    newValue?: string;
    defaultMeaning?: string;
    detail?: string;
    onCommit: () => Promise<void>;
  }>({
    isOpen: false,
    actionName: '',
    onCommit: async () => {},
  });

  const showNotification = (type: 'success' | 'error' | 'info', message: string) => {
    setNotification({ type, message });
    setTimeout(() => setNotification(null), 4000);
  };

  // Sync state when active recipe changes
  useEffect(() => {
    if (activeRecipe) {
      setRecipeForm({
        code: activeRecipe.code,
        name: activeRecipe.name,
        category: activeRecipe.category || 'Dairy Formulation',
        version: activeRecipe.version,
        status: activeRecipe.status,
        author: activeRecipe.author || 'Process Engineering MOM',
      });
      setParameters(JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(activeRecipe.parameters || [])));
      setQualityGateError(null);
    }
  }, [activeRecipe?.id, activeRecipe?.version, activeRecipe?.status]);

  // Is current recipe released or locked from editing
  const isReleased = (activeRecipe?.status || '').toUpperCase() === 'RELEASED' || (recipeForm.status || '').toUpperCase() === 'RELEASED';
  const isLocked = isReleased || (activeRecipe?.status || '').toUpperCase() === 'LOCKED' || (recipeForm.status || '').toUpperCase() === 'LOCKED';

  // Handle parameter value change in DRAFT mode
  const handleParamChange = (index: number, field: keyof RecipeParameter, value: any) => {
    if (isLocked) return;
    const updated = [...parameters];
    updated[index] = {
      ...updated[index],
      [field]: field === 'targetValue' || field === 'targetSetpoint' ? parseFloat(value) || 0 : value,
    };
    // Keep targetSetpoint and targetValue in sync
    if (field === 'targetValue') {
      updated[index].targetSetpoint = parseFloat(value) || 0;
    } else if (field === 'targetSetpoint') {
      updated[index].targetValue = parseFloat(value) || 0;
    }
    setParameters(updated);
    setQualityGateError(null);
  };

  // Save changes to current recipe with 21 CFR Part 11 E-Signature verification
  const handleSaveChanges = async () => {
    if (!activeRecipe) return;
    if (isLocked) {
      showNotification('error', `Recipe is ${activeRecipe.status}. Create a new version to modify formulation parameters.`);
      return;
    }

    setEsignModalConfig({
      isOpen: true,
      actionName: 'RECIPE_MODIFICATION',
      fieldName: 'RECIPE_FORMULATION',
      oldValue: `${activeRecipe.code} v${activeRecipe.version} (Active Baseline)`,
      newValue: `${recipeForm.code} v${recipeForm.version} (Modified Setpoints)`,
      defaultMeaning: 'Recipe Modification',
      detail: `Modified formulation parameters for recipe [${recipeForm.code} - ${recipeForm.name}]`,
      onCommit: async () => {
        try {
          await editRecipeMaster(activeRecipe.id, {
            code: recipeForm.code.trim().toUpperCase(),
            name: recipeForm.name.trim(),
            category: recipeForm.category.trim(),
            author: recipeForm.author.trim(),
          });
          await updateRecipeParameters(activeRecipe.id, parameters);
          showNotification('success', `Recipe [${recipeForm.code} ${activeRecipe.version}] parameters saved with verified electronic signature.`);
        } catch (err: any) {
          showNotification('error', `Failed to save recipe: ${err?.message || 'Database write failed'}`);
        }
      },
    });
  };

  // Create New Version handler
  const handleCreateVersion = async () => {
    if (!activeRecipe) return;
    try {
      await createNewVersion(activeRecipe.id);
      showNotification('success', `Created new draft version incremented from [${activeRecipe.code}]. Parameters unlocked for configuration.`);
    } catch (err: any) {
      showNotification('error', `Failed to create version: ${err?.message || 'Database write failed'}`);
    }
  };

  // Approve / Release Handler (Quality Gate Verification & 21 CFR Part 11 E-Signature)
  const handleApproveRelease = async () => {
    if (!activeRecipe) return;

    // 1. Clear any existing quality gate error banner
    setQualityGateError(null);

    // 2. Unify Parameter Data Binding: calculate total percentage directly from active parameters bound to the UI table
    const activeIngredients = parameters.filter(
      (p) =>
        p.phaseId === 'PH_DOSING' ||
        p.phaseId?.startsWith('PH_DOSING') ||
        p.phaseId?.startsWith('PH_SUPPLY') ||
        p.isIngredient ||
        p.unit === '%'
    );
    const totalPercentage = activeIngredients.reduce(
      (sum, p) => sum + (Number(p.targetSetpoint ?? p.targetValue ?? p.percentage ?? 0) || 0),
      0
    );

    // Allow slight floating point tolerance (e.g. 99.9% to 100.1%)
    if (Math.abs(totalPercentage - 100.0) > 0.1) {
      const errorMsg = `Quality Gate Warning: Total ingredient percentage is ${totalPercentage.toFixed(1)}% (must total 100.0% before release).`;
      setQualityGateError(errorMsg);
      showNotification('error', errorMsg);
      return;
    }

    setEsignModalConfig({
      isOpen: true,
      actionName: 'RECIPE_APPROVAL',
      fieldName: 'RECIPE_STATUS',
      oldValue: activeRecipe.status,
      newValue: 'RELEASED',
      defaultMeaning: 'Approval',
      detail: `Formal release authorization for master recipe [${activeRecipe.code} ${activeRecipe.version}]`,
      onCommit: async () => {
        try {
          await editRecipeMaster(activeRecipe.id, {
            code: recipeForm.code.trim().toUpperCase(),
            name: recipeForm.name.trim(),
            category: recipeForm.category.trim(),
            author: recipeForm.author.trim(),
          });
          await updateRecipeParameters(activeRecipe.id, parameters);
          await approveRecipe(activeRecipe.id);
          setRecipeForm((prev) => ({ ...prev, status: 'RELEASED' }));
          setQualityGateError(null);
          showNotification(
            'success',
            `Recipe [${activeRecipe.code} ${activeRecipe.version}] approved and RELEASED with verified electronic signature.`
          );
        } catch (err: any) {
          showNotification('error', `Failed to approve recipe: ${err?.message || 'Database write failed'}`);
        }
      },
    });
  };

  // Lock Recipe Handler
  const handleLockRecipe = async () => {
    if (!activeRecipe) return;
    try {
      await lockRecipe(activeRecipe.id);
      showNotification('info', `Recipe [${activeRecipe.code} ${activeRecipe.version}] marked as LOCKED/ARCHIVED.`);
    } catch (err: any) {
      showNotification('error', `Failed to lock recipe: ${err?.message || 'Database write failed'}`);
    }
  };

  // Create brand new recipe
  const handleCreateNewRecipe = async () => {
    const nextId = recipes.length > 0 ? Math.max(...recipes.map(r => r.id)) + 1 : 1;
    const defaultParams: RecipeParameter[] = [
      {
        id: `p-${nextId}-1`,
        phaseId: 'PH_SUPPLYMILK',
        parameterName: 'Raw Milk Supply',
        targetValue: 70.0,
        unit: '%',
        tolerance: 'Â±1.0%',
        targetNodeId: 'Recipe_Milk_SP',
        durationSeconds: 300,
        recipeId: nextId,
      },
      {
        id: `p-${nextId}-2`,
        phaseId: 'PH_SUPPLYSUGAR',
        parameterName: 'Sugar Syrup Supply',
        targetValue: 20.0,
        unit: '%',
        tolerance: 'Â±0.5%',
        targetNodeId: 'Recipe_Sugar_SP',
        durationSeconds: 180,
        recipeId: nextId,
      },
      {
        id: `p-${nextId}-3`,
        phaseId: 'PH_SUPPLYADDITIVE',
        parameterName: 'Additive Dosing',
        targetValue: 10.0,
        unit: '%',
        tolerance: 'Â±0.2%',
        targetNodeId: 'Recipe_Additive_SP',
        durationSeconds: 120,
        recipeId: nextId,
      },
      {
        id: `p-${nextId}-4`,
        phaseId: 'PH_HEATING',
        parameterName: 'Thermal Sterilization',
        targetValue: 138.0,
        unit: 'Â°C',
        tolerance: 'Â±0.5Â°C',
        targetNodeId: 'Recipe_Temp_SP',
        durationSeconds: 600,
        recipeId: nextId,
      },
      {
        id: `p-${nextId}-5`,
        phaseId: 'PH_COOLING',
        parameterName: 'Chilled Preservation',
        targetValue: 4.0,
        unit: 'Â°C',
        tolerance: 'Â±1.0Â°C',
        targetNodeId: 'Recipe_Cool_SP',
        durationSeconds: 450,
        recipeId: nextId,
      },
    ];

    try {
      await saveRecipeMaster({
        code: `RCP-CUSTOM-0${nextId}`,
        name: `New Dairy Formulation #${nextId}`,
        version: 'v1.0',
        status: 'DRAFT',
        category: 'Liquid Dairy Formulation',
        author: 'Lead MES Engineer',
        parameters: defaultParams,
        tempHot: 138,
        tempCold: 4,
      });
      showNotification('success', `Initialized New Master Recipe [RCP-CUSTOM-0${nextId} v1.0] in DRAFT mode.`);
    } catch (err: any) {
      showNotification('error', `Failed to create recipe: ${err?.message || 'Database write failed'}`);
    }
  };

  // Calculate percentage total for visual verification
  const activeIngredients = parameters.filter(
    (p) =>
      p.phaseId === 'PH_DOSING' ||
      p.phaseId?.startsWith('PH_DOSING') ||
      p.phaseId?.startsWith('PH_SUPPLY') ||
      p.isIngredient ||
      p.unit === '%'
  );
  const ingredientTotal = activeIngredients.reduce(
    (sum, p) => sum + (Number(p.targetSetpoint ?? p.targetValue ?? p.percentage ?? 0) || 0),
    0
  );

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      {/* Sub-Header Strip */}
      <div className="bg-white border border-slate-200 px-5 py-3 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-4 shadow-xs">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
          <div className="w-8 h-8 bg-slate-900 text-white flex items-center justify-center font-mono font-bold text-sm">
            <FileSpreadsheet className="w-4 h-4" />
          </div>
          <div>
            <h2 className="text-sm font-bold text-slate-900 font-mono tracking-tight uppercase">
              Recipe Management (Siemens PM-CONTROL Benchmark)
            </h2>
            <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 font-mono">
              ISA-88 Master Recipe Formulation, Version Life Cycle & Phase Parameter Binding
            </p>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Global Action & Recipe Count */}
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3 font-mono text-xs">
          <button
            onClick={handleCreateNewRecipe}
            className="h-9 px-3 bg-white hover:bg-slate-50 border border-slate-300 text-slate-900 font-mono font-semibold text-xs uppercase tracking-wider flex items-center gap-1.5 focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-sky-600 focus-visible:outline-offset-2 active:translate-y-px transition-none"
          >
            <Plus className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
            <span>New Master Recipe</span>
          </button>
          <div className="bg-slate-100 border border-slate-300 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs text-slate-700">
            {recipes.length} Master Recipes
          </div>
          <div className="bg-emerald-50 border border-emerald-200 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs text-emerald-800 font-bold">
            RELEASED RECIPES: {recipes.filter(r => (r.status || '').toUpperCase() === 'RELEASED').length}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Quality Gate Warning Banner */}
      {qualityGateError && (
        <div
          role="alert"
          className="p-3 text-xs font-mono border border-rose-300 bg-rose-50 text-rose-900 flex items-center justify-between gap-2 shadow-2xs"
        >
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <AlertTriangle className="w-4 h-4 text-rose-600 shrink-0" />
            <span className="font-semibold">{qualityGateError}</span>
          </div>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => setQualityGateError(null)}
            className="text-[11px] underline hover:no-underline font-mono font-bold"
          >
            DISMISS
          </button>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Notification Banner */}
      {notification && (
        <div
          role="alert"
          className={`p-3 text-xs font-mono border flex items-center justify-between gap-2 ${
            notification.type === 'success'
              ? 'bg-emerald-50 border-emerald-300 text-emerald-900'
              : notification.type === 'error'
              ? 'bg-rose-50 border-rose-300 text-rose-900'
              : 'bg-sky-50 border-sky-300 text-sky-900'
          }`}
        >
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            {notification.type === 'success' && <CheckCircle className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-600 shrink-0" />}
            {notification.type === 'error' && <AlertTriangle className="w-4 h-4 text-rose-600 shrink-0" />}
            {notification.type === 'info' && <Info className="w-4 h-4 text-sky-600 shrink-0" />}
            <span>{notification.message}</span>
          </div>
          <button
            onClick={() => setNotification(null)}
            className="text-[11px] underline hover:no-underline font-mono"
          >
            DISMISS
          </button>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* TOP CARD: Master Recipe Selection & Version Control (PM-CONTROL Benchmark) */}
      <div className="bg-white border border-slate-200 shadow-xs">
        <div className="px-5 py-3 bg-slate-50 border-b border-slate-200 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <Layers className="w-4 h-4 text-slate-700" />
            <span className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-900 font-mono uppercase tracking-wider">
              Master Recipe Header & Version Lifecycle
            </span>
          </div>

          {/* Recipe Status Badge */}
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 font-mono text-xs">
            <span className="text-slate-500 uppercase text-[10px]">LIFECYCLE STATUS:</span>
            {isReleased && (
              <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1 bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-800 border border-emerald-300 font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-xs">
                <CheckCircle className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-emerald-600" />
                RELEASED (Operational)
              </span>
            )}
            {!isReleased && ((activeRecipe?.status || '').toUpperCase() === 'DRAFT' || (recipeForm.status || '').toUpperCase() === 'DRAFT') && (
              <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1 bg-amber-50 text-amber-800 border border-amber-300 font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-xs">
                <Unlock className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-amber-600" />
                DRAFT (Modifiable)
              </span>
            )}
            {!isReleased && ((activeRecipe?.status || '').toUpperCase() === 'LOCKED' || (recipeForm.status || '').toUpperCase() === 'LOCKED') && (
              <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1 bg-slate-100 text-slate-700 border border-slate-300 font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-xs">
                <Lock className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-slate-500" />
                LOCKED / ARCHIVED
              </span>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Master Recipe Selector & Property Fields */}
        <div className="p-5 space-y-4 text-xs font-mono">
          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-4 items-end">
            {/* Master Recipe Dropdown */}
            <div className="md:col-span-4">
              <label className="block text-[11px] font-semibold text-slate-700 uppercase mb-1">
                Select Master Recipe
              </label>
              <select
                value={selectedRecipeId || ''}
                onChange={(e) => setSelectedRecipeId(parseInt(e.target.value, 10))}
                className="w-full h-9 px-3 text-xs font-mono bg-white border border-slate-300 text-slate-900 font-semibold focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-sky-600 focus-visible:outline-offset-2 transition-none"
              >
                {recipes.map((r) => (
                  <option key={r.id} value={r.id}>
                    [{r.code}] {r.name} ({r.version}) - {r.status}
                  </option>
                ))}
              </select>
            </div>

            {/* Recipe Code */}
            <div className="md:col-span-2">
              <label className="block text-[11px] font-semibold text-slate-700 uppercase mb-1">
                Recipe Code
              </label>
              <input
                type="text"
                disabled={isLocked}
                value={recipeForm.code}
                onChange={(e) => setRecipeForm({ ...recipeForm, code: e.target.value.toUpperCase() })}
                className="w-full h-9 px-3 text-xs font-mono bg-white border border-slate-300 text-slate-900 disabled:bg-slate-100 disabled:text-slate-600 focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-sky-600 focus-visible:outline-offset-2 transition-none"
              />
            </div>

            {/* Version String */}
            <div className="md:col-span-2">
              <label className="block text-[11px] font-semibold text-slate-700 uppercase mb-1">
                Active Version
              </label>
              <div className="relative">
                <GitBranch className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-slate-400 absolute left-2.5 top-2.5" />
                <input
                  type="text"
                  disabled
                  value={recipeForm.version}
                  className="w-full h-9 pl-8 pr-3 text-xs font-mono font-bold bg-slate-100 border border-slate-300 text-slate-800"
                />
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Category / Application */}
            <div className="md:col-span-4">
              <label className="block text-[11px] font-semibold text-slate-700 uppercase mb-1">
                Category / Process Class
              </label>
              <input
                type="text"
                disabled={isLocked}
                value={recipeForm.category}
                onChange={(e) => setRecipeForm({ ...recipeForm, category: e.target.value })}
                className="w-full h-9 px-3 text-xs font-mono bg-white border border-slate-300 text-slate-900 disabled:bg-slate-100 disabled:text-slate-600 focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-sky-600 focus-visible:outline-offset-2 transition-none"
              />
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Row 2: Recipe Name & Author Metadata */}
          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-4">
            <div className="md:col-span-8">
              <label className="block text-[11px] font-semibold text-slate-700 uppercase mb-1">
                Formulation Display Name
              </label>
              <input
                type="text"
                disabled={isLocked}
                value={recipeForm.name}
                onChange={(e) => setRecipeForm({ ...recipeForm, name: e.target.value })}
                className="w-full h-9 px-3 text-xs font-mono bg-white border border-slate-300 text-slate-900 disabled:bg-slate-100 disabled:text-slate-600 focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-sky-600 focus-visible:outline-offset-2 transition-none"
              />
            </div>

            <div className="md:col-span-4">
              <label className="block text-[11px] font-semibold text-slate-700 uppercase mb-1">
                Author / Lead MOM Engineer
              </label>
              <input
                type="text"
                disabled={isLocked}
                value={recipeForm.author}
                onChange={(e) => setRecipeForm({ ...recipeForm, author: e.target.value })}
                className="w-full h-9 px-3 text-xs font-mono bg-white border border-slate-300 text-slate-900 disabled:bg-slate-100 disabled:text-slate-600 focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-sky-600 focus-visible:outline-offset-2 transition-none"
              />
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Siemens PM-CONTROL Lifecycle Action Bar */}
          <div className="pt-3 border-t border-slate-200 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              {/* Button: Create New Version */}
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={handleCreateVersion}
                className="h-9 px-3.5 bg-slate-900 hover:bg-slate-800 text-white font-mono font-bold text-xs uppercase tracking-wider flex items-center gap-1.5 focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-sky-600 focus-visible:outline-offset-2 active:translate-y-px transition-none"
              >
                <GitBranch className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                <span>Create New Version</span>
              </button>

              {/* Button: Approve / Release Recipe */}
              <button
                type="button"
                disabled={isReleased}
                onClick={handleApproveRelease}
                className="h-9 px-3.5 bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-700 text-white font-mono font-bold text-xs uppercase tracking-wider flex items-center gap-1.5 disabled:opacity-50 disabled:cursor-not-allowed focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-sky-600 focus-visible:outline-offset-2 active:translate-y-px transition-none"
              >
                <CheckCircle className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                <span>Approve / Release Recipe</span>
              </button>

              {/* Button: Save Changes */}
              <button
                type="button"
                disabled={isLocked}
                onClick={handleSaveChanges}
                className="h-9 px-3.5 bg-white hover:bg-slate-50 border border-slate-300 text-slate-900 font-mono font-semibold text-xs uppercase tracking-wider flex items-center gap-1.5 disabled:opacity-50 disabled:cursor-not-allowed focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-sky-600 focus-visible:outline-offset-2 active:translate-y-px transition-none"
              >
                <Save className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-slate-700" />
                <span>Save Changes</span>
              </button>

              {/* Button: Lock Recipe */}
              {isReleased && (
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={handleLockRecipe}
                  className="h-9 px-3 bg-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-200 border border-slate-300 text-slate-700 font-mono text-xs uppercase tracking-wider flex items-center gap-1.5 focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-sky-600 focus-visible:outline-offset-2 active:translate-y-px transition-none"
                >
                  <Lock className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-slate-500" />
                  <span>Lock / Archive</span>
                </button>
              )}

              {/* Button: Delete Draft Recipe */}
              {!isLocked && (
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={async () => {
                    if (activeRecipe) {
                      try {
                        await deleteRecipeMaster(activeRecipe.id);
                        showNotification('info', `Draft recipe [${activeRecipe.code}] deleted.`);
                      } catch (err: any) {
                        showNotification('error', `Delete Failed: ${err?.message || 'Database error'}`);
                      }
                    }
                  }}
                  className="h-9 px-3 bg-rose-50 hover:bg-rose-100 border border-rose-200 text-rose-700 font-mono text-xs uppercase tracking-wider flex items-center gap-1.5 focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-sky-600 focus-visible:outline-offset-2 active:translate-y-px transition-none"
                >
                  <Trash2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-rose-600" />
                  <span>Delete Draft</span>
                </button>
              )}
            </div>

            {/* PM-CONTROL Integrity Indicator */}
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs font-mono">
              {isLocked ? (
                <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-amber-700 bg-amber-50 border border-amber-200 px-2.5 py-1">
                  <Lock className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                  <span>PARAMETERS LOCKED (PM-CONTROL INTEGRITY)</span>
                </div>
              ) : (
                <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-emerald-700 bg-emerald-50 border border-emerald-200 px-2.5 py-1">
                  <Unlock className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                  <span>DRAFT MODE: PARAMETERS EDITABLE</span>
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* BOTTOM CARD: Phase Parameter Binding Table (ISA-88 Mapping) */}
      <div className="bg-white border border-slate-200 shadow-xs">
        <div className="px-5 py-3 bg-slate-50 border-b border-slate-200 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <Sliders className="w-4 h-4 text-slate-700" />
            <span className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-900 font-mono uppercase tracking-wider">
              Phase Parameter Binding Table (ISA-88 Physical Phases)
            </span>
          </div>

          {/* Ingredients Formulation Verification Badge */}
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3 font-mono text-xs">
            <div
              className={`px-3 py-1 border flex items-center gap-1.5 ${
                Math.abs(ingredientTotal - 100) < 0.1
                  ? 'bg-emerald-50 border-emerald-300 text-emerald-800 font-semibold'
                  : 'bg-amber-50 border-amber-300 text-amber-800 font-bold'
              }`}
            >
              <span>INGREDIENT SUM:</span>
              <span>{ingredientTotal.toFixed(1)}%</span>
              {Math.abs(ingredientTotal - 100) < 0.1 ? (
                <CheckCircle className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-emerald-600 inline" />
              ) : (
                <AlertTriangle className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-amber-600 inline" />
              )}
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Phase Table */}
        <div className="overflow-x-auto">
          <table className="w-full text-left text-xs font-mono">
            <thead className="bg-slate-100 border-b border-slate-200 text-slate-700 uppercase tracking-wider text-[11px]">
              <tr>
                <th className="py-2.5 px-3">ISA-88 Phase ID</th>
                <th className="py-2.5 px-3">Parameter Name / Role</th>
                <th className="py-2.5 px-3 text-center">Target Setpoint</th>
                <th className="py-2.5 px-3 text-center">Unit</th>
                <th className="py-2.5 px-3 text-center">Tolerance Band</th>
                <th className="py-2.5 px-3">Target Node (OPC UA / Tag)</th>
                <th className="py-2.5 px-3 text-center">Duration</th>
                <th className="py-2.5 px-3 text-center">State</th>
              </tr>
            </thead>
            <tbody className="divide-y divide-slate-200 bg-white">
              {parameters.map((param, index) => {
                return (
                  <tr key={param.id || index} className="hover:bg-slate-50 transition-none">
                    {/* Phase ID */}
                    <td className="py-2.5 px-3 font-mono font-bold text-slate-900">
                      <span className="px-2 py-0.5 bg-slate-100 border border-slate-300 text-[11px]">
                        {param.phaseId}
                      </span>
                    </td>

                    {/* Parameter Name */}
                    <td className="py-2.5 px-3">
                      {isLocked ? (
                        <span className="font-semibold text-slate-800">{param.parameterName}</span>
                      ) : (
                        <input
                          type="text"
                          value={param.parameterName}
                          onChange={(e) => handleParamChange(index, 'parameterName', e.target.value)}
                          className="h-8 px-2 w-full text-xs font-mono bg-white border border-slate-300 text-slate-900 focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-sky-600 focus-visible:outline-offset-2"
                        />
                      )}
                    </td>

                    {/* Target Setpoint */}
                    <td className="py-2.5 px-3 text-center">
                      {isLocked ? (
                        <span className="font-bold text-slate-900 text-sm">{param.targetValue}</span>
                      ) : (
                        <input
                          type="number"
                          step="0.1"
                          value={param.targetValue}
                          onChange={(e) => handleParamChange(index, 'targetValue', e.target.value)}
                          className="h-8 px-2 w-24 text-center font-bold text-slate-900 text-xs font-mono bg-white border border-slate-300 focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-sky-600 focus-visible:outline-offset-2"
                        />
                      )}
                    </td>

                    {/* Unit */}
                    <td className="py-2.5 px-3 text-center font-semibold text-slate-600">
                      {param.unit}
                    </td>

                    {/* Tolerance Band */}
                    <td className="py-2.5 px-3 text-center">
                      {isLocked ? (
                        <span className="text-slate-700 bg-slate-100 px-2 py-0.5 border border-slate-200">
                          {param.tolerance}
                        </span>
                      ) : (
                        <input
                          type="text"
                          value={param.tolerance}
                          onChange={(e) => handleParamChange(index, 'tolerance', e.target.value)}
                          className="h-8 px-2 w-24 text-center text-xs font-mono bg-white border border-slate-300 text-slate-900 focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-sky-600 focus-visible:outline-offset-2"
                        />
                      )}
                    </td>

                    {/* Target Node (OPC UA / Tag) */}
                    <td className="py-2.5 px-3">
                      <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2 py-0.5 bg-slate-50 border border-slate-300 text-slate-800 text-[11px] font-mono">
                        <Cpu className="w-3 h-3 text-slate-500" />
                        {param.targetNodeId}
                      </span>
                    </td>

                    {/* Duration */}
                    <td className="py-2.5 px-3 text-center text-slate-700">
                      {param.durationSeconds ? `${param.durationSeconds} s` : 'Continuous'}
                    </td>

                    {/* Lock State */}
                    <td className="py-2.5 px-3 text-center">
                      {isLocked ? (
                        <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-[11px] text-slate-600 font-semibold" title="Locked by PM-CONTROL">
                          <Lock className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-slate-500" />
                          Locked
                        </span>
                      ) : (
                        <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-[11px] text-emerald-700 font-semibold" title="Editable">
                          <Unlock className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-emerald-600" />
                          Editable
                        </span>
                      )}
                    </td>
                  </tr>
                );
              })}
            </tbody>
          </table>
        </div>

        {/* Phase Table Footnote */}
        <div className="p-3 bg-slate-50 border-t border-slate-200 text-[11px] text-slate-500 font-mono flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <Info className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-slate-400" />
            <span>Parameters are bound to Siemens S7-1500 / Kepware OPC UA tags mapped in ISA-88 Telemetry Hub.</span>
          </div>
          <div className="text-[10px] text-slate-400">
            COMPLIANT: ISA-88.01 PART 1 MASTER RECIPE SCHEMA
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* 21 CFR Part 11 Electronic Signature Modal */}
      <ESignatureModal
        isOpen={esignModalConfig.isOpen}
        onClose={() => setEsignModalConfig((prev) => ({ ...prev, isOpen: false }))}
        onSuccess={async () => {
          await esignModalConfig.onCommit();
        }}
        actionName={esignModalConfig.actionName}
        fieldName={esignModalConfig.fieldName}
        oldValue={esignModalConfig.oldValue}
        newValue={esignModalConfig.newValue}
        defaultMeaning={esignModalConfig.defaultMeaning}
        detail={esignModalConfig.detail}
      />
    </div>
  );
};

export const OeeTagMappingModal: React.FC<OeeTagMappingModalProps> = ({
  isOpen,
  onClose,
  onSaved,
}) => {
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState<OeeModalTab>('counters');
  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState<string>('');

  // Empty baseline: All tag mapping fields start as empty strings ""
  const [tagInputs, setTagInputs] = useState<Record<string, string>>({});
  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [isSavingAll, setIsSavingAll] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [savingKey, setSavingKey] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const [toastMessage, setToastMessage] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [toastType, setToastType] = useState<'success' | 'error' | 'warning'>('success');

  // Test status per NodeId
  const [nodeTestResults, setNodeTestResults] = useState<Record<string, {
    testing: boolean;
    valid?: boolean;
    value?: any;
    message?: string;
  }>>({});

  const showToast = (msg: string, type: 'success' | 'error' | 'warning' = 'success') => {
    setToastMessage(msg);
    setToastType(type);
    setTimeout(() => setToastMessage(null), 4000);
  };

  // Load saved OEE tag mappings
  const loadSavedMappings = async () => {
    setIsLoading(true);
    setToastMessage(null);
    try {
      const res = await api.getOeeTagMappings();
      const raw = res && res.mappings ? res.mappings : {};
      const loaded: Record<string, string> = {};

      // Initialize counter tags
      OEE_COUNTER_TAGS.forEach((tag) => {
        const val = raw[tag.key];
        loaded[tag.key] = typeof val === 'string' ? val : (val?.node_id ? String(val.node_id) : '');
      });

      // Initialize 7 equipment tags
      SEVEN_EQUIPMENT_ASSETS.forEach((asset) => {
        const pvVal = raw[asset.pvTagKey];
        loaded[asset.pvTagKey] = typeof pvVal === 'string' ? pvVal : (pvVal?.node_id ? String(pvVal.node_id) : '');

        const stVal = raw[asset.stateTagKey];
        loaded[asset.stateTagKey] = typeof stVal === 'string' ? stVal : (stVal?.node_id ? String(stVal.node_id) : '');
      });

      setTagInputs(loaded);
    } catch (err: any) {
      console.warn('Could not load OEE tag mappings, keeping empty baseline:', err);
    } finally {
      setIsLoading(false);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    if (isOpen) {
      loadSavedMappings();
      setNodeTestResults({});
    }
  }, [isOpen]);

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  const handleInputChange = (key: string, value: string) => {
    setTagInputs((prev) => ({
      ...prev,
      [key]: value,
    }));
  };

  // Test single OPC UA NodeId connectivity
  const handleTestNode = async (key: string, nodeId: string) => {
    const cleanNode = nodeId.trim();
    if (!cleanNode) {
      setNodeTestResults((prev) => ({
        ...prev,
        [key]: { testing: false, valid: false, message: 'Node ID rá»—ng!' },
      }));
      return;
    }

    setNodeTestResults((prev) => ({
      ...prev,
      [key]: { testing: true },
    }));

    try {
      const res = await api.testOpcNodeConnectivity(cleanNode);
      setNodeTestResults((prev) => ({
        ...prev,
        [key]: {
          testing: false,
          valid: res.valid,
          value: res.value,
          message: res.message || (res.valid ? `GiĂ¡ trá»‹: ${res.value}` : 'KhĂ´ng cĂ³ pháº£n há»“i tá»« Kepware'),
        },
      }));
    } catch (err: any) {
      setNodeTestResults((prev) => ({
        ...prev,
        [key]: {
          testing: false,
          valid: false,
          message: err?.message || 'Lá»—i kiá»ƒm tra Node ID',
        },
      }));
    }
  };

  // Save single tag (Incremental Persistence)
  const handleSaveSingleTag = async (key: string) => {
    const val = tagInputs[key] || '';
    setSavingKey(key);
    try {
      const payload = { [key]: val.trim() };
      const res = await api.updateOeeTagMappings(payload);
      if (res && res.success) {
        showToast('ÄĂ£ lÆ°u tag OEE thĂ nh cĂ´ng!', 'success');
        if (onSaved) onSaved();
      } else {
        showToast(res.error || 'Lá»—i khi lÆ°u tag OEE!', 'error');
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      showToast(err?.message || 'Lá»—i khi gá»i API lÆ°u tag!', 'error');
    } finally {
      setSavingKey(null);
    }
  };

  // Save asset row (PV + State tags together)
  const handleSaveAssetRow = async (pvKey: string, stateKey: string) => {
    const payload = {
      [pvKey]: (tagInputs[pvKey] || '').trim(),
      [stateKey]: (tagInputs[stateKey] || '').trim(),
    };
    setSavingKey(pvKey);
    try {
      const res = await api.updateOeeTagMappings(payload);
      if (res && res.success) {
        showToast('ÄĂ£ lÆ°u cáº¥u hĂ¬nh thiáº¿t bá»‹ thĂ nh cĂ´ng!', 'success');
        if (onSaved) onSaved();
      } else {
        showToast(res.error || 'Lá»—i khi lÆ°u cáº¥u hĂ¬nh thiáº¿t bá»‹!', 'error');
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      showToast(err?.message || 'Lá»—i khi gá»i API lÆ°u thiáº¿t bá»‹!', 'error');
    } finally {
      setSavingKey(null);
    }
  };

  // Save all tags together
  const handleSaveAll = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setIsSavingAll(true);
    try {
      const payload: Record<string, string> = {};
      Object.entries(tagInputs).forEach(([k, v]) => {
        payload[k] = (v || '').trim();
      });

      const res = await api.updateOeeTagMappings(payload);
      if (res && res.success) {
        showToast('ÄĂ£ lÆ°u toĂ n bá»™ 17 tag OEE vĂ o há»‡ thá»‘ng!', 'success');
        if (onSaved) onSaved();
      } else {
        showToast(res.error || 'Lá»—i khi lÆ°u cáº¥u hĂ¬nh tag OEE!', 'error');
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      showToast(err?.message || 'Lá»—i khi gá»i API lÆ°u toĂ n bá»™!', 'error');
    } finally {
      setIsSavingAll(false);
    }
  };

  // Mapped count telemetry
  const totalTagsCount = OEE_COUNTER_TAGS.length + SEVEN_EQUIPMENT_ASSETS.length * 2;
  const mappedCount = Object.values(tagInputs).filter((v) => v && v.trim() !== '' && v.trim() !== '[CHÆ¯A ĂNH Xáº ]').length;

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4 bg-slate-900/60 backdrop-blur-xs animate-in fade-in duration-200">
      <div className="bg-white border border-slate-300 rounded shadow-2xl w-full max-w-5xl max-h-[92vh] flex flex-col overflow-hidden text-slate-800 font-sans">
        {/* =========================================================================
            HEADER & TOP STATUS
           ========================================================================= */}
        <div className="px-6 py-4 bg-slate-50 border-b border-slate-200 flex items-center justify-between shrink-0">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded bg-sky-50 border border-sky-200 flex items-center justify-center text-sky-700">
              <Settings className="w-5 h-5" />
            </div>
            <div>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <h2 className="text-base font-bold text-slate-900 tracking-tight uppercase" style={{ fontStyle: 'normal' }}>
                  Cáº¤U HĂŒNH TAG OEE &amp; 7 THIáº¾T Bá» CĂ”NG NGHá»† CHáº¤P HĂ€NH
                </h2>
                <span className="px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-mono font-semibold uppercase bg-sky-100 text-sky-800 rounded border border-sky-200">
                  Kepware OPC UA port 49320
                </span>

                Ănh xáº¡ Node ID phá»¥c vá»¥ tĂ­nh toĂ¡n Availability (A), Performance (P), Quality (Q) vĂ  Six Big Losses.

              <span className="text-[10px] font-mono uppercase text-slate-500 block">Äá»™ phá»§ Ă¡nh xáº¡:</span>

                {mappedCount} / {totalTagsCount} Tags ({Math.round((mappedCount / totalTagsCount) * 100)}%)

              type="button"

    sectionTitle: '3. PROCESS CELL 2 (SIMIT DIGITAL TWIN)',
    group: 'pc2_up2000',
    groupTitle: 'SIMIT HIERARCHY: UP2000 STERILIZE UNIT',
    direction: 'READ',
    unit: 'Int16',
    expectedType: 'Int16',
    icon: Layers,
  },
];

export const OperationsTagMappingModal: React.FC<OperationsTagMappingModalProps> = ({
  isOpen,
  onClose,
  onSaved,
}) => {
  // Active Section Filter Tab
  const [activeSection, setActiveSection] = useState<'all' | TagSectionType>('general');
  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState<string>('');

  // Empty baseline state: All fields initially completely empty ""
  const [tagInputs, setTagInputs] = useState<Record<string, string>>({});

  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [isSavingAll, setIsSavingAll] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [savingKey, setSavingKey] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [toastMessage, setToastMessage] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [toastType, setToastType] = useState<'success' | 'error' | 'warning'>('success');

  // Test status per NodeId
  const [nodeTestResults, setNodeTestResults] = useState<Record<string, {
    testing: boolean;
    valid?: boolean;
    value?: any;
    message?: string;
  }>>({});

  // Fetch saved mappings on modal open
  const loadSavedMappings = async () => {
    setIsLoading(true);
    setToastMessage(null);
    try {
      const res = await api.getOperationsTagMappings();
      if (res && res.mappings) {
        const raw = res.mappings;
        const loaded: Record<string, string> = {};

        OPERATIONS_TAG_PARAMETERS.forEach((param) => {
          let val = '';

          // 1. Check dot-notation for nested dicts (e.g. pc1_phases.PH11101)
          if (param.key.includes('.')) {
            const [parentKey, subKey] = param.key.split('.');
            if (raw[parentKey] && typeof raw[parentKey] === 'object' && raw[parentKey][subKey]) {
              const subVal = raw[parentKey][subKey];
              val = typeof subVal === 'string' ? subVal : subVal.node_id ? String(subVal.node_id) : '';
            } else if (raw[param.key]) {
              val = typeof raw[param.key] === 'string' ? raw[param.key] : raw[param.key].node_id || '';
            }
          } else {
            // Direct key
            const candidate = raw[param.key] || raw[param.key.toUpperCase()] || raw[param.label];
            if (typeof candidate === 'string') {
              val = candidate;
            } else if (candidate && typeof candidate === 'object' && candidate.node_id) {
              val = String(candidate.node_id);
            }
          }

          // 2. Check aliases if still empty
          if (!val) {
            const aliasMap: Record<string, string[]> = {
              uht_temp_sp: ['Recipe_Temp_SP', 'Heat_Temp_SP', 'UHT_TEMP_SP', 'pc1_uht_temp_sp'],
              pc1_uht_temp_sp: ['Recipe_Temp_SP', 'Heat_Temp_SP', 'UHT_TEMP_SP', 'uht_temp_sp'],
              uht_temp_pv: ['Heat_Temp_ACT', 'Temp_Sterilizer_PV', 'UHT_TEMP_PV', 'pc1_uht_temp_pv'],
              pc1_uht_temp_pv: ['Heat_Temp_ACT', 'Temp_Sterilizer_PV', 'UHT_TEMP_PV', 'uht_temp_pv'],
              cooling_temp_sp: ['Cold_Temp_SP', 'Cooling_Temp_SP', 'COOLING_TEMP_SP'],
              cooling_temp_pv: ['Cold_Temp_ACT', 'Cooling_Temp_PV', 'COOLING_TEMP_PV'],
              agitator_speed_sp: ['Agitator_Speed_SP', 'Motor_Speed_SP', 'AGITATOR_SPEED_SP'],
              agitator_speed_pv: ['MOTOR_SPEED_ACT', 'Agitator_Speed_PV', 'AGITATOR_SPEED_PV'],
              cip_clean_status: ['CIP_CLEAN_STATUS'],
              cip_start_cmd: ['CIP_START_CMD'],
              batch_start_cmd: ['Batch_Start_CMD', 'Batch_Start', 'BATCH_START_CMD', 'cell1.CMD_Start'],
              batch_hold_cmd: ['Batch_Hold_CMD', 'Batch_Hold', 'BATCH_HOLD_CMD'],
              batch_complete_flag: ['FLAG_BATCH_COMPLETE', 'Batch_Complete_Flag', 'BATCH_COMPLETE_FLAG', 'cell1.Flag_Complete'],
              pc1_batch_state: ['Batch_State', 'batch_state', 'cell1.State_ID'],
              pc2_simit_batch_state: ['SIMIT_Batch_State', 'cell2_simit.State_ID'],
              pc2_simit_uht_temp_sp: ['SIMIT_Temp_Hot_SP', 'cell2_simit.Heating_SP'],
              pc2_simit_uht_temp_pv: ['SIMIT_Temp_Hot_PV', 'cell2_simit.Heating_PV'],
              'cell1.Heating_SP': ['pc1_uht_temp_sp', 'uht_temp_sp', 'Recipe_Temp_SP'],
              'cell1.Heating_PV': ['pc1_uht_temp_pv', 'uht_temp_pv', 'Heat_Temp_ACT'],
              'cell1.Cooling_SP': ['cooling_temp_sp', 'Cold_Temp_SP'],
              'cell1.Cooling_PV': ['cooling_temp_pv', 'Cold_Temp_ACT'],
              'cell1.Agitator_SP': ['agitator_speed_sp', 'Motor_Speed_SP'],
              'cell1.Agitator_PV': ['agitator_speed_pv', 'MOTOR_SPEED_ACT'],
              'cell1.CMD_Start': ['batch_start_cmd', 'Batch_Start_CMD'],
              'cell1.Flag_Complete': ['batch_complete_flag', 'FLAG_BATCH_COMPLETE'],
              'cell1.State_ID': ['pc1_batch_state', 'Batch_State'],
              'cell2_simit.Heating_SP': ['pc2_simit_uht_temp_sp', 'SIMIT_Temp_Hot_SP'],
              'cell2_simit.Heating_PV': ['pc2_simit_uht_temp_pv', 'SIMIT_Temp_Hot_PV'],
              'cell2_simit.State_ID': ['pc2_simit_batch_state', 'SIMIT_Batch_State'],
            };

            const aliases = aliasMap[param.key] || [];
            for (const al of aliases) {
              let aVal: any = undefined;
              if (al.includes('.')) {
                const [p, c] = al.split('.');
                aVal = raw[p]?.[c];
              } else {
                aVal = raw[al];
              }
              if (typeof aVal === 'string' && aVal) {
                val = aVal;
                break;
              } else if (aVal && typeof aVal === 'object' && aVal.node_id) {
                val = String(aVal.node_id);
                break;
              }
            }
          }

          loaded[param.key] = val || '';
        });

        setTagInputs(loaded);
      }
    } catch {
      // Graceful baseline: keep empty strings ""
    } finally {
      setIsLoading(false);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    if (isOpen) {
      loadSavedMappings();
      setNodeTestResults({});
    }
  }, [isOpen]);

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  const showToast = (msg: string, type: 'success' | 'error' | 'warning' = 'success') => {
    setToastMessage(msg);
    setToastType(type);
    setTimeout(() => {
      setToastMessage(null);
    }, 4000);
  };

  const handleInputChange = (key: string, value: string) => {
    setTagInputs((prev) => ({
      ...prev,
      [key]: value,
    }));
  };

  // Test single OPC UA NodeId connectivity
  const handleTestNode = async (key: string, nodeId: string) => {
    const cleanNode = nodeId.trim();
    if (!cleanNode) {
      setNodeTestResults((prev) => ({
        ...prev,
        [key]: { testing: false, valid: false, message: 'Node ID rá»—ng!' },
      }));
      return;
    }

    setNodeTestResults((prev) => ({
      ...prev,
      [key]: { testing: true },
    }));

    try {
      const res = await api.testOpcNodeConnectivity(cleanNode);
      setNodeTestResults((prev) => ({
        ...prev,
        [key]: {
          testing: false,
          valid: res.valid,
          value: res.value,
          message: res.message || (res.valid ? `Pháº£n há»“i: ${res.value}` : 'KhĂ´ng cĂ³ pháº£n há»“i tá»« Kepware'),
        },
      }));
    } catch (err: any) {
      setNodeTestResults((prev) => ({
        ...prev,
        [key]: {
          testing: false,
          valid: false,
          message: err.message || 'Lá»—i kiá»ƒm tra Node ID',
        },
      }));
    }
  };

  // Save single tag individually (Incremental Persistence)
  const handleSaveSingleTag = async (key: string) => {
    const val = tagInputs[key] || '';
    setSavingKey(key);
    try {
      const payload = { [key]: val.trim() };
      const res = await api.updateOperationsTagMappings(payload);
      if (res && res.success) {
        showToast('ÄĂ£ lÆ°u cáº¥u hĂ¬nh Tag thĂ nh cĂ´ng!', 'success');
        if (onSaved) onSaved();
      } else {
        showToast(res.error || 'Lá»—i khi lÆ°u cáº¥u hĂ¬nh tag!', 'error');
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      showToast(err.message || 'Lá»—i khi gá»i API lÆ°u tag!', 'error');
    } finally {
      setSavingKey(null);
    }
  };

  // Save active section tags together (Atomic Merge for Tab 1, 2, or 3)
  const handleSaveActiveTab = async () => {
    setIsSavingAll(true);
    try {
      const payload: Record<string, string> = {};
      const relevantParams = activeSection === 'all'
        ? OPERATIONS_TAG_PARAMETERS
        : OPERATIONS_TAG_PARAMETERS.filter((p) => p.section === activeSection);

      relevantParams.forEach((param) => {
        if (tagInputs[param.key] !== undefined) {
          payload[param.key] = (tagInputs[param.key] || '').trim();
        }
      });

      const res = await api.updateOperationsTagMappings(payload);
      if (res && res.success) {
        const tabLabel = activeSection === 'pc1'
          ? 'Process Cell 1 (Hardware)'
          : activeSection === 'pc2_simit'
          ? 'Process Cell 2 (SIMIT Twin)'
          : activeSection === 'general'
          ? 'Biáº¿n quy trĂ¬nh chung'
          : 'Táº¥t cáº£';
        showToast(`ÄĂ£ lÆ°u cáº¥u hĂ¬nh [${tabLabel}] thĂ nh cĂ´ng!`, 'success');
        if (onSaved) onSaved();
      } else {
        showToast(res.error || 'Lá»—i khi lÆ°u cáº¥u hĂ¬nh tag!', 'error');
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      showToast(err.message || 'Lá»—i khi gá»i API lÆ°u tab!', 'error');
    } finally {
      setIsSavingAll(false);
    }
  };

  // Save all tags or active section tags together
  const handleSaveAll = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setIsSavingAll(true);
    try {
      const payload: Record<string, string> = {};
      Object.entries(tagInputs).forEach(([k, v]) => {
        payload[k] = (v || '').trim();
      });

      const res = await api.updateOperationsTagMappings(payload);
      if (res && res.success) {
        showToast('ÄĂ£ lÆ°u cáº¥u hĂ¬nh Tag thĂ nh cĂ´ng!', 'success');
        if (onSaved) onSaved();
      } else {
        showToast(res.error || 'Lá»—i khi lÆ°u cáº¥u hĂ¬nh tag!', 'error');
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      showToast(err.message || 'Lá»—i khi gá»i API lÆ°u táº¥t cáº£ tag!', 'error');
    } finally {
      setIsSavingAll(false);
    }
  };

  // Filter items based on active section and search query
  const filteredParameters = OPERATIONS_TAG_PARAMETERS.filter((param) => {
    if (activeSection !== 'all' && param.section !== activeSection) {
      return false;
    }
    if (searchQuery.trim()) {
      const q = searchQuery.toLowerCase().trim();
      return (
        param.key.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
        param.label.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
        param.description.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
        (tagInputs[param.key] || '').toLowerCase().includes(q)
      );
    }
    return true;
  });

  // Group filtered parameters by their groupTitle
  const groupedParameters = filteredParameters.reduce<Record<string, TagParameterDefinition[]>>((acc, item) => {
    if (!acc[item.groupTitle]) {
      acc[item.groupTitle] = [];
    }
    acc[item.groupTitle].push(item);
    return acc;
  }, {});

  // Section item counts for tabs
  const countGeneral = OPERATIONS_TAG_PARAMETERS.filter((p) => p.section === 'general').length;
  const countPc1 = OPERATIONS_TAG_PARAMETERS.filter((p) => p.section === 'pc1').length;
  const countPc2 = OPERATIONS_TAG_PARAMETERS.filter((p) => p.section === 'pc2_simit').length;

  return (
    <div
      role="dialog"
      aria-modal="true"
      aria-labelledby="ops-tag-mapping-title"
      className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-3 sm:p-6 bg-slate-900/60 backdrop-blur-xs font-mono"
    >
      <div className="bg-white border border-slate-300 shadow-2xl w-full max-w-5xl max-h-[92vh] flex flex-col text-xs text-slate-800 animate-in fade-in zoom-in-95 duration-150">
        {/* Modal Header */}
        <div className="p-4 bg-slate-900 text-white flex items-center justify-between border-b border-slate-700 shrink-0 select-none">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
            <Settings className="w-5 h-5 text-sky-400 shrink-0" />
            <div>
              <h2 id="ops-tag-mapping-title" className="text-sm font-bold uppercase tracking-wider not-italic text-white">
                Cáº¤U HĂŒNH ĂNH Xáº  KEPWARE OPC UA TAG - OPERATIONS &amp; BATCH (ISA-88)
              </h2>
              <div className="text-[11px] text-slate-400 font-normal mt-0.5">
                Strict Empty-Baseline &amp; Incremental Persistence Â· Process Cell 1 (Physical) &amp; Process Cell 2 (SIMIT Digital Twin)
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={onClose}
            className="h-9 w-9 flex items-center justify-center text-slate-400 hover:text-white hover:bg-slate-800 transition-none focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-sky-400 focus-visible:outline-offset-2 active:translate-y-px"
            title="ÄĂ³ng modal"
          >
            <X className="w-4 h-4" />
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* Section Selector Toolbar */}
        <div className="px-4 py-2 bg-slate-100 border-b border-slate-200 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2 shrink-0">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setActiveSection('general')}
              className={`h-8 px-3 text-xs uppercase font-mono border transition-none flex items-center gap-1.5 ${
                activeSection === 'general'
                  ? 'bg-slate-900 text-white border-slate-900 font-bold'
                  : 'bg-white hover:bg-slate-200 text-slate-700 border-slate-300'
              }`}
            >
              <span>1. Biáº¿n Quy TrĂ¬nh Chung ({countGeneral})</span>
            </button>

            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setActiveSection('pc1')}
              className={`h-8 px-3 text-xs uppercase font-mono border transition-none flex items-center gap-1.5 ${
                activeSection === 'pc1'
                  ? 'bg-slate-900 text-white border-slate-900 font-bold'
                  : 'bg-white hover:bg-slate-200 text-slate-700 border-slate-300'
              }`}
            >
              <Cpu className="w-3 h-3 text-emerald-400" />
              <span>2. Process Cell 1 - Hardware ({countPc1})</span>
            </button>

            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setActiveSection('pc2_simit')}
              className={`h-8 px-3 text-xs uppercase font-mono border transition-none flex items-center gap-1.5 ${
                activeSection === 'pc2_simit'
                  ? 'bg-slate-900 text-white border-slate-900 font-bold'
                  : 'bg-white hover:bg-slate-200 text-slate-700 border-slate-300'
              }`}
            >
              <Radio className="w-3 h-3 text-sky-400" />
              <span>3. Process Cell 2 - SIMIT Twin ({countPc2})</span>
            </button>

            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setActiveSection('all')}
              className={`h-8 px-3 text-xs uppercase font-mono border transition-none flex items-center gap-1.5 ${
                activeSection === 'all'
                  ? 'bg-slate-900 text-white border-slate-900 font-bold'
                  : 'bg-white hover:bg-slate-200 text-slate-700 border-slate-300'
              }`}
            >
              <span>Táº¥t cáº£ ({OPERATIONS_TAG_PARAMETERS.length})</span>
            </button>
          </div>

          {/* Search Filter Box */}
          <div className="relative w-full sm:w-64">
            <Search className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-slate-400 absolute left-2.5 top-2.5 pointer-events-none" />
            <input
              type="text"
              value={searchQuery}
              onChange={(e) => setSearchQuery(e.target.value)}
              placeholder="TĂ¬m kiáº¿m tag / nodeId..."
              className="w-full h-8 pl-8 pr-3 bg-white border border-slate-300 text-xs font-mono placeholder:text-slate-400 focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-sky-600 focus-visible:outline-offset-2 transition-none"
            />
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Informational Guidance Banner */}
        <div className="px-4 py-2 bg-slate-50 border-b border-slate-200 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2 text-[11px] text-slate-600 shrink-0">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <HelpCircle className="w-4 h-4 text-slate-500 shrink-0" />
            <span>
              Khá»Ÿi táº¡o máº·c Ä‘á»‹nh trá»‘ng hoĂ n toĂ n <code className="bg-slate-200 px-1 py-0.5 text-slate-900 font-bold">""</code> (Zero simulation mocks). Biáº¿n chÆ°a Ă¡nh xáº¡ hiá»ƒn thá»‹ <code className="bg-slate-200 px-1 py-0.5 text-slate-700">[CHÆ¯A ĂNH Xáº ]</code>.
            </span>
          </div>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 shrink-0">
            <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-[10px] text-slate-600 bg-white border border-slate-300 px-2 py-0.5 font-bold">
              PORT: 49320 (KEPWARE OPC UA)
            </span>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Non-blocking Toast Feedback */}
        {toastMessage && (
          <div
            className={`mx-4 mt-3 p-3 border font-mono text-xs flex items-center justify-between shrink-0 ${
              toastType === 'success'
                ? 'bg-emerald-50 border-emerald-300 text-emerald-950'
                : toastType === 'warning'
                ? 'bg-amber-50 border-amber-300 text-amber-950'
                : 'bg-rose-50 border-rose-300 text-rose-950'
            }`}
          >
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 font-bold">
              {toastType === 'success' ? (
                <CheckCircle2 className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-700 shrink-0" />
              ) : (
                <AlertTriangle className="w-4 h-4 text-rose-700 shrink-0" />
              )}
              <span>{toastMessage}</span>
            </div>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setToastMessage(null)}
              className="text-slate-500 hover:text-slate-900 text-xs font-bold px-1"
            >
              [âœ•]
            </button>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* Scrollable Form Body */}
        <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto p-4 sm:p-5 space-y-5">
          {isLoading ? (
            <div className="py-12 text-center text-slate-500 font-mono">
              <Activity className="w-6 h-6 animate-spin mx-auto text-sky-600 mb-2" />
              <span>Äang Ä‘á»c cáº¥u hĂ¬nh tá»« tag_mappings.json &amp; SQL Server...</span>
            </div>
          ) : Object.keys(groupedParameters).length === 0 ? (
            <div className="py-12 text-center text-slate-400 font-mono">
              KhĂ´ng tĂ¬m tháº¥y thĂ´ng sá»‘ nĂ o phĂ¹ há»£p vá»›i bá»™ lá»c.
            </div>
          ) : (
            Object.entries(groupedParameters).map(([groupTitle, items]) => (
              <div key={groupTitle} className="border border-slate-200 bg-white shadow-2xs">
                {/* Group Header */}
                <div className="bg-slate-100/90 px-3 py-2 border-b border-slate-200 text-slate-800 font-bold uppercase text-[11px] tracking-wider flex items-center justify-between">
                  <span>{groupTitle}</span>
                  <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-500 font-normal">
                    {items.length} THĂ”NG Sá»
                  </span>
                </div>

                {/* Group Items */}
                <div className="divide-y divide-slate-100">
                  {items.map((item) => {
                    const currentValue = tagInputs[item.key] || '';
                    const isMapped = Boolean(currentValue.trim() && currentValue.trim() !== '[CHÆ¯A ĂNH Xáº ]');
                    const Icon = item.icon;
                    const test = nodeTestResults[item.key];
                    const isSingleSaving = savingKey === item.key;

                    return (
                      <div
                        key={item.key}
                        className="p-3 hover:bg-slate-50/60 transition-none flex flex-col md:flex-row md:items-center justify-between gap-3"
                      >
                        {/* Left: Metadata & Labels */}
                        <div className="md:w-5/12 space-y-1">
                          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                            <Icon className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-slate-600 shrink-0" />
                            <span className="font-bold text-slate-900">{item.label}</span>
                            <span
                              className={`px-1.5 py-0.2 text-[9px] font-bold border uppercase ${
                                item.direction === 'WRITE'
                                  ? 'bg-blue-50 text-blue-800 border-blue-200'
                                  : 'bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-800 border-emerald-200'
                              }`}
                            >
                              {item.direction}
                            </span>
                            <span className="px-1.5 py-0.2 text-[9px] bg-slate-100 text-slate-700 border border-slate-200 font-bold">
                              {item.unit}
                            </span>
                          </div>

                          <div className="text-[11px] text-slate-500 leading-tight">
                            {item.description}
                          </div>

                          {/* Status Pill */}
                          <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 pt-0.5">
                            <span
                              className={`inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-bold uppercase border ${
                                isMapped
                                  ? 'bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-800 border-emerald-300'
                                  : 'bg-slate-100 text-slate-500 border-slate-300'
                              }`}
                            >
                              <span
                                className={`w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full ${
                                  isMapped ? 'bg-emerald-600' : 'bg-slate-400'
                                }`}
                              />
                              {isMapped ? 'ÄĂƒ ĂNH Xáº ' : '[CHÆ¯A ĂNH Xáº ] (--)'}
                            </span>

                            {test && (
                              <span
                                className={`text-[10px] font-bold px-1.5 py-0.5 border ${
                                  test.testing
                                    ? 'bg-sky-50 text-sky-800 border-sky-300'
                                    : test.valid
                                    ? 'bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-800 border-emerald-300'
                                    : 'bg-rose-50 text-rose-800 border-rose-300'
                                }`}
                              >
                                {test.testing ? 'Äang test...' : test.message}
                              </span>
                            )}
                          </div>
                        </div>

                        {/* Right: Input field & Action Buttons */}
                        <div className="md:w-7/12 flex items-center gap-2">
                          <input
                            type="text"
                            value={currentValue}
                            onChange={(e) => handleInputChange(item.key, e.target.value)}
                            placeholder={`Nháº­p NodeId cho ${item.label}...`}

          </div>

            >

            {activeSection !== 'all' && (

                  LÆ¯U {activeSection === 'pc1' ? 'TAB 2 (CELL 1)' : activeSection === 'pc2_simit' ? 'TAB 3 (SIMIT TWIN)' : 'TAB 1 (CHUNG)'}
                </span>
              </button>
            )}

            <button
              type="button"
              disabled={isSavingAll || isLoading}
              onClick={handleSaveAll}

            >
              <Check className={`w-4 h-4 ${isSavingAll ? 'animate-spin' : ''}`} />
              <span>{isSavingAll ? 'ÄANG LÆ¯U TOĂ€N Bá»˜...' : 'LÆ¯U TOĂ€N Bá»˜ Cáº¤U HĂŒNH'}</span>
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export default OperationsTagMappingModal;

export const QualityDetailTab: React.FC = () => {
  const {

    selectedBatch,

    dispositionBatch,
    setActiveSubTab

  const [notes, setNotes] = useState<string>(selectedBatch?.reviewerNotes || '');
  const [feedbackMsg, setFeedbackMsg] = useState<{ text: string; type: 'success' | 'error' | 'info' } | null>(null);
  const [showPdfModal, setShowPdfModal] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [isEsignModalOpen, setIsEsignModalOpen] = useState<boolean>(false);

  const isPass = selectedBatch?.status === 'PASS';
  const currentDisposition: BatchDisposition = selectedBatch?.disposition || (isPass ? 'RELEASED' : 'QUARANTINED');

  const handleQuarantine = () => {
    const res = dispositionBatch(selectedReportId, 'QUARANTINED', notes);
    setFeedbackMsg({ text: res.message, type: res.success ? 'error' : 'info' });
    setTimeout(() => setFeedbackMsg(null), 4000);
  };

  const handleApproveRelease = () => {
    setIsEsignModalOpen(true);
  };

  const handleCommitRelease = () => {
    const res = dispositionBatch(selectedReportId, 'RELEASED', notes);
    setFeedbackMsg({ 
      text: `Batch released with cryptographically verified electronic signature. ${res.message}`, 
      type: res.success ? 'success' : 'error' 
    });
    setTimeout(() => setFeedbackMsg(null), 4000);
  };

  const handleExportCertificate = () => {
    setShowPdfModal(true);
  };

  const getParameterIcon = (phaseId: string, paramName: string) => {
    if (paramName.includes('Temp') || phaseId.includes('HEATING')) {
      return <Flame className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-rose-600 shrink-0" />;
    }
    if (phaseId.includes('COOLING')) {
      return <ThermometerSnowflake className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-sky-600 shrink-0" />;
    }
    if (phaseId.includes('MIXING')) {
      return <RotateCw className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-indigo-600 shrink-0" />;
    }
    return <Scale className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-slate-500 shrink-0" />;

                type="button"

                <strong>Auditor Assessment:</strong> {notes || selectedBatch?.reviewerNotes || 'Standard evaluation recorded.'}
              </div>

                className="h-9 px-4 bg-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-200 text-slate-800 font-semibold text-xs uppercase rounded-xs"
              >
                Cancel
              </button>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => {
                  alert(`Certificate of Analysis (CoA-2026-${selectedReportId.toString().padStart(4, '0')}) exported to MES Document Store.`);
                  setShowPdfModal(false);
                }}
                className="h-9 px-4 bg-slate-900 hover:bg-slate-800 text-white font-semibold text-xs uppercase flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-xs"
              >
                <Download className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                <span>Download Certified PDF</span>
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* 21 CFR Part 11 Electronic Signature Modal */}
      <ESignatureModal
        isOpen={isEsignModalOpen}
        onClose={() => setIsEsignModalOpen(false)}
        onSuccess={handleCommitRelease}
        actionName="BATCH_RELEASE"
        fieldName="DISPOSITION"
        oldValue={currentDisposition}
        newValue="RELEASED"
        defaultMeaning="Batch Release"
        detail={`Quality disposition release for report [${selectedBatch?.reportCode || `RPT-${selectedReportId}`}]`}
      />
    </div>
  );
};

/* Hallmark Â· component: QualityTagMappingModal Â· genre: modern-minimal Â· register: industrial-workbench
 * states: default Â· hover Â· focus Â· active Â· disabled Â· loading Â· error Â· success

import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { 
  X, 
  CheckCircle2, 
  AlertTriangle, 
  Radio, 
  Save, 
  RotateCw,
  Sliders,
  ShieldCheck,
  Flame,
  Scale,
  Beaker
} from 'lucide-react';
import * as api from '../../services/api';
import { QualityTagConfigItem } from '../../types/quality';

export interface QualityTagMappingModalProps {
  isOpen: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  onSaved?: () => void;
}

interface TagTestStatus {
  testing: boolean;
  quality?: 'Good' | 'Bad' | 'Unmapped';
  value?: any;
  message?: string;
}

export const QualityTagMappingModal: React.FC<QualityTagMappingModalProps> = ({
  isOpen,
  onClose,
  onSaved,
}) => {
  // Persistent local dictionary of Quality tags
  const [tagConfigs, setTagConfigs] = useState<Record<string, QualityTagConfigItem>>({
    inline_ph_pv: {
      tag_name: 'inline_ph_pv',
      node_id: '',
      description: 'Inline Milk Acidity (pH)',
      unit: 'pH',
      spec_min: 6.5,
      spec_max: 6.8,
    },
    inline_brix_pv: {
      tag_name: 'inline_brix_pv',
      node_id: '',
      description: 'Refractometer Dissolved Brix',
      unit: 'Â°Bx',
      spec_min: 11.5,
      spec_max: 12.5,
    },
    pasteur_hold_temp: {
      tag_name: 'pasteur_hold_temp',
      node_id: '',
      description: 'Pasteurizer Holding Tube Critical Temp (CCP-1)',
      unit: 'Â°C',
      spec_min: 137.0,
      spec_max: 140.0,
    },
  });

  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [isSaving, setIsSaving] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [saveSuccess, setSaveSuccess] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [errorMessage, setErrorMessage] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [testResults, setTestResults] = useState<Record<string, TagTestStatus>>({});

  // Fetch current persistent mappings on open
  const fetchCurrentMappings = async () => {
    setIsLoading(true);
    setErrorMessage(null);
    try {
      const res = await api.getQualityTagMappings();
      if (res && res.tags) {
        setTagConfigs((prev) => {
          const updated = { ...prev };
          Object.entries(res.tags).forEach(([k, v]: [string, any]) => {
            updated[k] = {
              tag_name: k,
              node_id: v.node_id || '',
              description: v.description || updated[k]?.description || k,
              unit: v.unit || updated[k]?.unit || '--',
              spec_min: v.spec_min ?? updated[k]?.spec_min,
              spec_max: v.spec_max ?? updated[k]?.spec_max,
              value: v.value,
              quality: v.quality,
            };
          });
          return updated;
        });
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      setErrorMessage(err.message || 'KhĂ´ng thá»ƒ táº£i cáº¥u hĂ¬nh tag Quality tá»« mĂ¡y chá»§.');
    } finally {
      setIsLoading(false);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    if (isOpen) {
      fetchCurrentMappings();
      setSaveSuccess(false);
    }
  }, [isOpen]);

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  const handleNodeIdChange = (tagKey: string, value: string) => {
    setTagConfigs((prev) => ({
      ...prev,
      [tagKey]: {
        ...prev[tagKey],
        node_id: value,
      },
    }));
    // Reset test result if user changes the string
    setTestResults((prev) => ({
      ...prev,
      [tagKey]: { testing: false },
    }));
  };

  const handleTestNode = async (tagKey: string) => {
    const targetTag = tagConfigs[tagKey];
    const rawNode = (targetTag?.node_id || '').trim();

    if (!rawNode) {
      setTestResults((prev) => ({
        ...prev,
        [tagKey]: {
          testing: false,
          quality: 'Unmapped',
          message: 'ChÆ°a cáº¥u hĂ¬nh Node ID',
        },
      }));
      return;
    }

    setTestResults((prev) => ({
      ...prev,
      [tagKey]: { testing: true },
    }));

    try {
      const probe = await api.testQualityNode(rawNode);
      setTestResults((prev) => ({
        ...prev,
        [tagKey]: {
          testing: false,
          quality: probe.quality === 'Good' ? 'Good' : (probe.quality === 'Unmapped' ? 'Unmapped' : 'Bad'),
          value: probe.value,
          message: probe.message || (probe.quality === 'Good' ? 'Good' : 'Bad / Not Found'),
        },
      }));
    } catch {
      setTestResults((prev) => ({
        ...prev,
        [tagKey]: {
          testing: false,
          quality: 'Bad',
          message: 'Lá»—i giao tiáº¿p máº¡ng hoáº·c Kepware OPC UA',
        },
      }));
    }
  };

  const handleSaveAll = async () => {
    setIsSaving(true);
    setErrorMessage(null);
    setSaveSuccess(false);

    try {
      const res = await api.updateQualityTagMappings({ tags: tagConfigs });
      if (res && res.status === 'success') {
        setSaveSuccess(true);
        if (onSaved) onSaved();
        setTimeout(() => {
          setSaveSuccess(false);
        }, 3000);
      } else {
        throw new Error(res?.message || 'Lá»—i khi lÆ°u cáº¥u hĂ¬nh tag vĂ o SQL Server');
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      setErrorMessage(err.message || 'Lá»—i lÆ°u cáº¥u hĂ¬nh tag');
    } finally {
      setIsSaving(false);
    }
  };

  const getTagIcon = (key: string) => {
    if (key.includes('ph')) return <Beaker className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-600" />;
    if (key.includes('brix')) return <Scale className="w-4 h-4 text-indigo-600" />;
    return <Flame className="w-4 h-4 text-rose-600" />;
  };

  const renderStatusBadge = (tagKey: string) => {
    const test = testResults[tagKey];
    const config = tagConfigs[tagKey];
    const isNodeEmpty = !(config?.node_id || '').trim();

    if (test?.testing) {
      return (
        <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-2.5 py-1 text-[11px] font-mono font-bold bg-slate-100 text-slate-700 border border-slate-300 rounded-xs">
          <RotateCw className="w-3 h-3 animate-spin text-slate-600" />
          <span>Äang kiá»ƒm tra...</span>
        </span>
      );
    }

    if (test?.quality === 'Good') {
      return (
        <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-2.5 py-1 text-[11px] font-mono font-bold bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-800 border border-emerald-300 rounded-xs">
          <CheckCircle2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-emerald-600" />
          <span>Good</span>
          {test.value !== undefined && test.value !== null && (
            <span className="text-slate-600 font-normal">({test.value} {config.unit})</span>
          )}
        </span>
      );
    }

    if (test?.quality === 'Bad') {
      return (
        <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-2.5 py-1 text-[11px] font-mono font-bold bg-rose-50 text-rose-800 border border-rose-300 rounded-xs">
          <AlertTriangle className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-rose-600" />
          <span>Bad / Not Found</span>
        </span>
      );
    }

    if (test?.quality === 'Unmapped' || isNodeEmpty) {
      return (
        <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-2.5 py-1 text-[11px] font-mono font-semibold bg-slate-100 text-slate-500 border border-slate-300 rounded-xs">
          <Radio className="w-3 h-3 text-slate-400" />
          <span>ChÆ°a cáº¥u hĂ¬nh</span>
        </span>
      );
    }

    // Default resting state for non-tested node with configured string
    return (
      <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-2.5 py-1 text-[11px] font-mono font-semibold bg-slate-50 text-slate-600 border border-slate-300 rounded-xs">
        <Radio className="w-3 h-3 text-slate-400" />
        <span>Sáºµn sĂ ng kiá»ƒm tra</span>
      </span>
    );
  };

  return (
    <div 
      className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4 bg-slate-900/60 backdrop-blur-xs font-mono"
      role="dialog"
      aria-modal="true"

        {/* Modal Header */}
        <div className="px-5 py-3.5 bg-slate-100 border-b border-slate-200 flex items-center justify-between">

              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <h2 id="quality-tag-modal-title" className="text-sm font-bold text-slate-900 uppercase tracking-wide">
                  Cáº¤U HĂŒNH &amp; ĂNH Xáº  TAG KEPWARE OPC UA
                </h2>
