import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { useAuth } from '../context/AuthContext';
import { useReports } from '../context/ReportContext';
import { signAndAuditAction, SignActionResult } from '../services/api';
import { 
  KeyRound, 
  ShieldCheck, 
  CheckCircle2, 
  AlertTriangle, 
  Eye, 
  EyeOff, 
  Loader2, 
  X, 
  ArrowRight, 
  FileSignature,
  FileCheck
} from 'lucide-react';

export interface ESignatureModalProps {
  isOpen: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  onSuccess: (result: SignActionResult) => void;
  actionName: string;
  fieldName?: string;
  oldValue?: string;
  newValue?: string;
  defaultMeaning?: string;
  detail?: string;
  isCorrection?: boolean;
  refLogId?: number;
}

const SIGNATURE_MEANINGS = [
  'Approval',
  'Parameter Override',
  'Recipe Modification',
  'Calibration Correction',
  'Batch Release',
  'Verification',
  'Review',
  'Responsibility'
];

export const ESignatureModal: React.FC<ESignatureModalProps> = ({
  isOpen,
  onClose,
  onSuccess,
  actionName,
  fieldName,
  oldValue,
  newValue,
  defaultMeaning = 'Approval',
  detail,
  isCorrection = false,
  refLogId,
}) => {
  const { user } = useAuth();
  const { refreshAuditLogs } = useReports();

  const activeUsername = user?.username || 'admin';
  const activeRole = user?.role || 'Engineer';

  const [password, setPassword] = useState('');
  const [showPassword, setShowPassword] = useState(false);
  const [signatureMeaning, setSignatureMeaning] = useState(defaultMeaning);
  const [reason, setReason] = useState('');
  const [isSubmitting, setIsSubmitting] = useState(false);
  const [errorMessage, setErrorMessage] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [successResult, setSuccessResult] = useState<SignActionResult | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (isOpen) {
      setPassword('');
      setShowPassword(false);
      setSignatureMeaning(defaultMeaning);
      setReason('');
      setErrorMessage(null);
      setSuccessResult(null);
      setIsSubmitting(false);
    }
  }, [isOpen, defaultMeaning]);

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  const isReasonValid = reason.trim().length >= 5;

  const handleSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setErrorMessage(null);

    if (!password) {
      setErrorMessage('Password is required to verify electronic identity.');
      return;
    }

    if (!isReasonValid) {
      setErrorMessage('Reason for action is required (minimum 5 characters per 21 CFR Â§11.50).');
      return;
    }

    setIsSubmitting(true);

    try {
      const summaryDetail = detail || (
        fieldName 
          ? `Modified ${fieldName} from "${oldValue ?? '---'}" to "${newValue ?? '---'}"`
          : `Executed ${actionName}`
      );

      const result = await signAndAuditAction({
        username: activeUsername,
        password,
        action_name: actionName,
        field_name: fieldName,
        old_value: oldValue,
        new_value: newValue,
        reason: reason.trim(),
        signature_meaning: signatureMeaning,
        detail: summaryDetail,
        is_correction: isCorrection,
        ref_log_id: refLogId,
      });

      if (result.status === 'success') {
        setSuccessResult(result);
        try {
          await refreshAuditLogs();
        } catch (err) {
          console.debug('[ESignatureModal] Auto-refresh audit trail error:', err);
        }
        setTimeout(() => {
          onSuccess(result);
          onClose();
        }, 900);
      } else {
        setErrorMessage(result.message || 'Signature verification rejected.');
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      const msg = err?.message || 'Authentication failed. Please verify credentials.';
      setErrorMessage(msg);
    } finally {
      setIsSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  const hasDelta = (oldValue !== undefined || newValue !== undefined) && (oldValue !== newValue);

  return (
    <div 
      className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4 bg-slate-900/70 backdrop-blur-xs transition-opacity animate-in fade-in duration-150"
      role="dialog"
      aria-modal="true"
      aria-labelledby="esign-modal-title"
    >
      <div className="bg-white border border-slate-300 w-full max-w-xl shadow-2xl overflow-hidden rounded-xs flex flex-col font-sans">
        {/* Header */}
        <div className="px-5 py-3.5 bg-slate-900 text-white flex items-center justify-between border-b border-slate-800">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <FileSignature className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-400 shrink-0" />
            <h2 
              id="esign-modal-title" 
              className="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-white"
              style={{ fontStyle: 'normal' }}
            >
              ELECTRONIC SIGNATURE VERIFICATION (21 CFR PART 11)
            </h2>
          </div>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={onClose}
            disabled={isSubmitting}
            className="text-slate-400 hover:text-white p-1 rounded-xs transition-colors focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-sky-500 focus-visible:outline-offset-2"
            aria-label="Close signature verification dialog"
          >
            <X className="w-4 h-4" />
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* Regulatory Banner */}
        <div className="px-5 py-2 bg-slate-100 border-b border-slate-200 flex items-center justify-between text-[11px] font-mono text-slate-600">
          <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
            <ShieldCheck className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-emerald-600" />
            ALCOA+ DATA INTEGRITY &bull; IMMUTABLE AUDIT TRAIL
          </span>
          <span className="font-semibold text-slate-700">FDA 21 CFR &sect;11.200</span>
        </div>

        {/* Feedback Alert Banners */}
        {errorMessage && (
          <div 
            className="p-3 bg-rose-50 border-b border-rose-200 flex items-start gap-2 text-xs font-semibold text-rose-900"
            role="alert"
          >
            <AlertTriangle className="w-4 h-4 text-rose-600 shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
            <div>
              <div className="font-bold uppercase tracking-wide text-rose-950">Verification Challenge Failed</div>
              <div className="text-[11px] font-normal text-rose-800 mt-0.5">{errorMessage}</div>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}

        {successResult && (
          <div 
            className="p-3 bg-emerald-50 border-b border-emerald-200 flex items-start gap-2 text-xs font-semibold text-emerald-900"
            role="status"
          >
            <CheckCircle2 className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-600 shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
            <div>
              <div className="font-bold uppercase tracking-wide text-emerald-950">Signature Verified &bull; Record Committed</div>
              <div className="text-[11px] font-mono font-normal text-emerald-800 mt-0.5">
                Log ID: #{successResult.log_id} &bull; SHA-256: {successResult.record_hash?.substring(0, 16)}...
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}

        <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="p-5 space-y-4 text-xs">
          {/* Action Context Card */}
          <div className="p-3 bg-slate-50 border border-slate-200 space-y-2">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
              <span className="text-[10px] font-mono uppercase text-slate-500 font-bold">Interception Target</span>
              <span className="px-2 py-0.5 bg-slate-200 text-slate-800 font-mono font-bold text-[10px] uppercase">
                {actionName}
              </span>
            </div>

            {/* Before / After Difference Badge */}
            {hasDelta && (
              <div className="pt-2 border-t border-slate-200">
                <div className="text-[10px] text-slate-500 font-mono uppercase font-semibold mb-1">
                  Field Modification: <span className="text-slate-900 font-bold">{fieldName || 'Parameter'}</span>
                </div>
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2 font-mono text-xs">
                  <div className="flex-1 p-2 bg-rose-50 border border-rose-200 text-rose-900 font-bold rounded-xs text-center">
                    <span className="block text-[9px] uppercase text-rose-600 font-normal">Prior Value</span>
                    {oldValue ?? '---'}
                  </div>
                  <ArrowRight className="w-4 h-4 text-slate-400 shrink-0" />
                  <div className="flex-1 p-2 bg-emerald-50 border border-emerald-200 text-emerald-900 font-bold rounded-xs text-center">
                    <span className="block text-[9px] uppercase text-emerald-600 font-normal">New Target Value</span>
                    {newValue ?? '---'}
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>
            )}

            {detail && !hasDelta && (
              <div className="text-[11px] text-slate-700 font-medium">
                {detail}
              </div>
            )}
          </div>

          {/* User Identity (Read Only) */}
          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-3">
            <div className="space-y-1">
              <label className="block text-[11px] font-bold text-slate-700 uppercase tracking-wide">
                Signer Identity (Current User)
              </label>
              <div className="h-9 px-3 bg-slate-100 border border-slate-300 rounded-xs flex items-center justify-between text-slate-900 font-mono">
                <span className="font-bold">{activeUsername}</span>
                <span className="text-[10px] px-1.5 py-0.5 bg-white border border-slate-200 font-sans text-slate-600 font-medium">
                  {activeRole}
                </span>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Meaning of Signature */}
            <div className="space-y-1">
              <label 
                htmlFor="signature-meaning-select" 
                className="block text-[11px] font-bold text-slate-700 uppercase tracking-wide"
              >
                Meaning of Signature (21 CFR &sect;11.50) *
              </label>
              <select
                id="signature-meaning-select"
                value={signatureMeaning}
                onChange={(e) => setSignatureMeaning(e.target.value)}
                disabled={isSubmitting}
                className="w-full bg-white border border-slate-300 h-9 px-3 text-xs font-mono text-slate-900 rounded-xs focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-sky-600 focus-visible:outline-offset-2 hover:bg-slate-50 transition-none"
              >
                {SIGNATURE_MEANINGS.map((meaning) => (
                  <option key={meaning} value={meaning}>
                    {meaning}
                  </option>
                ))}
              </select>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Re-Authentication Password */}
          <div className="space-y-1">
            <label 
              htmlFor="esign-password-input" 
              className="block text-[11px] font-bold text-slate-700 uppercase tracking-wide flex items-center justify-between"
            >
              <span className="flex items-center gap-1">
                <KeyRound className="w-3 h-3 text-slate-500" />
                Password / Electronic Credential Verification *
              </span>
              <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-500 font-normal">Re-authentication required</span>
            </label>
            <div className="relative">
              <input
                id="esign-password-input"
                type={showPassword ? 'text' : 'password'}
                value={password}
                onChange={(e) => setPassword(e.target.value)}
                disabled={isSubmitting}
                placeholder="Enter your system password..."
                autoComplete="current-password"
                className="w-full h-9 pl-3 pr-10 bg-white border border-slate-300 text-xs font-mono text-slate-900 rounded-xs focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-sky-600 focus-visible:outline-offset-2 hover:border-slate-400 transition-none"
              />
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setShowPassword(!showPassword)}
                tabIndex={-1}
                className="absolute right-2 top-2 text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-700 p-0.5 rounded-xs focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-sky-600"
                aria-label={showPassword ? 'Hide password' : 'Show password'}
              >
                {showPassword ? <EyeOff className="w-4 h-4" /> : <Eye className="w-4 h-4" />}
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Reason for Change / Action */}
          <div className="space-y-1">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
              <label 
                htmlFor="esign-reason-input" 
                className="text-[11px] font-bold text-slate-700 uppercase tracking-wide"
              >
                Reason for Action / Change (Mandatory &ge; 5 Chars) *
              </label>
              <span className={`text-[10px] font-mono ${isReasonValid ? 'text-emerald-700 font-semibold' : 'text-slate-500'}`}>
                {reason.trim().length} / 5 min chars
              </span>
            </div>
            <textarea
              id="esign-reason-input"
              rows={3}
              value={reason}
              onChange={(e) => setReason(e.target.value)}
              disabled={isSubmitting}
              placeholder="State regulatory or engineering rationale (e.g. Setpoint adjustment per SOP-402, authorized by Shift Lead)..."
              className={`w-full p-2.5 bg-white border ${
                reason.length > 0 && !isReasonValid ? 'border-amber-400 bg-amber-50/30' : 'border-slate-300'
              } text-xs font-mono text-slate-900 rounded-xs focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-sky-600 focus-visible:outline-offset-2 hover:border-slate-400 transition-none`}
            />

            {/* Quick Reason Snippets */}
            <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1.5 pt-1">
              {[
                'Standard formulation adjustment per SOP-402',
                'Routine QA release approval after CCP verification',
                'Supervisory batch download to SCADA buffer',
                'Engineering calibration correction',
              ].map((snippet) => (
                <button
                  key={snippet}
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setReason(snippet)}
                  disabled={isSubmitting}
                  className="px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-mono bg-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-200 text-slate-700 border border-slate-300 rounded-xs transition-none active:translate-y-px"
                >
                  + {snippet.substring(0, 32)}...
                </button>
              ))}
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Footer Controls */}
          <div className="pt-3 border-t border-slate-200 flex items-center justify-between gap-3">
            <div className="text-[10px] font-mono text-slate-500 flex items-center gap-1">
              <FileCheck className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-slate-400" />
              <span>Cryptographic SHA-256 signature stamped upon commit</span>
            </div>

            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={onClose}
                disabled={isSubmitting}
                className="h-9 px-4 bg-white border border-slate-300 hover:bg-slate-100 text-slate-700 font-semibold text-xs uppercase tracking-wider rounded-xs focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-sky-600 focus-visible:outline-offset-2 active:translate-y-px transition-none"
              >
                Cancel
              </button>

              <button
                type="submit"
                disabled={isSubmitting || !isReasonValid || !password}
                className={`h-9 px-5 bg-slate-900 hover:bg-slate-800 disabled:opacity-50 disabled:cursor-not-allowed text-white font-semibold text-xs uppercase tracking-wider flex items-center gap-2 rounded-xs border border-slate-900 shadow-xs focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-sky-600 focus-visible:outline-offset-2 active:translate-y-px transition-none ${
                  isSubmitting ? 'opacity-70 cursor-not-allowed' : ''
                }`}
              >
                {isSubmitting ? (
                  <>
                    <Loader2 className="w-4 h-4 animate-spin text-emerald-400" />
                    <span>Verifying Identity...</span>
                  </>
                ) : (
                  <>
                    <ShieldCheck className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-400" />
                    <span>Verify Signature &amp; Commit</span>
                  </>
                )}
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </form>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

/* Hallmark Â· component: ModuleTagMappingModal Â· genre: modern-minimal Â· register: industrial-workbench
 * states: default Â· hover Â· focus Â· active Â· disabled Â· loading Â· error Â· success
 * contrast: WCAG AA Pass

import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { useAuth } from '../context/AuthContext';
import * as api from '../services/api';
import { 
  Settings2, 
  X, 
  Activity, 
  Check, 
  AlertTriangle, 
  CheckCircle2, 
  Save, 
  Lock, 
  ShieldCheck, 
  RefreshCw,
  Radio,
  Sliders
} from 'lucide-react';

export interface ModuleTagMappingModalProps {
  isOpen: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  moduleKey: 'operations' | 'quality' | 'maintenance' | 'oee' | 'inventory';
  moduleTitle: string;
  onSaved?: () => void;
}

export const ModuleTagMappingModal: React.FC<ModuleTagMappingModalProps> = ({
  isOpen,
  onClose,
  moduleKey,
  moduleTitle,
  onSaved,
}) => {
  const { user } = useAuth();
  const isAdmin = (user?.role?.toUpperCase() === 'ADMIN') || (user?.username?.toLowerCase() === 'admin');

  const [tags, setTags] = useState<Record<string, api.ModuleTagItem>>({});
  const [editedTags, setEditedTags] = useState<Record<string, { node_id: string; unit: string; role: string; dataType?: string }>>({});
  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [isSaving, setIsSaving] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [feedback, setFeedback] = useState<{ type: 'success' | 'error' | 'warning'; message: string } | null>(null);

  // Per-node test status
  const [testResults, setTestResults] = useState<Record<string, {
    testing: boolean;
    valid?: boolean;
    value?: any;
    datatype?: string;
    message?: string;
  }>>({});

  const fetchMappings = async () => {
    setIsLoading(true);
    setFeedback(null);
    try {
      const res = await api.getModuleTagMappings(moduleKey);
      if (res && res.tags) {
        setTags(res.tags);
        const edits: Record<string, { node_id: string; unit: string; role: string; dataType?: string }> = {};
        Object.entries(res.tags).forEach(([k, v]) => {
          edits[k] = {
            node_id: v.node_id,
            unit: v.unit,
            role: v.role,
            dataType: v.dataType,
          };
        });
        setEditedTags(edits);
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      setFeedback({
        type: 'error',
        message: err.message || `KhĂ´ng thá»ƒ táº£i cáº¥u hĂ¬nh tag cho module ${moduleKey}.`
      });
    } finally {
      setIsLoading(false);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    if (isOpen) {
      fetchMappings();
      setTestResults({});
    }
  }, [isOpen, moduleKey]);

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  const handleFieldChange = (tagKey: string, field: 'node_id' | 'unit' | 'role', val: string) => {
    setEditedTags((prev) => ({
      ...prev,
      [tagKey]: {
        ...prev[tagKey],
        [field]: val,
      },
    }));
  };

  const handleTestNode = async (tagKey: string, nodeId: string) => {
    if (!nodeId.trim()) {
      setTestResults((prev) => ({
        ...prev,
        [tagKey]: { testing: false, valid: false, message: 'Node ID rá»—ng' }
      }));
      return;
    }

    setTestResults((prev) => ({
      ...prev,
      [tagKey]: { testing: true }
    }));

    try {
      const res = await api.testOpcNodeConnectivity(nodeId.trim());
      setTestResults((prev) => ({
        ...prev,
        [tagKey]: {
          testing: false,
          valid: res.valid,
          value: res.value,
          datatype: res.datatype,
          message: res.message || (res.valid ? `GiĂ¡ trá»‹: ${res.value}` : 'KhĂ´ng pháº£n há»“i')
        }
      }));
    } catch (err: any) {
      setTestResults((prev) => ({
        ...prev,
        [tagKey]: {
          testing: false,
          valid: false,
          message: err.message || 'Lá»—i kiá»ƒm tra node'
        }
      }));
    }
  };

  const handleSave = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!isAdmin) {
      setFeedback({
        type: 'error',
        message: 'Chá»‰ Quáº£n trá»‹ viĂªn (Admin) má»›i cĂ³ quyá»n chá»‰nh sá»­a cáº¥u hĂ¬nh Tag! (FDA 21 CFR Part 11)'
      });
      return;
    }

    setIsSaving(true);
    setFeedback(null);
    try {
      const res = await api.updateModuleTagMappings(
        moduleKey,
        editedTags,
        user?.username || 'admin',
        user?.role || 'Admin'
      );

      setFeedback({
        type: 'success',
        message: res.message || `ÄĂ£ cáº­p nháº­t cáº¥u hĂ¬nh tag cho module [${moduleTitle}] thĂ nh cĂ´ng vĂ  kĂ­ch hoáº¡t hot-reload!`
      });

      // Refetch live readouts
      await fetchMappings();
      if (onSaved) onSaved();
    } catch (err: any) {
      setFeedback({
        type: 'error',
        message: err.message || 'Lá»—i cáº­p nháº­t cáº¥u hĂ¬nh tag.'
      });
    } finally {
      setIsSaving(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 bg-slate-900/60 backdrop-blur-xs flex items-center justify-center z-50 p-4">
      <div className="bg-white border border-slate-300 shadow-2xl w-full max-w-5xl rounded-xs overflow-hidden flex flex-col max-h-[90vh] animate-in fade-in zoom-in-95 font-mono text-xs">
        {/* Header */}
        <div className="px-5 py-3.5 bg-slate-100 border-b border-slate-200 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3 shrink-0">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
            <Settings2 className="w-4 h-4 text-slate-800" />
            <div>
              <h3 className="font-bold text-slate-900 uppercase tracking-wide not-italic text-xs">
                Cáº¥u hĂ¬nh & Ănh xáº¡ Tag Kepware OPC UA â€” {moduleTitle}
              </h3>
              <p className="text-[10px] text-slate-500 font-normal">
                ISA-88 / ISA-95 Equipment Interface Â· Direct Node Mapping, Hot-Reloading & FDA 21 CFR Part 11 Audit
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            {/* Clearance Indicator Badge */}
            <span
              className={`px-2.5 py-1 text-[10px] font-bold border rounded-xs flex items-center gap-1.5 shadow-xs ${
                isAdmin
                  ? 'bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-800 border-emerald-300'
                  : 'bg-slate-100 text-slate-600 border-slate-300'
              }`}
            >
              {isAdmin ? (
                <>
                  <ShieldCheck className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-emerald-600" />
                  <span>QUYá»€N Háº N: ADMIN (TOĂ€N QUYá»€N)</span>
                </>
              ) : (
                <>
                  <Lock className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-slate-500" />
                  <span>QUYá»€N Háº N: OPERATOR (CHá»ˆ Äá»ŒC)</span>
                </>
              )}
            </span>

            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={onClose}
              className="text-slate-500 hover:text-slate-900 font-bold px-1.5 py-0.5 text-sm"
            >
              <X className="w-4 h-4" />
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Feedback Banner */}
        {feedback && (
          <div
            className={`px-4 py-2.5 border-b flex items-center justify-between text-xs shrink-0 ${
              feedback.type === 'success'
                ? 'bg-emerald-50 border-emerald-300 text-emerald-900'
                : feedback.type === 'error'
                ? 'bg-rose-50 border-rose-300 text-rose-900'
                : 'bg-amber-50 border-amber-300 text-amber-900'
            }`}
          >
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              {feedback.type === 'success' ? (
                <CheckCircle2 className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-700 shrink-0" />
              ) : (
                <AlertTriangle className="w-4 h-4 text-rose-700 shrink-0" />
              )}
              <span className="font-semibold">{feedback.message}</span>

            <button
              onClick={() => setFeedback(null)}
              className="text-slate-500 hover:text-slate-900 font-bold px-1"
            >
              âœ•
            </button>

                <th className="py-2.5 px-3 border-r border-slate-200 text-right w-28">Live PV</th>
                <th className="py-2.5 px-3 border-r border-slate-200 text-center w-24">Cháº¥t lÆ°á»£ng</th>
                <th className="py-2.5 px-3 text-center w-28">HĂ nh Ä‘á»™ng</th>
              </tr>

                      <span>Äang táº£i thĂ´ng sá»‘ Ă¡nh xáº¡ tag tá»« Gateway...</span>
                    </div>
                  </td>

                  </td>

              ) : (

                  const editData = editedTags[tagKey] || { node_id: tagMeta.node_id, unit: tagMeta.unit, role: tagMeta.role };
                  const testRes = testResults[tagKey];
                  const quality = tagMeta.quality || 'Good';

                  return (
                    <tr key={tagKey} className="hover:bg-slate-50/70 transition-colors">
                      {/* Tag Key */}
                      <td className="py-2.5 px-3 border-r border-slate-200 font-bold text-slate-900 align-top">

                            onChange={(e) => handleFieldChange(tagKey, 'role', e.target.value)}
                            className="w-full bg-white border border-slate-300 h-8 px-2 text-[11px] font-mono rounded-xs hallmark-focus"
                          />
                        ) : (
                          <div className="font-medium text-slate-800">{tagMeta.role}</div>
                        )}
                        <div className="text-[10px] text-slate-400 mt-0.5 truncate max-w-[180px]" title={tagMeta.description}>
                          {tagMeta.description}
                        </div>
                      </td>

                      {/* OPC Node ID */}
                      <td className="py-2.5 px-3 border-r border-slate-200 align-top">
                        {isAdmin ? (
                          <input
                            type="text"
                            value={editData.node_id}
                            onChange={(e) => handleFieldChange(tagKey, 'node_id', e.target.value)}
                            placeholder="ns=2;s=..."
                            className="w-full bg-white border border-slate-300 h-8 px-2 text-[11px] font-mono rounded-xs hallmark-focus"

                        ) : (
                          <code className="text-slate-800 text-[11px] bg-slate-100 px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded-xs block truncate" title={tagMeta.node_id}>
                            {tagMeta.node_id}
                          </code>
                        )}

                        {/* Inline Test Result Feedback */}
                        {testRes && !testRes.testing && (
                          <div className={`mt-1 text-[10px] font-mono flex items-center gap-1 ${
                            testRes.valid ? 'text-emerald-700' : 'text-rose-700'
                          }`}>
                            {testRes.valid ? <Check className="w-3 h-3 shrink-0" /> : <AlertTriangle className="w-3 h-3 shrink-0" />}
                            <span className="truncate">{testRes.message}</span>
                          </div>
                        )}
                      </td>

                      {/* Unit */}
                      <td className="py-2.5 px-3 border-r border-slate-200 text-center align-top">
                        {isAdmin ? (
                          <input
                            type="text"
                            value={editData.unit}
                            onChange={(e) => handleFieldChange(tagKey, 'unit', e.target.value)}
                            className="w-16 mx-auto bg-white border border-slate-300 h-8 px-1 text-center text-[11px] font-mono rounded-xs hallmark-focus"
                          />
                        ) : (
                          <span className="font-bold text-slate-700">{tagMeta.unit}</span>
                        )}
                      </td>

                      {/* Live PV Readout */}
                      <td className="py-2.5 px-3 border-r border-slate-200 text-right align-top font-bold text-slate-900">
                        <div className="flex items-center justify-end gap-1">
                          <Radio className="w-2.5 h-2.5 text-emerald-600 animate-pulse" />
                          <span>
                            {tagMeta.value !== undefined 
                              ? typeof tagMeta.value === 'number'

import React, { useState, useMemo } from 'react';

interface OeeShiftDashboardProps {
  className?: string;
  defaultCollapsed?: boolean;
  oeeSummary?: UseOeeSummaryReturn | OeeSummaryData | null;
}

export const OeeShiftDashboard: React.FC<OeeShiftDashboardProps> = ({ 
  className = '', 
  defaultCollapsed = false,
  oeeSummary: externalOeeSummary
}) => {
  const [isCollapsed, setIsCollapsed] = useState<boolean>(defaultCollapsed);
  const { runningOrders, finishedOrders } = useOperations();

  // Internal OEE Poller hook fallback (2.5-second polling interval, shared with OEEDashboard)
  const hookData = useOeeSummary({ pollIntervalMs: 2500, enabled: !externalOeeSummary });

  // Merge external prop or hook data as the Single Source of Truth
  const activeOee = externalOeeSummary || hookData;

  // Extract metrics from shared OEE engine (Zeroed defaults when in cold standby / unmapped tags)
  const overallOee = Number(
    (activeOee as any)?.overallOee ?? 
    (activeOee as any)?.overall_oee ?? 
    (activeOee as any)?.oee ?? 
    (activeOee as any)?.line_oee ?? 
    0.0
  );

  const availability = Number(
    (activeOee as any)?.availability ?? 
    0.0
  );

  const performance = Number(
    (activeOee as any)?.performance ?? 
    0.0
  );

  const quality = Number(
    (activeOee as any)?.qualityRate ?? 
    (activeOee as any)?.quality_rate ?? 
    (activeOee as any)?.quality ?? 
    0.0
  );

  const shiftOutputVolume = Number(
    (activeOee as any)?.shiftOutputVolume ?? 
    (activeOee as any)?.shift_output_volume ?? 
    (activeOee as any)?.shift_output_liters ?? 
    0.0
  );

  const shiftTargetVolume = Number(
    (activeOee as any)?.shiftTargetVolume ?? 
    (activeOee as any)?.shift_target_volume ?? 
    5000.0
  );

  const downtimeMinutes = Number(
    (activeOee as any)?.downtimeMinutes ?? 
    (activeOee as any)?.downtime_minutes ?? 
    0.0
  );

  const plannedShiftMinutes = 480; // 8-hour shift standard (ISA-95)

  const shiftName = (activeOee as any)?.shiftName || (activeOee as any)?.shift_name || 'SHIFT 1 (MORNING)';
  const shiftWindow = (activeOee as any)?.shiftWindow || (activeOee as any)?.shift_window || '06:00 â€” 14:00';
  const shiftLeader = (activeOee as any)?.shiftLeader || (activeOee as any)?.shift_leader || 'Tráº§n Äá»©c (Lead Process Architect)';

  const isStandby = overallOee === 0.0 || Boolean((activeOee as any)?.isStandby || (activeOee as any)?.is_standby);

  // Dynamic calculation of shift output:
  // Reflects backend OEE engine output volume + live execution volume from finished orders
  const currentShiftOutput = useMemo(() => {
    const completedVol = finishedOrders.reduce((sum, o) => sum + (o.volume || 0), 0);
    const runningVol = runningOrders.reduce((sum, o) => sum + ((o.volume || 0) * 0.5), 0);
    const liveExecVol = Math.round(completedVol + runningVol);
    return Math.max(shiftOutputVolume, liveExecVol);
  }, [shiftOutputVolume, finishedOrders, runningOrders]);

  // Dynamic active batches count based on active orders in execution
  const activeBatchesCount = useMemo(() => {
    const rawBatches = Number((activeOee as any)?.activeBatches ?? (activeOee as any)?.active_batches ?? 0);
    return Math.max(runningOrders.length, rawBatches);
  }, [runningOrders, activeOee]);

  const completedBatchesCount = finishedOrders.length;

  const oeeGrade = useMemo(() => {
    if (isStandby || overallOee === 0.0) {
      return { 
        label: 'COLD STANDBY', 
        color: 'text-slate-700 bg-slate-100 border-slate-300' 
      };
    }
    if (overallOee >= 85.0) return { label: 'WORLD CLASS A', color: 'text-emerald-700 bg-emerald-50 border-emerald-300' };
    if (overallOee >= 75.0) return { label: 'WORLD CLASS B+', color: 'text-sky-800 bg-sky-50 border-sky-300' };
    if (overallOee >= 65.0) return { label: 'NORMAL OPERATION C', color: 'text-amber-800 bg-amber-50 border-amber-300' };
    return { label: 'ATTENTION REQUIRED D', color: 'text-rose-800 bg-rose-50 border-rose-300' };
  }, [overallOee, isStandby]);

          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <Gauge className="w-4 h-4 text-slate-800 shrink-0" />
            <span className="font-bold text-slate-900 text-xs uppercase tracking-wider not-italic">
              Real-Time OEE &amp; Shift Management
            </span>
          </div>

          <span className="text-slate-300 hidden sm:inline">|</span>

          {/* Current Shift Detector Badge */}

            GRADE: {oeeGrade.label} ({overallOee.toFixed(1)}%)
          </span>

/* Hallmark Â· context: AuthContext Â· genre: modern-minimal Â· register: industrial-workbench
 * standards: ISA-95 Level 3 MOM Â· Security Clearance & Role Matrix
 * contrast: WCAG AA Pass
 */

import React, { createContext, useContext, useState } from 'react';
import { User, UserRole, AuthContextType } from '../types/auth';

const AuthContext = createContext<AuthContextType | undefined>(undefined);

export const AuthProvider: React.FC<{ children: React.ReactNode }> = ({ children }) => {
  // Always default to null on app launch: Bypassing login on startup is strictly prohibited
  const [user, setUser] = useState<User | null>(null);

  const login = async (username: string, role: UserRole, customName?: string): Promise<boolean> => {
    // Simulate industrial auth token handshake delay
    await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 300));

    const trimmedUser = username.trim().toLowerCase();

    // Standardized Employee ID & Display Name mapping
    let empId = 'EMP-6583';
    let displayName = customName;

    if (trimmedUser === 'admin') {
      empId = 'EMP-6583';
      displayName = displayName || 'System Administrator';
    } else if (trimmedUser === 'eng_tranduc' || trimmedUser === 'engineer_lead' || trimmedUser.includes('engineer')) {
      empId = 'EMP-3042';
      displayName = displayName || 'Tráº§n Äá»©c (Lead Process Architect)';
    } else if (trimmedUser === 'qa_supervisor_01' || trimmedUser === 'supervisor_01' || trimmedUser.includes('supervisor')) {
      empId = 'EMP-2088';
      displayName = displayName || 'QA Lead Inspector';
    } else if (trimmedUser === 'operator_01' || trimmedUser.includes('operator')) {
      empId = 'EMP-1024';
      displayName = displayName || 'Shift 1 Line Operator';
    } else {
      switch (role) {
        case 'Admin':
          empId = 'EMP-6583';
          displayName = displayName || 'System Administrator';
          break;
        case 'Engineer':
          empId = 'EMP-3042';
          displayName = displayName || 'Controls & Automation Engineer';
          break;
        case 'Supervisor':
          empId = 'EMP-2088';
          displayName = displayName || 'Shift Production Supervisor';
          break;
        case 'Operator':
          empId = 'EMP-1024';
          displayName = displayName || 'Line 01 Lead Operator';
          break;
      }
    }

    const newUser: User = {
      username: username.trim(),
      name: displayName || 'Authenticated Operator',
      role,
      employeeId: empId,
      lastLogin: new Date().toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit', second: '2-digit' }),
    };

    try {
      localStorage.setItem('mes_auth_session', JSON.stringify(newUser));
    } catch {}

    setUser(newUser);
    return true;
  };

  const logout = () => {
    setUser(null);
    try {
      localStorage.removeItem('mes_auth_session');
      sessionStorage.clear();
    } catch {
      // ignore
    }
  };

  return (
    <AuthContext.Provider
      value={{
        user,
        currentUser: user,
        isAuthenticated: !!user,
        login,
        logout,
      }}
    >
      {children}
    </AuthContext.Provider>
  );
};

export const useAuth = (): AuthContextType => {
  const context = useContext(AuthContext);
  if (!context) {
    throw new Error('useAuth must be used within an AuthProvider');
  }
  return context;
};

import { SiemensPlcConfig, SqlServerConfig, ConfigContextType } from '../types/config';
import { checkDbStatus, testDbConnection, getGatewayStatus, GatewayStatusResponse } from '../services/api';

const ConfigContext = createContext<ConfigContextType | undefined>(undefined);

const PLC1_STORAGE_KEY = 'mes_plc1_config_v2';
const PLC2_STORAGE_KEY = 'mes_plc2_config_v2';
const SQL_STORAGE_KEY = 'mes_sql_config_v2';

const defaultPlc1Config: SiemensPlcConfig = {
  id: 'plc1',
  name: 'SIMATIC S7-1500 (PLC 1)',
  unitLabel: 'Unit 1 / Simulation',
  roleDescription: 'Simulation & Digital Twin Mixing Line Controller',
  ipAddress: '192.168.0.1',
  port: 102,
  rack: 0,
  slot: 1,
  connectionState: 'disconnected',
  latencyMs: undefined,
};

const defaultPlc2Config: SiemensPlcConfig = {
  id: 'plc2',
  name: 'SIMATIC S7-1500 (PLC 2)',
  unitLabel: 'Unit 2 / Hardware Physical',
  roleDescription: 'Production Plant Physical Sterilize & Transfer Controller',
  ipAddress: '192.168.0.23',
  port: 102,
  rack: 0,
  slot: 1,
  connectionState: 'disconnected',
  latencyMs: undefined,
};

const defaultSqlConfig: SqlServerConfig = {
  serverName: 'localhost\\WINCC',
  databaseName: 'MES_Milk_Production',
  authMode: 'windows',
  username: '',
  password: '',
  port: 1433,
  connectionState: 'disconnected',
  version: 'SQL SERVER 2022',
};

const CONNECTION_ERROR_ALERT = 
  "Connection Failed: Host unreachable. Please check physical Ethernet cable, IP subnet (192.168.0.x), or start backend service.";

async function verifyHostLink(endpoint: string, payload: unknown): Promise<{ ok: boolean; latencyMs?: number }> {
  const startTime = Date.now();
  const controller = new AbortController();
  const timeoutMs = 2000;
  const timer = setTimeout(() => controller.abort(), timeoutMs);

  let success = false;
  let latency = 10;

  try {
    const res = await fetch(endpoint, {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify(payload),
      signal: controller.signal,
    });
    clearTimeout(timer);
    if (res.ok) {
      const data = await res.json().catch(() => ({}));
      success = true;
      latency = data.latencyMs || 10;
    }
  } catch {
    // Network error, connection refused or timeout aborted
  }

  // Ensure user sees the 2-second timeout attempt if connection failed
  const elapsed = Date.now() - startTime;
  if (!success && elapsed < timeoutMs) {
    await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, timeoutMs - elapsed));
  }

  return { ok: success, latencyMs: latency };
}

export const ConfigProvider: React.FC<{ children: React.ReactNode }> = ({ children }) => {
  const [plc1Config, setPlc1Config] = useState<SiemensPlcConfig>(() => {
    try {
      const saved = localStorage.getItem(PLC1_STORAGE_KEY);
      if (saved) {
        const parsed = JSON.parse(saved);
        return {
          ...parsed,
          connectionState: 'disconnected',
          latencyMs: undefined,
          errorMessage: undefined,
        };
      }
    } catch {
      // ignore
    }
    return defaultPlc1Config;
  });

  const [plc2Config, setPlc2Config] = useState<SiemensPlcConfig>(() => {
    try {
      const saved = localStorage.getItem(PLC2_STORAGE_KEY);
      if (saved) {
        const parsed = JSON.parse(saved);
        return {
          ...parsed,
          connectionState: 'disconnected',
          latencyMs: undefined,
          errorMessage: undefined,
        };
      }
    } catch {
      // ignore
    }
    return defaultPlc2Config;
  });

  const [sqlConfig, setSqlConfig] = useState<SqlServerConfig>(() => {
    try {
      const saved = localStorage.getItem(SQL_STORAGE_KEY);
      if (saved) {
        const parsed = JSON.parse(saved);
        const isLegacyDummy = !parsed.serverName || parsed.serverName.includes('MES-SRV-SQL01') || parsed.databaseName === 'MES_ISA95_DB';
        return {
          ...parsed,
          serverName: isLegacyDummy ? 'localhost\\WINCC' : parsed.serverName,
          databaseName: isLegacyDummy ? 'MES_Milk_Production' : parsed.databaseName,
          authMode: parsed.authMode || 'windows',
          version: parsed.version || 'SQL SERVER 2022',
          connectionState: 'disconnected',
          errorMessage: undefined,
        };
      }
    } catch {
      // ignore
    }
    return defaultSqlConfig;
  });

  const [isSavingSql, setIsSavingSql] = useState<boolean>(false);

  // Sync with Global Header Live Telemetry: continuous 5s background poll of /api/db/status
  useEffect(() => {
    let isMounted = true;
    const syncLiveDbStatus = async () => {
      try {
        const res = await checkDbStatus();
        if (!isMounted) return;
        if (res.connected) {
          setSqlConfig((prev) => {
            if (prev.connectionState === 'connecting') return prev;
            return {
              ...prev,
              connectionState: 'connected',
              version: 'SQL SERVER 2022',
              errorMessage: undefined,
            };
          });
        } else {
          setSqlConfig((prev) => {
            if (prev.connectionState === 'connecting') return prev;
            return {
              ...prev,
              connectionState: 'disconnected',
            };
          });
        }
      } catch {
        if (!isMounted) return;
        setSqlConfig((prev) => {
          if (prev.connectionState === 'connecting') return prev;
          return {
            ...prev,
            connectionState: 'disconnected',
          };
        });
      }
    };

    syncLiveDbStatus();
    const interval = setInterval(syncLiveDbStatus, 5000);
    return () => {
      isMounted = false;
      clearInterval(interval);
    };
  }, []);

  // Centralized OPC UA Gateway Connection Status State (Shared Application-Wide)
  const [gatewayStatus, setGatewayStatus] = useState<GatewayStatusResponse | null>(null);

  const refreshGatewayStatus = useCallback(async (): Promise<GatewayStatusResponse | null> => {
    try {
      const data = await getGatewayStatus();
      setGatewayStatus(data);
      if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
        window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('mes:gateway-status-changed', { detail: data }));
      }
      return data;
    } catch {
      const fallback: GatewayStatusResponse = {
        status: 'OFFLINE',
        is_connected: false,
        connected: false,
        server_connected: false,
        endpoint: 'opc.tcp://127.0.0.1:49320',
        latency_ms: 0,
        active_tags: 0,
      };
      setGatewayStatus(fallback);
      if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
        window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('mes:gateway-status-changed', { detail: fallback }));
      }
      return fallback;
    }
  }, []);

  // Sync with Centralized Gateway: continuous 3s background poll of /api/gateway/status
  useEffect(() => {
    let isMounted = true;
    const syncGateway = async () => {
      try {
        const data = await getGatewayStatus();
        if (!isMounted) return;
        setGatewayStatus(data);
      } catch {
        if (!isMounted) return;
        setGatewayStatus({
          status: 'OFFLINE',
          is_connected: false,
          connected: false,
          server_connected: false,
          endpoint: 'opc.tcp://127.0.0.1:49320',
          latency_ms: 0,
          active_tags: 0,
        });
      }
    };

    syncGateway();
    const interval = setInterval(syncGateway, 3000);

    const handleCustomStatusChanged = (e: any) => {
      if (!isMounted) return;
      if (e?.detail) {
        setGatewayStatus(e.detail);
      } else {
        syncGateway();
      }
    };

    if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
      window.addEventListener('mes:gateway-status-changed', handleCustomStatusChanged);
      window.addEventListener('mes:gateway-status-refresh-needed', syncGateway);
    }

    return () => {
      isMounted = false;
      clearInterval(interval);
      if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
        window.removeEventListener('mes:gateway-status-changed', handleCustomStatusChanged);
        window.removeEventListener('mes:gateway-status-refresh-needed', syncGateway);
      }
    };
  }, []);

  const isGatewayOnline = Boolean(
    gatewayStatus?.is_connected ||
    gatewayStatus?.connected ||
    gatewayStatus?.status === 'ONLINE'
  );

  useEffect(() => {
    localStorage.setItem(PLC1_STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(plc1Config));
  }, [plc1Config]);

  useEffect(() => {
    localStorage.setItem(PLC2_STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(plc2Config));
  }, [plc2Config]);

  useEffect(() => {
    localStorage.setItem(SQL_STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(sqlConfig));
  }, [sqlConfig]);

  const updatePlc1Config = (fields: Partial<SiemensPlcConfig>) => {
    setPlc1Config((prev) => ({
      ...prev,
      ...fields,
      // If IP or Port changes, reset connection and error
      connectionState: (fields.ipAddress && fields.ipAddress !== prev.ipAddress) || (fields.port && fields.port !== prev.port)
        ? 'disconnected'
        : prev.connectionState,
      errorMessage: undefined,
    }));
  };

  const updatePlc2Config = (fields: Partial<SiemensPlcConfig>) => {
    setPlc2Config((prev) => ({
      ...prev,
      ...fields,
      connectionState: (fields.ipAddress && fields.ipAddress !== prev.ipAddress) || (fields.port && fields.port !== prev.port)
        ? 'disconnected'
        : prev.connectionState,
      errorMessage: undefined,
    }));
  };

  const togglePlc1Connection = async () => {
    if (plc1Config.connectionState === 'connected') {
      setPlc1Config((prev) => ({
        ...prev,
        connectionState: 'disconnected',
        latencyMs: undefined,
        errorMessage: undefined,
      }));
      return;
    }

    setPlc1Config((prev) => ({
      ...prev,
      connectionState: 'connecting',
      errorMessage: undefined,
    }));

    const result = await verifyHostLink('http://localhost:8000/api/plc/ping', {
      plcId: 'plc1',
      ipAddress: plc1Config.ipAddress,
      port: plc1Config.port,
      rack: plc1Config.rack,
      slot: plc1Config.slot,
    });

    if (result.ok) {
      setPlc1Config((prev) => ({
        ...prev,
        connectionState: 'connected',
        lastConnectedAt: new Date().toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit', second: '2-digit' }),
        latencyMs: result.latencyMs,
        errorMessage: undefined,
      }));
    } else {
      setPlc1Config((prev) => ({
        ...prev,
        connectionState: 'disconnected',
        errorMessage: CONNECTION_ERROR_ALERT,
        latencyMs: undefined,
      }));
    }
  };

  const togglePlc2Connection = async () => {
    if (plc2Config.connectionState === 'connected') {
      setPlc2Config((prev) => ({
        ...prev,
        connectionState: 'disconnected',
        latencyMs: undefined,
        errorMessage: undefined,
      }));
      return;
    }

    setPlc2Config((prev) => ({
      ...prev,
      connectionState: 'connecting',
      errorMessage: undefined,
    }));

    const result = await verifyHostLink('http://localhost:8000/api/plc/ping', {
      plcId: 'plc2',
      ipAddress: plc2Config.ipAddress,
      port: plc2Config.port,
      rack: plc2Config.rack,
      slot: plc2Config.slot,
    });

    if (result.ok) {
      setPlc2Config((prev) => ({
        ...prev,
        connectionState: 'connected',
        lastConnectedAt: new Date().toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit', second: '2-digit' }),
        latencyMs: result.latencyMs,
        errorMessage: undefined,
      }));
    } else {
      setPlc2Config((prev) => ({
        ...prev,
        connectionState: 'disconnected',
        errorMessage: CONNECTION_ERROR_ALERT,
        latencyMs: undefined,
      }));
    }
  };

  const updateSqlConfig = (fields: Partial<SqlServerConfig>) => {
    setSqlConfig((prev) => ({
      ...prev,
      ...fields,
      errorMessage: undefined,
    }));
  };

  const testSqlConnection = async (): Promise<boolean> => {
    setIsSavingSql(true);
    setSqlConfig((prev) => ({
      ...prev,
      connectionState: 'connecting',
      errorMessage: undefined,
    }));

    try {
      const res = await testDbConnection({
        server_name: sqlConfig.serverName,
        database_name: sqlConfig.databaseName,
        auth_mode: sqlConfig.authMode || 'windows',
        username: sqlConfig.username,
        password: sqlConfig.password,
        port: sqlConfig.port,
      });

      if (res.connected || res.ok) {
        const timeNow = new Date().toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit', second: '2-digit' });
        setSqlConfig((prev) => ({
          ...prev,
          connectionState: 'connected',
          version: res.version || 'SQL SERVER 2022',
          lastVerifiedAt: timeNow,
          errorMessage: undefined,
        }));
        setIsSavingSql(false);
        return true;
      } else {
        setSqlConfig((prev) => ({
          ...prev,
          connectionState: 'disconnected',
          errorMessage: res.error || CONNECTION_ERROR_ALERT,
        }));
        setIsSavingSql(false);
        return false;
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      setSqlConfig((prev) => ({
        ...prev,
        connectionState: 'disconnected',
        errorMessage: err.message || CONNECTION_ERROR_ALERT,
      }));
      setIsSavingSql(false);
      return false;
    }
  };

  const saveSqlConfig = async (): Promise<boolean> => {
    const timeNow = new Date().toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit', second: '2-digit' });
    setSqlConfig((prev) => ({
      ...prev,
      lastSavedAt: timeNow,
    }));
    try {
      localStorage.setItem(SQL_STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify({
        ...sqlConfig,
        lastSavedAt: timeNow,
      }));
    } catch {
      // ignore
    }
    return true;
  };

  return (
    <ConfigContext.Provider
      value={{
        plc1Config,
        plc2Config,
        sqlConfig,
        updatePlc1Config,
        updatePlc2Config,
        togglePlc1Connection,
        togglePlc2Connection,
        updateSqlConfig,
        saveSqlConfig,
        testSqlConnection,
        isSavingSql,
        gatewayStatus,
        isGatewayOnline,
        refreshGatewayStatus,
        setGatewayStatus,
      }}
    >
      {children}
    </ConfigContext.Provider>
  );
};

export const useConfig = (): ConfigContextType => {
  const context = useContext(ConfigContext);
  if (!context) {
    throw new Error('useConfig must be used within a ConfigProvider');
  }
  return context;
};

export const useGatewayStatus = () => {
  const { gatewayStatus: statusData, refreshGatewayStatus, setGatewayStatus } = useConfig();
  const isOnline = Boolean(statusData?.is_connected || statusData?.connected || statusData?.status === "ONLINE");
  return {
    statusData,
    gatewayStatus: statusData,
    isOnline,
    isGatewayOnline: isOnline,
    latencyMs: statusData?.latency_ms ?? 0,
    endpoint: statusData?.endpoint ?? 'opc.tcp://127.0.0.1:49320',
    refreshGatewayStatus,
    setGatewayStatus,
  };
};

import React, { createContext, useContext, useState, useEffect, useCallback } from 'react';
import { Equipment, MaintenanceLog, StateTransitionEvent, OperatingStatus, ServiceActionType, EquipmentType, EquipmentLocation } from '../types/equipment';
import { 
  getEquipment, 
  getEquipmentMaintenance, 
  createMaintenanceRecord, 
  updateEquipmentStatus, 
  getEquipmentStatusHistory,
  getEquipmentPerformance
} from '../services/api';
import { useConfig } from './ConfigContext';

const useSafeConfig = () => {
  try {
    return useConfig();
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
};

interface EquipmentContextType {
  equipmentList: Equipment[];
  maintenanceLogs: MaintenanceLog[];
  transitionEvents: StateTransitionEvent[];
  selectedEquipmentId: string | null;
  selectEquipment: (id: string | null) => void;
  registerEquipment: (eq: Omit<Equipment, 'lastStateUpdate'>) => void;
  updateEquipment: (id: string, updated: Partial<Equipment>) => void;
  deleteEquipment: (id: string) => void;
  recordMaintenanceEvent: (log: Omit<MaintenanceLog, 'id'>) => { success: boolean; message: string };
  exportMaintenanceLogsToCsv: () => void;
  isEquipmentInterlocked: (eq: Equipment) => boolean;
  refreshData: () => Promise<void>;
  isLoading: boolean;
}

const EquipmentContext = createContext<EquipmentContextType | undefined>(undefined);

export const EquipmentProvider: React.FC<{ children: React.ReactNode }> = ({ children }) => {
  const [equipmentList, setEquipmentList] = useState<Equipment[]>([]);
  const [maintenanceLogs, setMaintenanceLogs] = useState<MaintenanceLog[]>([]);
  const [transitionEvents, setTransitionEvents] = useState<StateTransitionEvent[]>([]);
  const [selectedEquipmentId, setSelectedEquipmentId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState<boolean>(true);

  // Helper: Determine if an equipment asset is interlocked
  const isEquipmentInterlocked = useCallback((eq: Equipment): boolean => {
    return (
      eq.status === 'FAULT' ||
      eq.status === 'MAINTENANCE' ||
      eq.runtimeHours >= eq.maintenanceLimit ||
      eq.isInterlocked === true
    );
  }, []);

  const selectEquipment = (id: string | null) => {
    setSelectedEquipmentId(id);
  };

  // Synchronize data from live SQL Server endpoints and centralized Kepware telemetry
  const refreshData = useCallback(async () => {
    try {
      const [eqs, mLogs, trans, perfRes] = await Promise.all([
        getEquipment(),
        getEquipmentMaintenance(),
        getEquipmentStatusHistory(),
        getEquipmentPerformance().catch(() => ({ data: [] })),
      ]);

      const perfList = perfRes?.data || (Array.isArray(perfRes) ? perfRes : []);
      const perfMap: Record<string, any> = {};
      perfList.forEach((p: any) => {
        const code = String(p.equipment_code || p.EquipmentCode || '').toUpperCase();
        if (code) perfMap[code] = p;
      });

      const mappedEquipment: Equipment[] = (eqs || []).map((r: any) => {
        const rawStatus = (r.CurrentStatus || 'STOP').toUpperCase();

            ? 'RUNNING'

            : rawStatus === 'MAINTENANCE'

            : 'STOPPED';

        const perf = perfMap[eqCodeUpper] || {};

          id: r.EquipmentCode,
          equipmentId: r.EquipmentID,

          location: (r.Location as EquipmentLocation) || 'Line 1 - Mixing Unit',
          plcTag: r.OpcNodeId || r.plcTag || '',
          opcNodeId: r.OpcNodeId || r.opcNodeId || '',
          status: mappedStatus,
          runtimeHours: Number((r.Runtime_Hours || 0).toFixed(1)),
          maintenanceLimit: r.Maintenance_Limit_Hours || 500,
          maintenanceCount: r.Maintenance_Count || 0,
          totalStarts: r.TotalStarts || 0,
          lastMaintenanceDate: r.Last_Maintenance_Date,
          nextMaintenanceDue: r.Next_Maintenance_Due,
          healthRatio: perf.health_index ?? (r.Runtime_Hours === 0 ? 100 : 100),
          usagePercent: r.Usage_Percent ?? 0,
          isInterlocked: perf.is_interlocked ?? r.Is_Interlocked ?? false,
          notes: r.Notes || `${r.Location || 'Plant Floor'} - LÆ°á»£t khá»Ÿi Ä‘á»™ng: ${r.TotalStarts || 0}, Chu ká»³ báº£o trĂ¬: ${r.Maintenance_Count || 0}`,
          lastStateUpdate: r.Last_Maintenance_Date || new Date().toISOString(),
          ratedCurrent: r.RatedCurrent != null ? Number(r.RatedCurrent) : 10.0,
          rated_current: r.RatedCurrent != null ? Number(r.RatedCurrent) : 10.0,
          maxVibrationThreshold: r.MaxVibrationThreshold != null ? Number(r.MaxVibrationThreshold) : 4.5,
          maxTempThreshold: r.MaxTempThreshold != null ? Number(r.MaxTempThreshold) : 85.0,
          is_valve: perf.is_valve ?? (eqCodeUpper.startsWith('VALVE_') || String(r.EquipmentType || '').toUpperCase().includes('VALVE')),
          is_mapped: perf.is_mapped ?? false,
          valve_state: perf.valve_state ?? '',
          actualCurrent: perf.actual_current ?? 0.0,
          actual_current: perf.actual_current ?? 0.0,
          loadPercent: perf.load_percent ?? 0.0,
          load_percent: perf.load_percent ?? 0.0,
          vibrationRms: perf.vibration_rms ?? 0.0,
          vibration_rms: perf.vibration_rms ?? 0.0,
          vibrationSeverity: perf.vibration_severity ?? (perf.is_mapped ? 'GOOD' : 'UNMAPPED'),
        };
      });
      setEquipmentList(mappedEquipment);

      if (!selectedEquipmentId && mappedEquipment.length > 0) {
        setSelectedEquipmentId(mappedEquipment[0].id);
      }

      const mappedLogs: MaintenanceLog[] = (mLogs || []).map((m: any) => ({
        id: `LOG-${m.Maintenance_ID}`,
        equipmentId: m.EquipmentCode,
        equipmentIntId: m.EquipmentID,
        equipmentName: m.EquipmentName,
        technician: m.Technician,
        serviceAction: (m.Maintenance_Type as ServiceActionType) || 'Periodic Inspection',
        ticketType: m.Ticket_Type || m.Maintenance_Type || 'Preventive',
        sparePartsUsed: m.Spare_Parts_Used || '',
        actionTaken: m.Action_Taken || m.Description || '',
        servicedAt: m.Serviced_At ? m.Serviced_At.replace('T', ' ').substring(0, 19) : (m.Completed_Date ? m.Completed_Date.replace('T', ' ').substring(0, 19) : ''),
        resetRuntime: m.Reset_Runtime_Flag !== false,
        remarks: m.Remarks || m.Description || '',
        costVnd: m.Cost_VND,
        status: m.Status,
      }));
      setMaintenanceLogs(mappedLogs);

      const mappedTrans: StateTransitionEvent[] = (trans || []).map((t: any) => ({
        id: `EVT-${t.Hist_ID}`,
        equipmentId: t.EquipmentCode,
        equipmentName: t.EquipmentName || t.EquipmentCode,
        previousState: (t.Old_Status === 'STOP' ? 'STOPPED' : t.Old_Status) as OperatingStatus,
        newState: (t.New_Status === 'STOP' ? 'STOPPED' : t.New_Status) as OperatingStatus,
        triggerSource: 'SCADA / Operator Dispatch',
        durationSeconds: t.Duration_Seconds || 0,
        timestamp: t.Changed_At ? t.Changed_At.replace('T', ' ').substring(0, 19) : '',
      }));
      setTransitionEvents(mappedTrans);
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn('[EquipmentContext] Live SQL sync warning:', e);
    }
  }, [selectedEquipmentId]);

  const config = useSafeConfig();
  const sqlOnline = config?.sqlConfig?.connectionState === 'connected';
  const prevSqlOnlineRef = React.useRef<boolean>(false);

  // Initial fetch and continuous 6-second heartbeat sync
  useEffect(() => {
    setIsLoading(true);
    refreshData().finally(() => setIsLoading(false));

    const poll = setInterval(() => {
      refreshData();

    return () => clearInterval(poll);
  }, [refreshData]);

  // Immediate re-fetch upon SQL Server transition from disconnected to connected
  useEffect(() => {
    if (sqlOnline && !prevSqlOnlineRef.current) {
      console.log('[EquipmentContext] SQL Server transitioned online - triggering immediate refreshData...');
      refreshData();
    }
    prevSqlOnlineRef.current = sqlOnline;
  }, [sqlOnline, refreshData]);

  const registerEquipment = (newEq: Omit<Equipment, 'lastStateUpdate'>) => {
    const timestamp = new Date().toISOString().replace('T', ' ').substring(0, 19);
    const item: Equipment = {
      ...newEq,
      plcTag: newEq.plcTag.trim(),
      opcNodeId: newEq.opcNodeId || newEq.plcTag.split(' ')[0] || newEq.plcTag,
      lastStateUpdate: timestamp,
    };
    setEquipmentList((prev) => [item, ...prev]);

    // Record initial state transition in immutable ledger
    const evt: StateTransitionEvent = {
      id: `EVT-${Date.now().toString().slice(-4)}`,
      equipmentId: item.id,
      equipmentName: item.name,
      previousState: 'STOPPED',
      newState: item.status,
      triggerSource: 'Asset Commissioning / Manual Registration',
      timestamp,
    };
    setTransitionEvents((prev) => [evt, ...prev]);
  };

  const updateEquipment = (id: string, updated: Partial<Equipment>) => {
    const timestamp = new Date().toISOString().replace('T', ' ').substring(0, 19);
    const targetEq = equipmentList.find((e) => e.id === id);

    if (updated.status && targetEq && updated.status !== targetEq.status) {
      const dbStatus = updated.status === 'STOPPED' ? 'STOP' : updated.status;
      updateEquipmentStatus(id, {
        status: dbStatus,
        duration_seconds: 0,
        trigger_source: 'Operator Manual Update / UI Action'
      }).then(() => {
        refreshData();
      }).catch((e) => {
        console.warn('Failed to update equipment status on backend:', e);
      });
    }

    setEquipmentList((prev) =>
      prev.map((eq) => {
        if (eq.id === id) {
          return {
            ...eq,
            ...updated,
            lastStateUpdate: timestamp,
          };
        }
        return eq;
      })
    );
  };

  const deleteEquipment = (id: string) => {
    setEquipmentList((prev) => prev.filter((eq) => eq.id !== id));
    if (selectedEquipmentId === id) {
      setSelectedEquipmentId(null);
    }
  };

  // Service Event Dispatch & Runtime Reset Logic
  const recordMaintenanceEvent = (logData: Omit<MaintenanceLog, 'id'>) => {
    const timestamp = new Date().toISOString().replace('T', ' ').substring(0, 19);
    const id = `LOG-${Date.now().toString().slice(-4)}`;
    const newLog: MaintenanceLog = {
      ...logData,
      id,
      servicedAt: logData.servicedAt || timestamp,
    };

    // Find integer EquipmentID
    const targetEq = equipmentList.find((e) => e.id === logData.equipmentId);
    const intId = targetEq?.equipmentId || (logData.equipmentIntId || 1);

    // Call backend API to write to dbo.Equipment_Maintenance and update dbo.Equipment_Master
    createMaintenanceRecord({
      equipment_id: intId,
      equipment_code: logData.equipmentId,
      ticket_type: logData.ticketType || logData.serviceAction,
      maintenance_type: logData.serviceAction,
      description: logData.remarks,
      action_taken: logData.actionTaken || logData.remarks,
      spare_parts_used: logData.sparePartsUsed || '',
      remarks: logData.remarks,
      technician: logData.technician,
      cost_vnd: logData.costVnd || 0,
      reset_runtime: logData.resetRuntime,
    }).then(() => {
      refreshData();
    }).catch((err) => {
      console.warn('Backend maintenance record sync warning:', err);
    });

    // Optimistic UI update
    setMaintenanceLogs((prev) => [newLog, ...prev]);

    if (newLog.resetRuntime) {
      setEquipmentList((prev) =>
        prev.map((eq) => {
          if (eq.id === newLog.equipmentId) {
            const nextStatus: OperatingStatus = 'STOPPED';
            return {
              ...eq,
              runtimeHours: 0,
              status: nextStatus,
              maintenanceCount: (eq.maintenanceCount || 0) + 1,
              healthRatio: 100,
              usagePercent: 0,
              lastStateUpdate: timestamp,
            };
          }
          return eq;
        })
      );

      // Trigger event clearing operational interlocks in Module Operations
      if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
        window.dispatchEvent(
          new CustomEvent('mes:equipment-interlock-cleared', {
            detail: {
              equipmentId: newLog.equipmentId,
              equipmentName: newLog.equipmentName,
              resetRuntime: true,
              timestamp,
            },
          })
        );
      }
    }

    return {
      success: true,
      message: `ÄĂ£ ghi nháº­n báº£o trĂ¬ [${newLog.id}] cho thiáº¿t bá»‹ ${newLog.equipmentName}.${
        newLog.resetRuntime ? ' ÄĂ£ Ä‘áº·t láº¡i giá» cháº¡y vá» 0 giá» vĂ  xĂ³a khĂ³a liĂªn Ä‘á»™ng váº­n hĂ nh.' : ''
      }`,
    };
  };

  const exportMaintenanceLogsToCsv = () => {
    const headers = ['Log ID', 'Equipment ID', 'Equipment Name', 'Technician', 'Service Action', 'Serviced At', 'Cost (VND)', 'Remarks'];
    const rows = maintenanceLogs.map((log) => [
      log.id,
      log.equipmentId,
      `"${(log.equipmentName || '').replace(/"/g, '""')}"`,
      log.technician,
      log.serviceAction,
      log.servicedAt,
      log.costVnd || 0,
      `"${(log.remarks || '').replace(/"/g, '""')}"`,
    ]);
    const csvContent = 'data:text/csv;charset=utf-8,' + [headers.join(','), ...rows.map((e) => e.join(','))].join('\n');
    const encodedUri = encodeURI(csvContent);
    const link = document.createElement('a');
    link.setAttribute('href', encodedUri);
    link.setAttribute('download', `MES_Equipment_Maintenance_Logs_${new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10)}.csv`);
    document.body.appendChild(link);
    link.click();
    document.body.removeChild(link);
  };

  return (
    <EquipmentContext.Provider
      value={{
        equipmentList,
        maintenanceLogs,
        transitionEvents,
        selectedEquipmentId,
        selectEquipment,
        registerEquipment,
        updateEquipment,
        deleteEquipment,
        recordMaintenanceEvent,
        exportMaintenanceLogsToCsv,
        isEquipmentInterlocked,
        refreshData,
        isLoading,
      }}
    >
      {children}
    </EquipmentContext.Provider>
  );
};

export const useEquipment = (): EquipmentContextType => {
  const context = useContext(EquipmentContext);
  if (!context) {
    throw new Error('useEquipment must be used within an EquipmentProvider');
  }
  return context;
};
