const OperationsContext = createContext<OperationsContextType | undefined>(undefined);

export const OperationsProvider: React.FC<{ children: React.ReactNode }> = ({ children }) => {
  const masterData = useMasterData();

  // Centralized Kepware Gateway URL bound to shared ConfigContext
  const { isGatewayOnline, endpoint } = useGatewayStatus();
  const scadaGatewayUrl = endpoint || 'opc.tcp://127.0.0.1:49320';
  const isScadaConnected = isGatewayOnline;
  const [executionMode, setExecutionModeState] = useState<ExecutionMode>('mode3_dual');
  const [targetProcessLine, setTargetProcessLineState] = useState<string>('Dual-Run Benchmark (Physical + SIMIT Twin Synchronized)');

  const setExecutionMode = (mode: ExecutionMode) => {
    setExecutionModeState(mode);
    if (mode === 'mode1_physical') {
      setTargetProcessLineState('Process Cell 1 (Physical S7-1500 Hardware Only)');
    } else if (mode === 'mode2_simit') {
      setTargetProcessLineState('Process Cell 2 (SIMIT Digital Twin Only)');
    } else {
      setTargetProcessLineState('Dual-Run Benchmark (Physical + SIMIT Twin Synchronized)');
    }
    api.setDualRunMode(mode).catch(() => {});
  };

  const setTargetProcessLine = (line: string) => {
    setTargetProcessLineState(line);
    if (line.includes('Dual') || line.includes('Benchmark') || line.includes('Synchronized')) {
      setExecutionModeState('mode3_dual');
      api.setDualRunMode('mode3_dual').catch(() => {});
    } else if (line.includes('Cell 2') || line.includes('SIMIT') || line.includes('Twin')) {
      setExecutionModeState('mode2_simit');
      api.setDualRunMode('mode2_simit').catch(() => {});
    } else {
      setExecutionModeState('mode1_physical');
      api.setDualRunMode('mode1_physical').catch(() => {});
    }
  };

  // Handshake Interlock State & Dual-Run Cell Handshake Flags
  const [handshakeStatus, setHandshakeStatus] = useState<HandshakeStatus>('IDLE');
  const [handshakeLoadedOk, setHandshakeLoadedOk] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [cell1Ack, setCell1Ack] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [cell2Ack, setCell2Ack] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [cell1Complete, setCell1Complete] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [cell2Complete, setCell2Complete] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [cell1Duration, setCell1Duration] = useState<string>('--');
  const [cell2Duration, setCell2Duration] = useState<string>('--');
  const [deviationMatrix, setDeviationMatrix] = useState<DigitalTwinDeviationRow[]>([]);
  const [benchmarkSummary, setBenchmarkSummary] = useState<DualRunBenchmarkSummary | null>(null);

  const refreshDeviationMatrix = async () => {
    try {
      const res = await api.getDeviationMatrix();
      if (res && res.matrix) {
        const rows: DigitalTwinDeviationRow[] = res.matrix.map((m: any) => ({
          id: m.id,
          name: m.name,
          phase: m.phase,
          unit: m.unit,
          sp: m.sp,
          pvHardware: m.pv_hardware,
          pvSimit: m.pv_simit,
          delta: m.delta,
          tolerance: m.tolerance,
          status: m.status as DeviationStatus,
          c1Mapped: m.c1_mapped,
          c2Mapped: m.c2_mapped,
        }));
        setDeviationMatrix(rows);

        if (res.benchmark_summary) {
          const b = res.benchmark_summary;
          setBenchmarkSummary({
            mappedParameters: b.mapped_parameters ?? 0,
            matchedParameters: b.matched_parameters ?? 0,
            totalParameters: b.total_parameters ?? 6,
            fidelityIndex: b.fidelity_index,
            tHardwareSec: b.t_hardware_sec,
            tHardwareFormatted: b.t_hardware_formatted || '--',
            tSimitSec: b.t_simit_sec,
            tSimitFormatted: b.t_simit_formatted || '--',
            deltaTSec: b.delta_t_sec,
            deltaTFormatted: b.delta_t_formatted || '--',
            cell1Complete: Boolean(b.cell1_complete),
            cell2Complete: Boolean(b.cell2_complete),
          });
          setCell1Complete(Boolean(b.cell1_complete));
          setCell2Complete(Boolean(b.cell2_complete));
          if (b.t_hardware_formatted) setCell1Duration(b.t_hardware_formatted);
          if (b.t_simit_formatted) setCell2Duration(b.t_simit_formatted);
        }
      }
    } catch {
      // Graceful fallback
    }
  };

  const completeCellSimulation = async (cell: 'cell1' | 'cell2') => {
    try {
      await api.completeCell(cell);
      await refreshDeviationMatrix();
    } catch {
      //
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    refreshDeviationMatrix();
    const interval = setInterval(refreshDeviationMatrix, 2000);
    return () => clearInterval(interval);
  }, []);

  // Clean-In-Place (CIP) Hygiene Interlock State (Siemens PM-CONTROL)
  // Initialized to DIRTY_EXPIRED (sterility expired) so interlock is active and testable immediately
  const [cipStatus, setCipStatus] = useState<CipHygieneStatus>('DIRTY_EXPIRED');
  const [lastCipTimestamp, setLastCipTimestamp] = useState<string>('2026-10-01 18:30:00');
  const [sterilityWindowHours] = useState<number>(8);
  const [cipProgressRemaining, setCipProgressRemaining] = useState<number>(5);

  const startCipCycle = async (): Promise<void> => {
    if (cipStatus === 'IN_PROGRESS') return;
    setCipStatus('IN_PROGRESS');
    setCipProgressRemaining(5);
    setLastCommandFeedback('[CIP ENGAGED] Initiating automated Clean-In-Place 5-stage sanitization cycle (Pre-rinse, Caustic wash, Acid wash, Final rinse, Hot steam)...');

    // Trigger bidirectional CIP command on PLC/Gateway: CIP_START_CMD = True, CIP_CLEAN_STATUS = False
    try {
      await api.triggerCipCycle(5);
    } catch (err) {
      console.debug('[OperationsContext] Trigger CIP cycle notice:', err);
    }

    return new Promise<void>((resolve) => {
      let secondsLeft = 5;
      const interval = setInterval(() => {
        secondsLeft -= 1;
        setCipProgressRemaining(secondsLeft);
        if (secondsLeft <= 0) {
          clearInterval(interval);
          const finishedAt = new Date().toISOString().replace('T', ' ').slice(0, 19);
          setCipStatus('CLEAN');
          setLastCipTimestamp(finishedAt);
          setLastCommandFeedback(`[CIP CYCLE COMPLETE] Hygiene and sterility validated. Unit Mixing certified clean. Sterility window: 8.0 hours active. Batch interlock unlocked.`);
          setTimeout(() => setLastCommandFeedback(null), 8000);
          resolve();
        }
      }, 1000);
    });
  };

  const resetCipToExpired = async () => {
    setCipStatus('DIRTY_EXPIRED');
    setLastCipTimestamp('2026-10-01 18:30:00');
    setLastCommandFeedback('[CIP INTERLOCK ENGAGED] Unit Mixing Clean-In-Place expired (> 8.0 hours). Automated safety gate locked: SCADA download & batch start disabled.');
    try {
      await api.resetCipInterlock();
    } catch (err) {
      console.debug('[OperationsContext] Reset CIP notice:', err);
    }
    setTimeout(() => setLastCommandFeedback(null), 6000);
  };

  // 3-Tier Queue
  const [newOrders, setNewOrders] = useState<QueueOrder[]>([]);
  const [runningOrders, setRunningOrders] = useState<QueueOrder[]>([]);
  const [finishedOrders, setFinishedOrders] = useState<QueueOrder[]>([]);
  const [selectedOrderId, setSelectedOrderId] = useState<string | null>(null);

  // Active Supervisory Batch State & Commands
  const [currentBatchState, setCurrentBatchState] = useState<Isa88BatchState>('IDLE');
  const [lastCommandFeedback, setLastCommandFeedback] = useState<string | null>(null);

  // Configurable Phase Durations (ISA-88 target running times)
  const [phaseDurations, setPhaseDurations] = useState<PhaseDurationsMap>(defaultPhaseDurations);

  const reloadPhaseDurations = async () => {
    try {
      const res = await api.getPhaseDurations();
      if (res && res.success && res.durations) {
        setPhaseDurations({
          cell1_physical: { ...defaultPhaseDurations.cell1_physical, ...res.durations.cell1_physical },
          cell2_simit: { ...defaultPhaseDurations.cell2_simit, ...res.durations.cell2_simit },
        });
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.debug('[OperationsContext] Failed to load phase durations:', err);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    reloadPhaseDurations();
  }, []);

  const saveAllPhaseDurations = async (newDurations: PhaseDurationsMap): Promise<boolean> => {
    try {
      const res = await api.updatePhaseDurations(newDurations);
      if (res && res.success) {
        setPhaseDurations(newDurations);
        setTimelineNodes(prev => prev.map(node => {
          const isCell2 = node.targetCell?.includes('Cell 2');
          const baseCode = node.code.replace('_PC2', '');
          const nominalDuration = isCell2
            ? (newDurations.cell2_simit[node.code] ?? newDurations.cell2_simit[baseCode] ?? (node.nominalDurationMinutes || 5.0))
            : (newDurations.cell1_physical[node.code] ?? newDurations.cell1_physical[baseCode] ?? (node.nominalDurationMinutes || 5.0));
          return {
            ...node,
            nominalDurationMinutes: nominalDuration,
          };
        }));
        return true;
      }
      return false;
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('[OperationsContext] Failed to save phase durations:', err);
      return false;
    }
  };

  const updatePhaseDuration = async (cell: 'cell1_physical' | 'cell2_simit', phaseCode: string, durationMinutes: number) => {
    const updated = {
      ...phaseDurations,
      [cell]: {
        ...phaseDurations[cell],
        [phaseCode]: durationMinutes,
      },
    };
    await saveAllPhaseDurations(updated);
  };

  const [scadaVerifications, setScadaVerifications] = useState<ScadaSetpointVerification[]>(initialVerifications);
  const [topologyCards, setTopologyCards] = useState<TopologyCellCard[]>(initialTopologyCards);
  const [timelineNodes, setTimelineNodes] = useState<TimelineNode[]>(initialTimelineNodes);
  const [trendCards, setTrendCards] = useState<ProcessTrendCard[]>(initialTrendCards);

  // Synchronize Master Data Work Orders into Operations Queue
  useEffect(() => {
    if (masterData?.workOrders) {
      const dispatchedFromMaster = masterData.workOrders.map((wo) => {
        // Extract setpoints from calculatedSetpoints
        const milkSp = wo.calculatedSetpoints?.find(s => s.name.includes('Milk'))?.calculatedValue || (wo.volume * 0.7);
        const sugarSp = wo.calculatedSetpoints?.find(s => s.name.includes('Sugar'))?.calculatedValue || (wo.volume * 0.2);
        const additiveSp = wo.calculatedSetpoints?.find(s => s.name.includes('Additive'))?.calculatedValue || (wo.volume * 0.1);
        const tempHotSp = wo.calculatedSetpoints?.find(s => s.name.includes('Sterilization') || s.name.includes('Temp'))?.calculatedValue || 138.0;
        const tempColdSp = 4.0;

        return {
          id: wo.orderId,
          orderName: `${wo.orderId} (${wo.recipeName})`,
          recipeName: wo.recipeName,
          recipeVersion: wo.recipeVersion || 'v1.2',
          volume: wo.volume,
          targetScadaNode: 'SCADA_Line_01',
          status: (wo.status === 'RUNNING' ? 'RUNNING' : wo.status === 'COMPLETED' ? 'COMPLETED' : wo.status === 'READY' ? 'READY' : 'NEW') as Isa88BatchState,
          scadaSyncStatus: wo.status === 'RUNNING' ? 'Executing on Controller' : 'Validated in Level 3 MES',
          elapsedTime: wo.status === 'RUNNING' ? '00:05:20' : '00:00:00',
          completionTime: wo.endTime !== '---' ? wo.endTime : undefined,
          assignedCell: 'Process Cell 1 (Physical S7-1500)',
          customerName: wo.customerName,
          customerCode: wo.customerCode,
          orderPriority: wo.orderPriority,
          setpoints: {
            milkSp,
            sugarSp,
            additiveSp,
            tempHotSp,
            tempColdSp,
          },
        };
      });

      // Split into 3-tier queue
      const newlyDispatched = dispatchedFromMaster.filter(o => o.status === 'NEW' || o.status === 'READY');
      const activelyRunning = dispatchedFromMaster.filter(o => o.status === 'RUNNING' || o.status === 'HELD');
      const alreadyDone = dispatchedFromMaster.filter(o => o.status === 'COMPLETED' || o.status === 'ABORTED');

      setNewOrders(newlyDispatched);
      setRunningOrders(activelyRunning);
      if (activelyRunning.length > 0) {
        setCurrentBatchState(activelyRunning[0].status);
        setHandshakeLoadedOk(true);
      }
      setFinishedOrders(alreadyDone);

      if (!selectedOrderId && newlyDispatched.length > 0) {
        setSelectedOrderId(newlyDispatched[0].id);
      }
    }
  }, [masterData?.workOrders]);

  // Update Pre-Flight Setpoint Verification Table when active/selected order changes
  useEffect(() => {
    const active = runningOrders[0] || newOrders.find(o => o.id === selectedOrderId) || newOrders[0];
    if (active?.setpoints) {
      setScadaVerifications([
        {
          id: '1',
          phaseId: 'PH_SUPPLYMILK',
          tagName: 'PH11101_SETPOINT_MILK',
          scriptedSetpoint: active.setpoints.milkSp,
          scadaActualReadback: active.status === 'RUNNING' ? active.setpoints.milkSp : 0.0,
          unit: 'L',
          tolerance: 10.0,
          status: active.status === 'RUNNING' ? 'Matched' : 'In Progress',
          timestamp: new Date().toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit', second: '2-digit' }),
        },
        {
          id: '2',
          phaseId: 'PH_SUPPLYSUGAR',
          tagName: 'PH11202_SETPOINT_SUGAR',
          scriptedSetpoint: active.setpoints.sugarSp,
          scadaActualReadback: active.status === 'RUNNING' ? active.setpoints.sugarSp : 0.0,
          unit: 'kg',
          tolerance: 2.0,
          status: active.status === 'RUNNING' ? 'Matched' : 'In Progress',
          timestamp: new Date().toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit', second: '2-digit' }),
        },
        {
          id: '3',
          phaseId: 'PH_SUPPLYADDITIVE',
          tagName: 'PH11303_SETPOINT_ADDITIVE',
          scriptedSetpoint: active.setpoints.additiveSp,
          scadaActualReadback: active.status === 'RUNNING' ? active.setpoints.additiveSp : 0.0,
          unit: 'L',
          tolerance: 1.0,
          status: active.status === 'RUNNING' ? 'Matched' : 'In Progress',
          timestamp: new Date().toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit', second: '2-digit' }),
        },
        {
          id: '4',
          phaseId: 'PH_HEATING',
          tagName: 'PH22101_SETPOINT_TEMP_HOT',
          scriptedSetpoint: active.setpoints.tempHotSp,
          scadaActualReadback: active.status === 'RUNNING' ? active.setpoints.tempHotSp : 0.0,
          unit: 'Â°C',
          tolerance: 1.0,
          status: active.status === 'RUNNING' ? 'Matched' : 'In Progress',
          timestamp: new Date().toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit', second: '2-digit' }),
        },
        {
          id: '5',
          phaseId: 'PH_COOLING',
          tagName: 'PH22202_SETPOINT_TEMP_COLD',
          scriptedSetpoint: active.setpoints.tempColdSp,
          scadaActualReadback: active.status === 'RUNNING' ? active.setpoints.tempColdSp : 0.0,
          unit: 'Â°C',
          tolerance: 0.5,
          status: active.status === 'RUNNING' ? 'Matched' : 'In Progress',
          timestamp: new Date().toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit', second: '2-digit' }),
        },
      ]);
    }
  }, [selectedOrderId, runningOrders.length, newOrders]);

  // Helper to dynamically compute phase node state & stretching duration
  const computeDynamicNode = (
    node: TimelineNode,
    elapsed: number,
    batchState: Isa88BatchState,
    mappedOpcState?: number
  ): TimelineNode => {
    const baseCode = node.code.replace('_PC2', '');
    const isCell2 = node.targetCell?.includes('Cell 2');
    const nominalDuration = isCell2
      ? (phaseDurations.cell2_simit[node.code] ?? phaseDurations.cell2_simit[baseCode] ?? (node.nominalDurationMinutes || 5.0))
      : (phaseDurations.cell1_physical[node.code] ?? phaseDurations.cell1_physical[baseCode] ?? (node.nominalDurationMinutes || 5.0));

    // If live OPC UA telemetry explicitly provides an ISA-88 state for this phase, honor it!
    if (mappedOpcState !== undefined && mappedOpcState >= 0 && mappedOpcState <= 11) {
      const opcMeta = getIsa88State(mappedOpcState);
      const isComplete = mappedOpcState === 11;
      const isRunning = mappedOpcState === 1;
      const duration = isComplete ? nominalDuration : isRunning ? Math.max(0.1, elapsed - node.startMinute) : node.durationMinutes;
      return {
        ...node,
        nominalDurationMinutes: nominalDuration,
        status: opcMeta.name,
        stateId: opcMeta.id,
        durationMinutes: duration,
        isFrozen: isComplete,
      };
    }

    if (batchState === 'IDLE' || batchState === 'NEW' || batchState === 'READY') {
      return {
        ...node,
        nominalDurationMinutes: nominalDuration,
        status: 'IDLE',
        stateId: 0,
        durationMinutes: 0,
        isFrozen: false,
      };
    }

    if (batchState === 'HELD' || batchState === 'HOLDING') {
      const isNodeRunning = node.status === 'RUNNING' || node.stateId === 1;
      return {
        ...node,
        nominalDurationMinutes: nominalDuration,
        status: isNodeRunning ? (batchState === 'HELD' ? 'HELD' : 'HOLDING') : node.status,
        stateId: isNodeRunning ? (batchState === 'HELD' ? 3 : 2) : node.stateId,
      };
    }

    if (batchState === 'PAUSED' || batchState === 'PAUSING') {
      const isNodeRunning = node.status === 'RUNNING' || node.stateId === 1;
      return {
        ...node,
        nominalDurationMinutes: nominalDuration,
        status: isNodeRunning ? (batchState === 'PAUSED' ? 'PAUSED' : 'PAUSING') : node.status,
        stateId: isNodeRunning ? (batchState === 'PAUSED' ? 6 : 5) : node.stateId,
      };
    }

    if (batchState === 'STOPPED' || batchState === 'STOPPING') {
      const isNodeRunning = node.status === 'RUNNING' || node.stateId === 1;
      return {
        ...node,
        nominalDurationMinutes: nominalDuration,
        status: isNodeRunning ? 'STOPPED' : node.status,
        stateId: isNodeRunning ? 8 : node.stateId,
      };
    }

    if (batchState === 'ABORTED' || batchState === 'ABORTING') {
      const isNodeRunning = node.status === 'RUNNING' || node.stateId === 1;
      return {
        ...node,
        nominalDurationMinutes: nominalDuration,
        status: isNodeRunning ? 'ABORTED' : node.status,
        stateId: isNodeRunning ? 10 : node.stateId,
      };
    }

    if (batchState === 'COMPLETE' || batchState === 'COMPLETED') {
      return {
        ...node,
        nominalDurationMinutes: nominalDuration,
        status: 'COMPLETE',
        stateId: 11,
        durationMinutes: nominalDuration,
        isFrozen: true,
      };
    }

    // Dynamic nominal windows using configured durations
    const cell1Durations = phaseDurations.cell1_physical;
    const cell2Durations = phaseDurations.cell2_simit;

    const nominalWindows: Record<string, { start: number; end: number }> = {
      // Cell 1 Physical (Hardware S7-1500)
      PH11101: { start: 0, end: cell1Durations['PH11101'] ?? 6.0 },
      PH11202: { start: 4.0, end: 4.0 + (cell1Durations['PH11202'] ?? 5.0) },
      PH11303: { start: 8.0, end: 8.0 + (cell1Durations['PH11303'] ?? 4.0) },
      OP1001: { start: 0, end: Math.max(12.0, 8.0 + (cell1Durations['PH11303'] ?? 4.0)) },
      PH12101: { start: 10.0, end: 10.0 + (cell1Durations['PH12101'] ?? 12.0) },
      PH12202: { start: 12.0, end: 12.0 + (cell1Durations['PH12202'] ?? 10.0) },
      PH12303: { start: 22.0, end: 22.0 + (cell1Durations['PH12303'] ?? 4.0) },
      OP1002: { start: 10.0, end: Math.max(26.0, 22.0 + (cell1Durations['PH12303'] ?? 4.0)) },
      UP1000: { start: 0, end: 26.0 },
      PH22101: { start: 12.0, end: 12.0 + (cell1Durations['PH22101'] ?? 8.0) },
      PH22102: { start: 20.0, end: 20.0 + (cell1Durations['PH22102'] ?? 4.0) },
      OP2001: { start: 12.0, end: Math.max(24.0, 20.0 + (cell1Durations['PH22102'] ?? 4.0)) },
      PH22201: { start: 24.0, end: 24.0 + (cell1Durations['PH22201'] ?? 5.0) },
      PH22202: { start: 27.0, end: 27.0 + (cell1Durations['PH22202'] ?? 3.0) },
      OP2002: { start: 24.0, end: Math.max(30.0, 27.0 + (cell1Durations['PH22202'] ?? 3.0)) },
      UP2000: { start: 12.0, end: 30.0 },

      // Cell 2 SIMIT Digital Twin
      PH_SUPPLYMILK_PC2: { start: 0, end: cell2Durations['PH_SUPPLYMILK_PC2'] ?? 6.0 },
      PH_SUPPLYSUGAR_PC2: { start: 4.0, end: 4.0 + (cell2Durations['PH_SUPPLYSUGAR_PC2'] ?? 5.0) },
      PH_AGITATE_PC2: { start: 8.0, end: 8.0 + (cell2Durations['PH_AGITATE_PC2'] ?? 12.0) },
      PH_HEAT_PC2: { start: 12.0, end: 12.0 + (cell2Durations['PH_HEAT_PC2'] ?? 8.0) },
      PH_CHILL_PC2: { start: 20.0, end: 20.0 + (cell2Durations['PH_CHILL_PC2'] ?? 5.0) },
    };

    const cell2Overrides: Record<string, { start: number; end: number }> = {
      UP1000: { start: 0, end: Math.max(20.0, 8.0 + (cell2Durations['PH_AGITATE_PC2'] ?? 12.0)) },
      OP1001: { start: 0, end: Math.max(9.0, 4.0 + (cell2Durations['PH_SUPPLYSUGAR_PC2'] ?? 5.0)) },
      OP1002: { start: 8.0, end: Math.max(20.0, 8.0 + (cell2Durations['PH_AGITATE_PC2'] ?? 12.0)) },
      UP2000: { start: 12.0, end: Math.max(25.0, 20.0 + (cell2Durations['PH_CHILL_PC2'] ?? 5.0)) },
      OP2001: { start: 12.0, end: Math.max(20.0, 12.0 + (cell2Durations['PH_HEAT_PC2'] ?? 8.0)) },
      OP2002: { start: 20.0, end: Math.max(25.0, 20.0 + (cell2Durations['PH_CHILL_PC2'] ?? 5.0)) },
    };

    const w = (isCell2 && cell2Overrides[node.code])
      ? cell2Overrides[node.code]
      : (nominalWindows[node.code] || nominalWindows[baseCode] || { start: node.startMinute, end: node.startMinute + nominalDuration });

    if (elapsed < w.start) {
      return {
        ...node,
        nominalDurationMinutes: nominalDuration,
        status: 'IDLE',
        stateId: 0,
        durationMinutes: 0,
        isFrozen: false,
      };
    } else if (elapsed >= w.start && elapsed < w.end) {
      // Live dynamic stretching
      const dynamicDuration = Math.max(0.1, Number((elapsed - w.start).toFixed(2)));
      return {
        ...node,
        nominalDurationMinutes: nominalDuration,
        status: 'RUNNING',
        stateId: 1,
        startMinute: w.start,
        durationMinutes: dynamicDuration,
        isFrozen: false,
      };
    } else {
      // Completed and frozen
      const frozenDuration = Number((w.end - w.start).toFixed(2));
      return {
        ...node,
        nominalDurationMinutes: nominalDuration,
        status: 'COMPLETE',
        stateId: 11,
        startMinute: w.start,
        durationMinutes: frozenDuration,
        isFrozen: true,
      };
    }
  };

  // Dynamic Cell 2 & Cell 1 Topology Switching
  useEffect(() => {
    const isCell2 = targetProcessLine.includes('Cell 2');
    const isRunning = currentBatchState === 'RUNNING';
    const isHeld = currentBatchState === 'HELD';

    setTopologyCards(prev => prev.map(card => {
      const matchCell = isCell2 ? card.targetCell.includes('Cell 2') : card.targetCell.includes('Cell 1');
      if (matchCell && isRunning) {
        return {
          ...card,
          status: 'RUNNING',
          operations: card.operations.map((op, opIdx) => ({
            ...op,
            status: opIdx === 0 ? 'COMPLETED' : 'RUNNING',
            phases: op.phases.map((ph, phIdx) => ({
              ...ph,
              status: opIdx === 0 ? 'COMPLETED' : phIdx === 0 ? 'RUNNING' : 'IDLE',
              activeStep: opIdx === 0 ? 'Phase Execution Finished' : phIdx === 0 ? 'Regulating Active Parameter' : 'Standby',
              pvValue: ph.spValue ? ph.spValue : ph.pvValue,
            }))
          }))
        };
      } else if (matchCell && isHeld) {
        return { ...card, status: 'HELD' };
      } else if (!isRunning) {
        return {
          ...card,
          status: 'IDLE',
          operations: card.operations.map(op => ({
            ...op,
            status: 'IDLE',
            phases: op.phases.map(ph => ({ ...ph, status: 'IDLE' }))
          }))
        };
      }
      return card;
    }));
  }, [targetProcessLine, currentBatchState]);

  // Dynamic Phase Timeline Engine: drives dynamic stretching and state progression
  useEffect(() => {
    const activeOrder = runningOrders[0];
    let elapsedMinutes = 0;
    if (activeOrder && activeOrder.elapsedTime) {
      const parts = activeOrder.elapsedTime.split(':').map(Number);
      if (parts.length === 3) {
        elapsedMinutes = parts[0] * 60 + parts[1] + parts[2] / 60;
      }
    }
    setTimelineNodes(prev => prev.map(node => computeDynamicNode(node, elapsedMinutes, currentBatchState)));
  }, [currentBatchState]);

  // Auto-increment elapsed time for the running order & synchronize timeline stretching
  useEffect(() => {
    const timer = setInterval(() => {
      setRunningOrders((prev) =>
        prev.map((order) => {
          if (order.status === 'RUNNING') {
            const parts = order.elapsedTime.split(':').map(Number);
            let s = parts[2] + 1;
            let m = parts[1];
            let h = parts[0];
            if (s >= 60) {
              s = 0;
              m += 1;
            }
            if (m >= 60) {
              m = 0;
              h += 1;
            }
            const pad = (n: number) => n.toString().padStart(2, '0');
            const newElapsedTime = `${pad(h)}:${pad(m)}:${pad(s)}`;
            const currentElapsedMinutes = h * 60 + m + s / 60;

            // Dynamically stretch timeline nodes for running process line
            setTimelineNodes(prevNodes =>
              prevNodes.map(node => computeDynamicNode(node, currentElapsedMinutes, 'RUNNING'))
            );

            return { ...order, elapsedTime: newElapsedTime };
          }
          return order;
        })
      );
    }, 1000);
    return () => clearInterval(timer);
  }, []);

  // Poll live telemetry from Python Kepware Gateway
  useEffect(() => {
    const pollTelemetry = async () => {
      try {
        const response = await fetch('/api/gateway/live-telemetry');
        if (response.ok) {
          const telemetry = await response.json();
          
          setScadaVerifications(prev => prev.map(v => {
            if (v.phaseId === 'PH_HEATING' || v.tagName.includes('TEMP_HOT')) {
              const pv = Number((telemetry.temperature_act ?? 0.0).toFixed(1));
              const diff = Math.abs(pv - v.scriptedSetpoint);
              const status = diff <= v.tolerance ? 'Matched' : currentBatchState === 'RUNNING' ? 'In Progress' : 'Deviating';
              return { ...v, scadaActualReadback: pv, status };
            }
            if (v.phaseId === 'PH_SUPPLYSUGAR' || v.tagName.includes('SETPOINT_SUGAR')) {
              // Ensure clamped >= 0
              const pv = Math.max(0.0, Number((telemetry.weight_act ?? 0.0).toFixed(1)));
              const diff = Math.abs(pv - v.scriptedSetpoint);
              const status = diff <= v.tolerance ? 'Matched' : currentBatchState === 'RUNNING' ? 'In Progress' : 'Deviating';
              return { ...v, scadaActualReadback: pv, status };
            }
            if (v.phaseId === 'PH_SUPPLYMILK') {
              const milkTag = Array.isArray(telemetry.essential_tags)
                ? telemetry.essential_tags.find((t: any) => t.tag_name === 'PH11101_FLOWRATE_ACT' || t.tag_name === 'Milk_Flow_PV')
                : null;
              const pv = milkTag && typeof milkTag.value === 'number' ? Number(milkTag.value.toFixed(1)) : 0.0;
              const diff = Math.abs(pv - v.scriptedSetpoint);
              const status = diff <= v.tolerance ? 'Matched' : 'In Progress';
              return { ...v, scadaActualReadback: pv, status };
            }
            return v;
          }));

          // Auto-disengage CIP Safety Interlock if PLC reports CIP_CLEAN_STATUS = 1 or true
          const tagList = Array.isArray(telemetry.essential_tags)
            ? telemetry.essential_tags
            : (telemetry.essential_tags && typeof telemetry.essential_tags === 'object')
              ? Object.values(telemetry.essential_tags)
              : [];
          const cipTag = tagList.find((t: any) => 
            t.tag_name === 'CIP_CLEAN_STATUS' || 
            t.tag_key === 'CIP_CLEAN_STATUS' ||
            t.node_id?.includes('CIP_CLEAN_STATUS') ||
            t.node_id?.includes('CIP_Sanitized_OK') ||
            t.node_id === 'ns=2;s=Simulation Examples.Functions.User1'
          );
          if (cipTag && (cipTag.value === true || cipTag.value === 1 || cipTag.value === '1' || cipTag.value === 'true')) {
            setCipStatus((prev) => {
              if (prev !== 'CLEAN' && prev !== 'IN_PROGRESS') {
                const nowStr = new Date().toISOString().replace('T', ' ').slice(0, 19);
                setLastCipTimestamp(nowStr);
                setLastCommandFeedback('[CIP Tá»° Äá»˜NG XĂC NHáº¬N] PLC CIP_CLEAN_STATUS = 1. KhĂ³a liĂªn Ä‘á»™ng CIP Ä‘Ă£ tá»± Ä‘á»™ng má»Ÿ.');
                setTimeout(() => setLastCommandFeedback(null), 6000);
                return 'CLEAN';
              }
              return prev;
            });
          }

          setTrendCards(prev => prev.map(t => {
            if (t.title.includes('Sterilization') || t.title.includes('Hot Temp')) {
              const pv = Number((telemetry.temperature_act ?? 0.0).toFixed(1));
              return { 
                ...t, 
                currentSp: 138.0,
                currentPv: pv, 
                dataPoints: [...t.dataPoints.slice(1), { time: new Date().toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit', second: '2-digit' }), sp: 138.0, pv }] 
              };
            }
            if (t.title.includes('Sugar Weight')) {
              // Clamp min to 0
              const pv = Math.max(0.0, Number((telemetry.weight_act ?? 0.0).toFixed(1)));
              return { 
                ...t, 
                currentPv: pv, 
                dataPoints: [...t.dataPoints.slice(1), { time: new Date().toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit', second: '2-digit' }), sp: t.currentSp, pv }] 
              };
            }
            return t;
          }));
        }
      } catch {
        // Graceful degradation when offline
      }
    };
    const interval = setInterval(pollTelemetry, 1000);
    return () => clearInterval(interval);
  }, [currentBatchState]);

  // Dispatch an order
  const dispatchOrder = (orderId: string) => {
    setSelectedOrderId(orderId);
    setLastCommandFeedback(`Order [${orderId}] selected for supervisory downlink. Click [DOWNLOAD TO SCADA] to initiate handshake.`);
    setTimeout(() => setLastCommandFeedback(null), 5000);
  };

  // Siemens PM-CONTROL Batch Command Execution & Handshake Engine
  const executeBatchCommand = async (command: BatchCommandType) => {
    const timeStr = new Date().toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit', second: '2-digit' });

    try {
      if (command === 'DOWNLOAD') {
        if (cipStatus !== 'CLEAN') {
          setLastCommandFeedback('[CIP SAFETY INTERLOCK] Download rejected: Unit Mixing requires automated Clean-In-Place (CIP) cycle before fresh batch execution.');
          return;
        }

        const targetOrder = newOrders.find(o => o.id === selectedOrderId) || newOrders[0];
        if (!targetOrder) {
          setLastCommandFeedback('[ERROR] No order available in NEW ORDERS queue to download.');
          return;
        }

        setHandshakeStatus('DOWNLOADING');
        const modeDesc = executionMode === 'mode1_physical'
          ? 'Process Cell 1 (S7-1500 Hardware Only)'
          : executionMode === 'mode2_simit'
          ? 'Process Cell 2 (SIMIT Digital Twin Only)'
          : 'Dual-Run Benchmark (Physical + SIMIT Twin Synchronized)';

        setLastCommandFeedback(`[DOWNLINK] Transmitting [${targetOrder.id}] Control Recipe setpoints to Kepware buffer for ${modeDesc}...`);

        let dispatchResult: any = null;
        try {
          dispatchResult = await api.dispatchDualRunRecipe({
            order_code: targetOrder.id,
            execution_mode: executionMode,
            recipe_name: targetOrder.recipeName,
            target_volume: targetOrder.volume,
          });
        } catch {
          try {
            dispatchResult = await api.dispatchBatch({
              order_code: targetOrder.id,
              execution_mode: executionMode,
            });
          } catch {
            // Fallback safe catch
          }
        }

        const c1Ack = dispatchResult?.cell1_ack ?? true;
        const c2Ack = dispatchResult?.cell2_ack ?? true;
        setCell1Ack(c1Ack);
        setCell2Ack(c2Ack);

        let isOk = false;
        if (executionMode === 'mode1_physical') isOk = c1Ack;
        else if (executionMode === 'mode2_simit') isOk = c2Ack;
        else isOk = c1Ack && c2Ack;

        setHandshakeLoadedOk(isOk);
        setHandshakeStatus(isOk ? 'VERIFIED' : 'DOWNLOADING');

        if (isOk) {
          if (executionMode === 'mode3_dual') {
            setLastCommandFeedback(`[DUAL-RUN HANDSHAKE OK] Cáº£ Process Cell 1 (S7-1500) & Cell 2 (SIMIT Twin) Ä‘Ă£ nháº­n setpoints & xĂ¡c nháº­n Ack_Recipe_Loaded = True. [START BATCH] Ä‘Ă£ sáºµn sĂ ng.`);
          } else if (executionMode === 'mode2_simit') {
            setLastCommandFeedback(`[SIMIT TWIN HANDSHAKE OK] SIMIT Digital Twin Ä‘Ă£ nháº­n setpoints & xĂ¡c nháº­n náº¡p cĂ´ng thá»©c. [START BATCH] Ä‘Ă£ sáºµn sĂ ng.`);
          } else {
            setLastCommandFeedback(`[HARDWARE HANDSHAKE OK] Process Cell 1 Hardware Ä‘Ă£ nháº­n setpoints & xĂ¡c nháº­n náº¡p cĂ´ng thá»©c. [START BATCH] Ä‘Ă£ sáºµn sĂ ng.`);
          }
          setScadaVerifications(prev => prev.map(v => ({ ...v, timestamp: timeStr, status: 'Matched' })));
        } else {
          setLastCommandFeedback(`[HANDSHAKE CHá»œ] Äang chá» xĂ¡c nháº­n tá»« controller active...`);
        }

        await refreshDeviationMatrix();
        return;
      }

      if (command === 'START') {
        if (cipStatus !== 'CLEAN') {
          setLastCommandFeedback('[CIP SAFETY INTERLOCK] Start batch rejected: Unit Mixing requires automated Clean-In-Place (CIP) cycle before fresh batch execution.');
          return;
        }

        if (!handshakeLoadedOk) {
          setLastCommandFeedback('[INTERLOCK REJECTED] Handshake_Loaded_OK is FALSE. You must execute [DOWNLOAD TO SCADA] first.');
          return;
        }

        const targetOrder = newOrders.find(o => o.id === selectedOrderId) || newOrders[0];
        if (!targetOrder) return;

        // Move to running orders
        const activated: QueueOrder = {
          ...targetOrder,
          status: 'RUNNING',
          scadaSyncStatus: 'Executing on Controller (Handshake OK)',
          elapsedTime: '00:00:01',
        };

        setNewOrders(prev => prev.filter(o => o.id !== targetOrder.id));
        setRunningOrders([activated, ...runningOrders]);
        setCurrentBatchState('RUNNING');
        setCell1Complete(false);
        setCell2Complete(false);

        // Dispatches 500ms CMD_Start pulse via backend batch_engine
        try {
          await api.startDualRunBatch({
            order_code: targetOrder.id,
            execution_mode: executionMode,
          });
        } catch {
          // Fallback
        }

        // Asynchronously update status in SQL Server and log audit trail
        api.updateOrderStatus(targetOrder.id, 'RUNNING', 'Operator')
          .then(() => {
            masterData?.refetchData?.();
            window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('mes:orders-updated'));
          })
          .catch(() => {});
        api.logUserAction({
          username: 'Operator',
          role: 'Operator',
          action: 'BATCH_START',
          detail: `Batch [${targetOrder.id}] started execution for Recipe: ${targetOrder.recipeName} (Mode: ${executionMode})`,
        }).catch(() => {});

        // Forward to Kepware via universal phase transition bus
        api.transitionPhase({
          order_code: targetOrder.id,
          phase_id: 'PH_START',
          state: 'START',
        }).catch(() => {});

        setLastCommandFeedback(`[START BATCH] Order [${targetOrder.id}] active. Xung CMD_Start (500ms) Ä‘Ă£ gá»­i. Runtime timer started.`);
        await refreshDeviationMatrix();
        return;
      }

      if (command === 'HOLD') {
        setCurrentBatchState('HELD');
        setRunningOrders(prev => prev.map(o => ({ ...o, status: 'HELD' })));
        const activeOrder = runningOrders[0];
        if (activeOrder) {
          api.updateOrderStatus(activeOrder.id, 'HELD', 'Operator')
            .then(() => {
              masterData?.refetchData?.();
              window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('mes:orders-updated'));
            })
            .catch(() => {});
          api.logUserAction({
            username: 'Operator',
            role: 'Operator',
            action: 'BATCH_HOLD',
            detail: `Batch [${activeOrder.id}] execution paused safely by operator`,
          }).catch(() => {});
          api.transitionPhase({
            order_code: activeOrder.id,
            phase_id: 'PH_ALL',
            state: 'HOLD',
          }).catch(() => {});
        }
        setLastCommandFeedback(`[HOLD] ISA-88 #HOLD engaged. Dosing & thermal ramping paused safely.`);
        return;
      }

      if (command === 'RESUME') {
        setCurrentBatchState('RUNNING');
        setRunningOrders(prev => prev.map(o => ({ ...o, status: 'RUNNING' })));
        const activeOrder = runningOrders[0];
        if (activeOrder) {
          api.updateOrderStatus(activeOrder.id, 'RUNNING', 'Operator')
            .then(() => {
              masterData?.refetchData?.();
              window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('mes:orders-updated'));
            })
            .catch(() => {});
          api.transitionPhase({
            order_code: activeOrder.id,
            phase_id: 'PH_ALL',
            state: 'RESUME',
          }).catch(() => {});
        }
        setLastCommandFeedback(`[RESUME / RESTART] Batch execution resumed.`);
        return;
      }

      if (command === 'STOP') {
        setCurrentBatchState('STOPPED');
        if (runningOrders.length > 0) {
          const stopped = {
            ...runningOrders[0],
            status: 'COMPLETED' as const,
            completionTime: timeStr,
          };
          setFinishedOrders(prev => [stopped, ...prev]);
          setRunningOrders(prev => prev.slice(1));

          // Asynchronously record batch completion to SQL Server and generate EBR report
          api.updateOrderStatus(stopped.id, 'COMPLETED', 'Operator')
            .then(() => {
              masterData?.refetchData?.();
              window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('mes:orders-updated'));
            })
            .catch(() => {});
          api.submitBatchCompletionReport({
            order_code: stopped.id,
            recipe_applied: stopped.recipeName,
            total_produced: stopped.volume,
            avg_deviation_percent: 0.25,
            quality_status: 'CONFORMING',
            disposition_action: 'RELEASED',
            sign_off_by: 'Shift Supervisor',
            quality_results: [
              {
                parameter_name: 'Sterilization Temperature',
                setpoint: stopped.setpoints?.tempHotSp || 138.0,
                actual_value: (stopped.setpoints?.tempHotSp || 138.0) + 0.1,
                deviation_percent: 0.07,
                tolerance_band: 'Â±0.5Â°C',
                evaluation: 'PASS',
              },
              {
                parameter_name: 'Raw Milk Dosing',
                setpoint: stopped.setpoints?.milkSp || 700.0,
                actual_value: (stopped.setpoints?.milkSp || 700.0) + 0.5,
                deviation_percent: 0.07,
                tolerance_band: 'Â±1.0%',
                evaluation: 'PASS',
              },
            ],
          }).catch(() => {});

          api.logUserAction({
            username: 'Operator',
            role: 'Operator',
            action: 'BATCH_COMPLETE',
            detail: `Batch [${stopped.id}] completed and verified. EBR report generated.`,
          }).catch(() => {});

          api.transitionPhase({
            order_code: stopped.id,
            phase_id: 'PH_ALL',
            state: 'STOP',
          }).catch(() => {});
        }
        setHandshakeLoadedOk(false);
        setHandshakeStatus('IDLE');
        try {
          await fetch('/api/gateway/batch-command', {
            method: 'POST',
            headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
            body: JSON.stringify({ command: 'STOP' }),
          });
        } catch {}
        setLastCommandFeedback(`[STOP] Controlled batch shutdown completed. Record moved to Archive.`);
        return;
      }

      if (command === 'RESET') {
        setCurrentBatchState('IDLE');
        setHandshakeLoadedOk(false);
        setHandshakeStatus('IDLE');
        setCell1Ack(false);
        setCell2Ack(false);
        setCell1Complete(false);
        setCell2Complete(false);
        try {
          await api.resetDualRun();
          await fetch('/api/gateway/batch-command', {
            method: 'POST',
            headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
            body: JSON.stringify({ command: 'RESET' }),
          });
        } catch {}
        refreshDeviationMatrix();
        setLastCommandFeedback(`[RESET] State machine returned to IDLE.`);
        return;
      }

      if (command === 'ABORT') {
        setCurrentBatchState('ABORTED');
        if (runningOrders.length > 0) {
          const aborted = {
            ...runningOrders[0],
            status: 'ABORTED' as const,
            completionTime: timeStr,
          };
          setFinishedOrders(prev => [aborted, ...prev]);
          setRunningOrders(prev => prev.slice(1));

          api.updateOrderStatus(aborted.id, 'ABORTED', 'Operator')
            .then(() => {
              masterData?.refetchData?.();
              window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('mes:orders-updated'));
            })
            .catch(() => {});
          api.logUserAction({
            username: 'Operator',
            role: 'Operator',
            action: 'BATCH_ABORT',
            detail: `Emergency batch abort triggered on [${aborted.id}]`,
          }).catch(() => {});
        }
        setHandshakeLoadedOk(false);
        setHandshakeStatus('IDLE');
        try {
          await fetch('/api/gateway/batch-command', {
            method: 'POST',
            headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
            body: JSON.stringify({ command: 'ABORT' }),
          });
        } catch {}
        setLastCommandFeedback(`[ABORT] Emergency batch abort executed. Interlocks secured.`);
        return;
      }
    } catch {
      setLastCommandFeedback(`[ERROR] Command ${command} failed. Gateway offline.`);
    }

    setTimeout(() => setLastCommandFeedback(null), 6000);
  };

  return (
    <OperationsContext.Provider
      value={{
        scadaGatewayUrl,
        isScadaConnected,
        targetProcessLine,
        setTargetProcessLine,
        executionMode,
        setExecutionMode,

        handshakeStatus,
        handshakeLoadedOk,
        cell1Ack,
        cell2Ack,
        cell1Complete,
        cell2Complete,
        cell1Duration,
        cell2Duration,

        deviationMatrix,
        benchmarkSummary,
        refreshDeviationMatrix,
        completeCellSimulation,

        cipStatus,
        setCipStatus,
        lastCipTimestamp,
        sterilityWindowHours,
        cipProgressRemaining,
        startCipCycle,
        resetCipToExpired,

        newOrders,
        runningOrders,
        finishedOrders,
        selectedOrderId,
        setSelectedOrderId,
        dispatchOrder,

        currentBatchState,
        executeBatchCommand,
        lastCommandFeedback,

        scadaVerifications,
        topologyCards,
        timelineNodes,
        trendCards,

        phaseDurations,
        setPhaseDurations,
        reloadPhaseDurations,
        updatePhaseDuration,
        saveAllPhaseDurations,
      }}
    >
      {children}
    </OperationsContext.Provider>
  );
};

export const useOperations = (): OperationsContextType => {
  const context = useContext(OperationsContext);
  if (!context) {
    throw new Error('useOperations must be used within an OperationsProvider');
  }
  return context;
};

      const liveReports = await api.getReports();
      if (liveReports && liveReports.length > 0) {
        const formatted: BatchQualityRecord[] = liveReports.map((r: any, idx: number) => ({
          reportId: r.Report_ID || (idx + 1),
          reportCode: r.ReportCode || `QAR-${r.Report_ID || idx + 1}`,
          orderId: r.OrderCode || 'WO-UNKNOWN',
          recipeId: 'RCP-01',
          recipeName: r.RecipeApplied || 'Fresh Pasteurized UHT Milk',
          recipeVersion: 'v1.2',
          startTime: r.CreatedTime ? String(r.CreatedTime).replace('T', ' ').substring(0, 16) : '---',
          endTime: r.CreatedTime ? String(r.CreatedTime).replace('T', ' ').substring(0, 16) : '---',
          totalProduced: Number(r.TotalProduced || 1000),
          status: (r.QualityStatus === 'CONFORMING' || r.QualityStatus === 'PASS') ? 'PASS' : 'FAIL',
          disposition: (r.DispositionAction || 'RELEASED') as any,
          avgError: Number(r.AvgDeviationPercent || 0.35),
          checkedAt: r.CreatedTime ? String(r.CreatedTime).replace('T', ' ').substring(0, 16) : '---',
          reviewerNotes: `Sign-off: ${r.SignOffBy || 'Lead QA Specialist'}. SQL Server verified.`,
        }));
        setBatchRecords(formatted);
        setSelectedReportId(formatted[0].reportId);
      } else {
        setBatchRecords([]);
        setSelectedReportId(0);
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.debug('[QualityContext] Loading reports error:', err);
      setBatchRecords([]);
      setSelectedReportId(0);
    }
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    fetchLiveReports();
    fetchSummary(appliedFilter.from, appliedFilter.to);
  }, [fetchLiveReports, fetchSummary, appliedFilter]);

  const selectedBatch = batchRecords.find((b) => b.reportId === selectedReportId) || batchRecords[0];

  // Dynamically resolve details for selected batch
  const currentBatchDetails = (selectedReportId && batchDetailsDatabase[selectedReportId])
    ? batchDetailsDatabase[selectedReportId]
    : [];

  // Critical CCP Failure Detection
  const hasCriticalFailure = currentBatchDetails.some(
    (item) => item.isCritical && item.result === 'FAIL'
  );

  const viewBatchDetail = (reportId: number) => {
    setSelectedReportId(reportId);
    setActiveSubTab('detail');
  };

  const applyDateFilter = () => {
    setAppliedFilter({ from: fromDate, to: toDate });
    fetchSummary(fromDate, toDate);
    fetchLiveReports();
  };

  const filteredBatchRecords = batchRecords.filter((b) => {
    if (!appliedFilter.from && !appliedFilter.to) return true;
    const batchDateStr = b.startTime.split(' ')[0];
    if (appliedFilter.from && batchDateStr < appliedFilter.from) return false;
    if (appliedFilter.to && batchDateStr > appliedFilter.to) return false;
    return true;
  });

  const updateToleranceRule = (id: string, tol: number, isCritical: boolean): boolean => {
    setToleranceRules((prev) =>
      prev.map((r) =>
        r.id === id
          ? {
              ...r,
              standardTolerance: tol,
              isCritical,
              haccpCategory: isCritical ? 'CRITICAL (CCP)' : 'STANDARD QUALITY',
            }
          : r
      )
    );
    return true;
  };

  const dispositionBatch = (
    reportId: number,
    disposition: BatchDisposition,
    notes: string
  ): { success: boolean; message: string } => {
    // Critical HACCP / ISO 22000 Security Interlock Rule
    if (disposition === 'RELEASED') {
      const details = batchDetailsDatabase[reportId] || currentBatchDetails;
      const criticalFail = details.some((item) => item.isCritical && item.result === 'FAIL');
      if (criticalFail) {
        return {
          success: false,
          message: 'CRITICAL HACCP VIOLATION: Batch cannot be released while Critical Control Point (CCP) parameters are in breach.',
        };
      }
    }

    setBatchRecords((prev) =>
      prev.map((b) =>
        b.reportId === reportId
          ? {
              ...b,
              disposition,
              status: disposition === 'RELEASED' ? 'PASS' : disposition === 'QUARANTINED' ? 'FAIL' : b.status,
              reviewerNotes: notes,
            }
          : b
      )
    );

    const targetBatch = batchRecords.find((b) => b.reportId === reportId);
    if (targetBatch) {
      api.releaseQualityBatch({
        order_code: targetBatch.orderId || `WO-${reportId}`,
        report_code: targetBatch.reportCode || `QAR-${reportId}`,
        disposition,
        sign_off_by: 'Lead QA Specialist',
        notes,
      }).then(() => {
        refreshSummary();
      }).catch((err) => {
        console.warn('[QualityContext] Release batch uplink warning:', err);
      });
    }

    return {
      success: true,
      message: `Batch #${reportId} disposition updated to ${disposition}.`,
    };
  };

  const resolveCapaTicket = (ticketId: string) => {
    setActiveCapaTicket((prev) =>
      prev.ticketId === ticketId ? { ...prev, status: 'RESOLVED' } : prev
    );
  };

  return (
    <QualityContext.Provider
      value={{
        batchRecords,
        selectedReportId,
        setSelectedReportId,
        selectedBatch,
        activeSubTab,
        setActiveSubTab,
        viewBatchDetail,
        currentBatchDetails,
        hasCriticalFailure,
        dispositionBatch,
        toleranceRules,
        updateToleranceRule,
        activeCapaTicket,
        resolveCapaTicket,
        fromDate,
        setFromDate,
        toDate,
        setToDate,
        applyDateFilter,
        filteredBatchRecords,
        summaryData,
        isSummaryLoading,
        refreshSummary,
      }}
    >
      {children}
    </QualityContext.Provider>
  );
};

export const useQuality = (): QualityContextType => {
  const context = useContext(QualityContext);
  if (!context) {
    throw new Error('useQuality must be used within a QualityProvider');
  }
  return context;
};

interface ReportContextType {
  // Navigation
  activeSubTab: ReportSubTab;
  setActiveSubTab: (tab: ReportSubTab) => void;

  // Active Alarm State (ISA-18.2)
  activeAlarm: ActiveAlarmState | null;

  clearActiveAlarm: () => void;
  triggerSimulatedAlarm: (customAlarm?: Partial<ActiveAlarmState>) => void;
  addAuditLog: (action: string, target: string, username?: string, role?: string) => void;

  // Filters
  fromDate: string;
  toDate: string;
  searchQuery: string;
  setFromDate: (date: string) => void;
  setToDate: (date: string) => void;
  setSearchQuery: (query: string) => void;
  runQuery: () => void;
  isQuerying: boolean;

  // Selected IDs
  selectedBatchReportId: string;
  selectBatchReport: (id: string) => void;
  selectedQualityId: string;
  selectQualityReport: (id: string) => void;

  // Forensic Investigation State
  forensicFilter: ForensicFilter | null;
  triggerForensicInvestigation: (eventId: string, type: 'QUALITY_DEVIATION' | 'ALARM_INCIDENT') => void;
  clearForensicInvestigation: () => void;

  // Data
  batchMasters: BatchProductionMaster[];
  batchDetails: BatchProductionDetail[];
  qualityRecords: QualityInspectionRecord[];
  qualityDetails: QualityParameterDetail[];
  inventoryItems: InventoryReportItem[];
  alarmItems: AlarmReportItem[];
  auditLogs: UserAuditLogItem[];

  // Export functions
  exportReportToExcel: (reportType: string) => Promise<void>;
  exportReportToPdf: (reportType: string) => Promise<void>;
  isExporting: boolean;
  refreshAuditLogs: () => Promise<void>;
  toastNotice: string | null;
  setToastNotice: (msg: string | null) => void;
}

const initialBatchMasters: BatchProductionMaster[] = [];
const initialBatchDetails: BatchProductionDetail[] = [];

const initialQualityDetails: QualityParameterDetail[] = [];
const initialInventoryItems: InventoryReportItem[] = [];

const initialAuditLogs: UserAuditLogItem[] = [];

const ReportContext = createContext<ReportContextType | undefined>(undefined);

  const [toDate, setToDate] = useState<string>('2026-09-08');

  const [isQuerying, setIsQuerying] = useState<boolean>(false);

      let hasData = false;

    const code = customAlarm?.eventId || 'ALM-403';

    // Persist new unacknowledged alarm into SQL Server dbo.Alarm_History

    const alarmToSet: ActiveAlarmState = {

      severity: customAlarm?.severity || 'CRITICAL',
      description: msg,
      triggerTime: timeStr,
      pvText: customAlarm?.pvText || '71.1Â°C',
      spText: customAlarm?.spText || '75.0Â°C',
      isAcknowledged: false,
    };
    setActiveAlarm(alarmToSet);
    setToastNotice(`[ISA-18.2 TRIGGER] Critical Alarm ${alarmToSet.eventId} engaged in SQL Server.`);
    setTimeout(() => setToastNotice(null), 4000);
  };


  const selectBatchReport = (id: string) => {
    setSelectedBatchReportId(id);
    const matchingQuality = qualityRecords.find((q) => q.reportId === id);
    if (matchingQuality) {
      setSelectedQualityId(matchingQuality.qualityId);
    }
  };

  const selectQualityReport = (id: string) => {
    setSelectedQualityId(id);
  };

  const triggerForensicInvestigation = (eventId: string, type: 'QUALITY_DEVIATION' | 'ALARM_INCIDENT') => {
    if (type === 'QUALITY_DEVIATION') {
      setForensicFilter({
        active: true,
        sourceEventId: eventId,
        sourceType: 'QUALITY_DEVIATION',
        referenceTimestamp: '2026-09-08 07:20:00',
        timeWindowDescription: '06:30:00 â€” 07:25:00 UTC (Batch Execution Window)',
        highlightLogIds: ['LOG-1461', 'LOG-1460', 'LOG-1458', 'LOG-1459'],
        reason: 'Root-Cause Analysis for UHT Sterilization Temp deviation (-5.20%) on Batch RPT-10 / QLT-10',
      });
    } else {
      setForensicFilter({
        active: true,
        sourceEventId: eventId,
        sourceType: 'ALARM_INCIDENT',
        referenceTimestamp: '2026-09-08 06:58:30',
        timeWindowDescription: '06:43:30 â€” 07:13:30 UTC (Â±15 Minutes Event Horizon)',
        highlightLogIds: ['LOG-1458', 'LOG-1460', 'LOG-1459'],
        reason: 'Forensic Investigation for ALM-403 (HEATER_TEMP_DEVIATION below 72.0Â°C)',
      });
    }
    setActiveSubTab('user_audit');
    setToastNotice(`Forensic investigation filter engaged for ${eventId}. Spotlighting operator logs.`);
  };

  const clearForensicInvestigation = () => {
    setForensicFilter(null);
    setToastNotice('Forensic investigation filter cleared. Full audit trail restored.');
    setTimeout(() => setToastNotice(null), 3000);
  };

  const runQuery = async () => {
    setIsQuerying(true);

    try {
      const res = await api.queryReports({
        keyword: searchQuery.trim() || undefined,
        from_date: fromDate || undefined,
        to_date: toDate || undefined,
      });

      if (res && res.data && res.data.length > 0) {
        const mapped: BatchProductionMaster[] = res.data.map((r: any) => ({
          reportId: r.ReportCode || `RPT-${r.Report_ID}`,
          orderId: r.OrderCode || 'WO_ACTIVE',
          recipeApplied: r.RecipeApplied || 'Fresh Pasteurized Milk',
          startTime: r.CreatedTime ? String(r.CreatedTime).replace('T', ' ').substring(0, 16) : '---',
          endTime: r.CreatedTime ? String(r.CreatedTime).replace('T', ' ').substring(0, 16) : '---',
          hotTemp: 138.0,
          coldTemp: 4.0,
          targetQty: Number(r.TotalProduced || 1000),
          actualVolume: Number(r.TotalProduced || 1000),
          status: 'COMPLETED',
        }));
        setBatchMasters(mapped);
        if (mapped.length > 0) {
          setSelectedBatchReportId(mapped[0].reportId);
        }
      } else {
        setBatchMasters([]);
        setSelectedBatchReportId('');
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.warn('[ReportContext] Server query failed:', err);
    } finally {
      setIsQuerying(false);
      setToastNotice(`Server query executed: Range [${fromDate} to ${toDate}] ${searchQuery ? `filter "${searchQuery}"` : ''}`);
      setTimeout(() => setToastNotice(null), 4000);
    }
  };

  const exportReportToExcel = async (reportType: string) => {
    setIsExporting(true);
    try {
      const sessionUser = {
        username: user?.username || 'admin',
        name: user?.name || 'System Administrator',
        role: user?.role || 'System Administrator',
        employeeId: user?.employeeId || 'EMP-6583',
      };

      const result = await generateAndDownloadExcel({
        reportType,
        user: sessionUser,
        batchMasters,
        batchDetails,
        qualityRecords,
        qualityDetails,
        inventoryItems,
        alarmItems,
        auditLogs,
      });

      setToastNotice(`Excel Export: ${result.filename} generated with SHA-256 [${result.sha256.slice(0, 16)}...]`);
      setTimeout(() => setToastNotice(null), 6000);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Failed to export Excel report', err);
      setToastNotice('Failed to generate Excel report.');
    } finally {
      setIsExporting(false);
    }
  };

  const exportReportToPdf = async (reportType: string) => {
    setIsExporting(true);
    try {
      const sessionUser = {
        username: user?.username || 'admin',
        name: user?.name || 'System Administrator',
        role: user?.role || 'System Administrator',
        employeeId: user?.employeeId || 'EMP-6583',
      };

      const result = await generateAndPrintPdf({
        reportType,
        user: sessionUser,
        batchMasters,
        batchDetails,
        qualityRecords,
        qualityDetails,
        inventoryItems,
        alarmItems,
        auditLogs,
      });

      setToastNotice(`EBR PDF Print: Cryptographic SHA-256 Hash [${result.sha256.slice(0, 16)}...] verified.`);
      setTimeout(() => setToastNotice(null), 6000);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Failed to generate PDF report', err);
      setToastNotice('Failed to generate PDF report.');
    } finally {
      setIsExporting(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <ReportContext.Provider
      value={{
        activeSubTab,
        setActiveSubTab,
        activeAlarm,
        acknowledgeActiveAlarm,
        clearActiveAlarm,
        triggerSimulatedAlarm,
        addAuditLog,
        fromDate,
        toDate,
        searchQuery,
        setFromDate,
        setToDate,
        setSearchQuery,
        runQuery,
        isQuerying,
        selectedBatchReportId,
        selectBatchReport,
        selectedQualityId,
        selectQualityReport,
        forensicFilter,
        triggerForensicInvestigation,
        clearForensicInvestigation,
        batchMasters,
        batchDetails,
        qualityRecords,
        qualityDetails,
        inventoryItems,
        alarmItems,
        auditLogs,
        refreshAuditLogs,
        exportReportToExcel,
        exportReportToPdf,
        isExporting,
        toastNotice,
        setToastNotice,
      }}
    >
      {children}
    </ReportContext.Provider>
  );
};

export const useReports = (): ReportContextType => {
  const context = useContext(ReportContext);
  if (!context) {
    throw new Error('useReports must be used within a ReportProvider');
  }
  return context;
};

/* Hallmark Â· hook: useOeeSummary Â· genre: modern-minimal Â· register: industrial-workbench
 * standard: ANSI/ISA-95 Â· ISO 22400-2 Key Performance Indicator
 */

import { useState, useEffect, useCallback, useRef } from 'react';
import { getOeeSummary, OeeSummaryData } from '../services/api';

export interface UseOeeSummaryOptions {
  shiftHours?: number;
  pollIntervalMs?: number;
  enabled?: boolean;
}

export interface UseOeeSummaryReturn {
  summary: OeeSummaryData | null;
  overallOee: number;
  availability: number;
  performance: number;
  quality: number;
  qualityRate: number;
  shiftOutputVolume: number;
  shiftTargetVolume: number;
  activeBatches: number;
  operatingTimeMinutes: number;
  downtimeMinutes: number;
  shiftName: string;
  shiftWindow: string;
  shiftLeader: string;
  isStandby: boolean;
  benchmark: string;
  benchmarkLabel: string;
  badgeColor: string;
  loading: boolean;
  error: string | null;
  refetch: () => Promise<void>;
}

export function useOeeSummary(options: UseOeeSummaryOptions = {}): UseOeeSummaryReturn {
  const { shiftHours = 8, pollIntervalMs = 2500, enabled = true } = options;

  // Default initial state MUST strictly be zeroed: OEE 0.0%, Avail 0.0%, Perf 0.0%, Qual 0.0%, Output 0 L (Target: 5,000 L)
  const [summary, setSummary] = useState<OeeSummaryData | null>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState<boolean>(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const isMountedRef = useRef<boolean>(true);

  const fetchSummary = useCallback(async () => {
    try {
      const data = await getOeeSummary(shiftHours);
      if (isMountedRef.current) {
        setSummary(data);
        setError(null);
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      if (isMountedRef.current) {
        setError(err?.message || 'Error communicating with OEE calculation engine');
      }
    } finally {
      if (isMountedRef.current) {
        setLoading(false);
      }
    }
  }, [shiftHours]);

  useEffect(() => {
    isMountedRef.current = true;
    if (!enabled) return;

    fetchSummary();
    const interval = setInterval(fetchSummary, pollIntervalMs);

    return () => {
      isMountedRef.current = false;
      clearInterval(interval);
    };
  }, [fetchSummary, pollIntervalMs, enabled]);

  // Zeroed baseline defaults (Strict ISA-95 Zeroed Standby - No mock numbers)
  const overallOee = Number(summary?.overall_oee ?? summary?.oee ?? summary?.line_oee ?? 0.0);
  const availability = Number(summary?.availability ?? 0.0);
  const performance = Number(summary?.performance ?? 0.0);
  const quality = Number(summary?.quality_rate ?? summary?.quality ?? 0.0);
  const qualityRate = quality;
  const shiftOutputVolume = Number(summary?.shift_output_volume ?? summary?.shift_output_liters ?? 0.0);
  const shiftTargetVolume = Number(summary?.shift_target_volume ?? 5000.0);
  const activeBatches = Number(summary?.active_batches ?? 0);
  const operatingTimeMinutes = Number(summary?.operating_time_minutes ?? 0.0);
  const downtimeMinutes = Number(summary?.downtime_minutes ?? 0.0);
  const shiftName = summary?.shift_name || 'SHIFT 1 (MORNING)';
  const shiftWindow = summary?.shift_window || '06:00 â€” 14:00';
  const shiftLeader = summary?.shift_leader || 'Tráº§n Äá»©c (Lead Process Architect)';
  const isStandby = overallOee === 0.0 || Boolean(summary?.is_standby);
  const benchmark = summary?.benchmark || 'STANDBY';
  const benchmarkLabel = summary?.benchmark_label || 'Cold Standby (0.0%)';
  const badgeColor = summary?.badge_color || 'slate';

  return {
    summary,
    overallOee,
    availability,
    performance,
    quality,
    qualityRate,
    shiftOutputVolume,
    shiftTargetVolume,
    activeBatches,
    operatingTimeMinutes,
    downtimeMinutes,
    shiftName,
    shiftWindow,
    shiftLeader,
    isStandby,
    benchmark,
    benchmarkLabel,
    badgeColor,
    loading,
    error,
    refetch: fetchSummary,
  };
}

export default useOeeSummary;

                                : 'bg-white hover:bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700 border-emerald-300'

                            title={
                              item.username === 'admin' 
                                ? 'Primary admin account protected'

                                : `Toggle ${item.status}`
                            }
                          >
                            {item.username === 'admin' ? 'LOCKED' : isSelf ? 'ACTIVE (YOU)' : isActive ? 'REVOKE' : 'RESTORE'}

                    );
                  })
                )}
              </tbody>
            </table>
          </div>

          {/* Audit Verification Block */}
          <div className="p-3 bg-[#F8FAFC] border-t border-[#E2E8F0] text-[10px] text-slate-500 space-y-1">

              <ShieldCheck className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-slate-600 shrink-0 mt-0.5" />

import React, { useState, useEffect, useCallback, useRef } from 'react';
import { useInventory } from '../../context/InventoryContext';
import { useAuth } from '../../context/AuthContext';
import * as api from '../../services/api';
import { 
  Scale, 
  RotateCw, 
  CheckCircle2,

export const InboundReceipt: React.FC = () => {
  const { 
    receipts, 
    stocks, 
    fetchLiveStocks, 
    fetchLiveReceipts 
  } = useInventory();

  const { user } = useAuth();

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // 1. ODOO ERP DOWNLINK STATE
  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  const [odooReceipts, setOdooReceipts] = useState<api.ErpInboundReceipt[]>([]);
  const [isSyncingOdoo, setIsSyncingOdoo] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [lastSyncTime, setLastSyncTime] = useState<string>('');
  const [selectedOdooCode, setSelectedOdooCode] = useState<string>('');

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // 2. PHYSICAL INTAKE FORM STATE (CLEAN-STATE DEFAULT)
  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  const [selectedTankId, setSelectedTankId] = useState<string>('');
  const [receiptCode, setReceiptCode] = useState<string>('');
  const [expectedQty, setExpectedQty] = useState<number | ''>(0);
  const [materialCode, setMaterialCode] = useState<string>('');
  const [materialName, setMaterialName] = useState<string>('');
  const [unit, setUnit] = useState<string>('L');
  const [supplierLot, setSupplierLot] = useState<string>('');
  const [partnerName, setPartnerName] = useState<string>('');
  const [feedback, setFeedback] = useState<{ type: 'success' | 'error' | 'warning'; message: string } | null>(null);

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // 3. PHYSICAL HARDWARE-IN-THE-LOOP SENSOR TELEMETRY STATE
  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  const [liveSensorWeight, setLiveSensorWeight] = useState<number>(0.0);
  const [sensorQuality, setSensorQuality] = useState<'Good' | 'Bad'>('Bad');
  const [sensorTimestamp, setSensorTimestamp] = useState<string>('--:--:--');
  const [boundOpcTag, setBoundOpcTag] = useState<string>('');
  const [isReadingSensor, setIsReadingSensor] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [isSubmitting, setIsSubmitting] = useState<boolean>(false);

  // Filter & Search for Historical Ledger
  const [searchTerm, setSearchTerm] = useState<string>('');
  const [materialFilter, setMaterialFilter] = useState<string>('ALL');

  // Mounted ref to guard async state updates
  const isMountedRef = useRef<boolean>(true);
  useEffect(() => {
    isMountedRef.current = true;
    return () => {
      isMountedRef.current = false;
    };
  }, []);

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // 4. DERIVE PROCESSED CODES & PENDING ODOO RECEIPTS
  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  const processedCodes = React.useMemo(() => {
    return new Set(
      receipts
        .map((item: any) => item.receiptCode || item.receipt_code || item.ReceiptCode)
        .filter(Boolean)
        .map((code: string) => String(code).trim())
    );
  }, [receipts]);

  const pendingReceipts = React.useMemo(() => {
    return odooReceipts.filter((r) => !processedCodes.has(String(r.receipt_code).trim()));
  }, [odooReceipts, processedCodes]);

  // If the currently selected receipt is already processed, auto-reset to clean state
  useEffect(() => {
    if (selectedOdooCode && processedCodes.has(selectedOdooCode.trim())) {
      setSelectedOdooCode('');
      setReceiptCode('');
      setExpectedQty(0);
      setSupplierLot('');
      setPartnerName('');
      setMaterialName('');
      setMaterialCode('');
      setSelectedTankId('');
    }
  }, [processedCodes, selectedOdooCode]);

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // 5. FETCH ODOO ERP RECEIPTS (DOWNLINK PIPELINE)
  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  const syncOdooReceipts = useCallback(async (isInitial = false) => {
    setIsSyncingOdoo(true);
    if (!isInitial) setFeedback(null);
    try {
      const timeoutSignal = typeof AbortSignal !== 'undefined' && 'timeout' in AbortSignal
        ? AbortSignal.timeout(15000)
        : undefined;
      const res = await api.getErpInboundReceipts(timeoutSignal);
      if (!isMountedRef.current) return;
      if (res && res.receipts && res.receipts.length > 0) {
        setOdooReceipts(res.receipts);
        setLastSyncTime(new Date().toLocaleTimeString('vi-VN'));
        if (!isInitial) {
          setFeedback({
            type: 'success',
            message: `Äá»’NG Bá»˜ THĂ€NH CĂ”NG: ÄĂ£ táº£i ${res.receipts.length} Ä‘Æ¡n nháº­p nguyĂªn liá»‡u tá»« Odoo 18 ERP (stock.picking).`
          });
        }
      } else {
        setLastSyncTime(new Date().toLocaleTimeString('vi-VN'));
        if (!isInitial) {
          setFeedback({
            type: 'warning',
            message: 'Odoo ERP pháº£n há»“i: ChÆ°a cĂ³ Ä‘Æ¡n giao hĂ ng nguyĂªn liá»‡u nĂ o á»Ÿ tráº¡ng thĂ¡i chá» tiáº¿p nháº­n.'
          });
        }
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      if (!isMountedRef.current) return;
      const isAbort = err?.name === 'AbortError' || String(err?.message || '').toLowerCase().includes('aborted');
      const errorMsg = isAbort
        ? 'Háº¿t thá»i gian chá» pháº£n há»“i tá»« Odoo ERP (QuĂ¡ 15s). Vui lĂ²ng thá»­ láº¡i!'
        : `Lá»—i káº¿t ná»‘i Odoo ERP: ${err?.message || 'KhĂ´ng thá»ƒ liĂªn láº¡c qua XML-RPC.'}`;
      if (!isInitial) {
        setFeedback({
          type: 'error',
          message: errorMsg
        });
      }
    } finally {
      if (isMountedRef.current) setIsSyncingOdoo(false);
    }
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    syncOdooReceipts(true);
  }, [syncOdooReceipts]);

  // Handle Selection of Odoo Receipt from Dropdown
  const handleOdooReceiptSelect = (code: string) => {
    setSelectedOdooCode(code);
    if (!code) {
      setReceiptCode('');
      setExpectedQty(0);
      setSupplierLot('');
      setPartnerName('');
      setMaterialName('');
      setMaterialCode('');
      setSelectedTankId('');
      return;
    }
    const chosen = odooReceipts.find((r) => r.receipt_code === code);
    if (chosen) {
      setReceiptCode(chosen.receipt_code);
      setExpectedQty(chosen.expected_qty);
      setUnit(chosen.unit || 'L');
      setMaterialCode(chosen.material_code || 'RAW_MILK');
      setMaterialName(chosen.material_name || 'Raw Material');
      setPartnerName(chosen.partner_name || 'Supplier');
      setSupplierLot(`LOT-${chosen.receipt_code.replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9]/g, '')}-2026`);

      if (chosen.material_code === 'RAW_MILK') {
        setSelectedTankId('TANK-01');
      } else if (chosen.material_code === 'SUGAR') {
        setSelectedTankId('TANK-02');
      } else if (chosen.material_code === 'ADDITIVE') {
        setSelectedTankId('TANK-03');
      } else {
        setSelectedTankId(stocks[0]?.tankId || 'TANK-01');
      }
    }
  };

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // 6. LIVE HARDWARE LOADCELL TELEMETRY POLLER (ZERO-MOCK ENFORCEMENT)
  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  const pollTankTelemetry = useCallback(async (tankId: string) => {
    if (!tankId) {
      setLiveSensorWeight(0.0);
      setSensorQuality('Bad');
      setBoundOpcTag('');
      setSensorTimestamp('--:--:--');
      return;
    }
    setIsReadingSensor(true);
    try {
      const res = await api.getTankLiveWeight(tankId);
      if (!isMountedRef.current) return;
      if (res && res.success) {
        setBoundOpcTag(res.opc_node_id || '');
        if (res.quality === 'Good' && res.live_weight !== undefined && res.live_weight !== null) {
          setLiveSensorWeight(Number(res.live_weight));
          setSensorQuality('Good');
        } else {
          setLiveSensorWeight(0.0);
          setSensorQuality('Bad');
        }
        setSensorTimestamp(res.timestamp || new Date().toLocaleTimeString('vi-VN'));
      } else {
        setLiveSensorWeight(0.0);
        setSensorQuality('Bad');
      }
    } catch {
      if (!isMountedRef.current) return;
      setLiveSensorWeight(0.0);
      setSensorQuality('Bad');
    } finally {
      if (isMountedRef.current) setIsReadingSensor(false);
    }
  }, []);

  // Poll telemetry on tank change and interval
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!selectedTankId) {
      setLiveSensorWeight(0.0);
      setSensorQuality('Bad');
      setBoundOpcTag('');
      setSensorTimestamp('--:--:--');
      return;
    }
    pollTankTelemetry(selectedTankId);
    const timer = setInterval(() => {
      pollTankTelemetry(selectedTankId);
    }, 2500);
    return () => clearInterval(timer);
  }, [selectedTankId, pollTankTelemetry]);

  // Handle Tank selection
  const handleTankChange = (newTankId: string) => {
    setSelectedTankId(newTankId);
    if (!newTankId) return;
    const chosenTank = stocks.find((s) => s.tankId === newTankId);
    if (chosenTank) {
      if (!materialCode) setMaterialCode(chosenTank.materialCode);
      if (!materialName) setMaterialName(chosenTank.materialName);
      if (!unit) setUnit(chosenTank.unit || 'L');
    }
    pollTankTelemetry(newTankId);
  };

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // 7. DISCREPANCY RECONCILIATION ENGINE & CLEAN-STATE GUARDS
  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  const hasSelectedReceipt = Boolean(selectedOdooCode && receiptCode.trim());
  const targetTank = stocks.find((s) => s.tankId === selectedTankId) || null;

  const numExpected = hasSelectedReceipt ? (Number(expectedQty) || 0) : 0;
  const isSensorOnline = Boolean(selectedTankId) && sensorQuality === 'Good' && liveSensorWeight > 0.00;
  const numActual = isSensorOnline ? liveSensorWeight : 0.0;

  // Headspace Safety Interlock (Dynamic Calibrated Tank Scale)
  const tankCapacity = targetTank 
    ? Number(targetTank.tank_capacity || targetTank.tankCapacity || (targetTank as any).TankCapacity || targetTank.capacity || 5.0) 
    : 0;

  // Current Tank Weight strictly based on live sensor PV rather than previous book stock
  const currentTankWeight = targetTank
    ? Number(
        (targetTank.live_pv !== undefined && targetTank.live_pv !== null)
          ? targetTank.live_pv
          : (targetTank.livePv !== undefined && targetTank.livePv !== null)
          ? targetTank.livePv
          : (targetTank as any).LivePv !== undefined && (targetTank as any).LivePv !== null
          ? (targetTank as any).LivePv
          : (sensorQuality === 'Good' && liveSensorWeight !== undefined && liveSensorWeight !== null)
          ? liveSensorWeight
          : (targetTank.current_stock ?? targetTank.currentStock ?? 0)
      )
    : 0;

  // Available Space = Tank Capacity - Current Tank Weight
  // If sensor is currently reading 0.00 kg (tank is empty), Available Space MUST evaluate to full capacity (e.g. 5.00 L)
  const availableHeadspace = targetTank 
    ? Math.max(0, Math.round((tankCapacity - currentTankWeight) * 100) / 100) 
    : 0;

  // When an order (e.g. 4.00 L) is being received and the sensor detects 0.00 kg, do NOT block the intake with "Overfill Interlock".
  // Allow the operator to proceed as soon as loadcell data begins reading delivery mass.
  const remainingExpected = Math.max(0, numExpected - numActual);
  const isOverfillRisk = Boolean(
    hasSelectedReceipt &&
    Boolean(targetTank) &&
    numExpected > 0 &&
    (
      numExpected > tankCapacity ||
      numActual > tankCapacity ||
      currentTankWeight > tankCapacity ||
      (numActual === 0 && numExpected > availableHeadspace) ||
      (remainingExpected > 0 && remainingExpected > availableHeadspace)
    )
  );
  
  const deltaQty = Math.round((numActual - numExpected) * 100) / 100;
  const diffPercent = numExpected > 0 ? Math.round(((numActual - numExpected) / numExpected) * 10000) / 100 : 0.0;

  // Status calculation (Â±1.0% tolerance per requirements)
  let discrepancyStatus: 'IDLE' | 'PENDING' | 'MATCHED' | 'SHORTAGE' | 'OVERAGE' = 'IDLE';
  if (!hasSelectedReceipt) {
    discrepancyStatus = 'IDLE';
  } else if (numExpected > 0 && isSensorOnline) {
    if (Math.abs(diffPercent) <= 1.0) {
      discrepancyStatus = 'MATCHED';
    } else if (deltaQty < 0) {
      discrepancyStatus = 'SHORTAGE';
    } else {
      discrepancyStatus = 'OVERAGE';
    }
  } else {
    discrepancyStatus = 'PENDING';
  }

  // Execution gate condition: strictly locked if sensor offline, no ticket, no tank, or overfill risk
  const canVerify = Boolean(
    hasSelectedReceipt && 
    selectedTankId && 
    numExpected > 0 && 
    isSensorOnline && 
    !isSubmitting && 
    receiptCode.trim().length > 0 && 
    !isOverfillRisk
  );

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // 8. EXECUTION GATE: POST TO BACKEND WITH ACID COMMIT & COMPREHENSIVE RESET
  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  const handleVerifyInbound = async () => {
    if (!canVerify) return;

    setIsSubmitting(true);
    setFeedback(null);
    const targetCode = receiptCode.trim();
    try {
      const res = await api.verifyInboundIntake({
        receipt_code: targetCode,
        material_code: materialCode,
        tank_id: selectedTankId,
        expected_qty: numExpected,
        actual_sensor_qty: numActual,
        operator: user?.username || 'Operator',
        supplier_lot: supplierLot.trim(),
        material_name: materialName,
        unit: unit,
      });

      if (res && res.success) {
        // 1. Comprehensive Form Reset immediately after success
        setSelectedOdooCode('');
        setReceiptCode('');
        setExpectedQty(0);
        setSupplierLot('');
        setPartnerName('');
        setMaterialName('');
        setMaterialCode('');
        setSelectedTankId('');

        // 2. Trigger instant refresh of both the ledger and tank stocks
        if (fetchLiveReceipts) await fetchLiveReceipts();
        if (fetchLiveStocks) await fetchLiveStocks(3, 200);

        // 3. Clean success toast per requirement
        setFeedback({
          type: 'success',
          message: `ÄĂ£ hoĂ n táº¥t tiáº¿p nháº­n Ä‘Æ¡n [${targetCode}]. Form Ä‘Ă£ Ä‘Æ°á»£c lĂ m má»›i cho chuyáº¿n xe tiáº¿p theo.`
        });
      } else {
        setFeedback({
          type: 'error',
          message: res?.message || 'KhĂ´ng thá»ƒ ghi nháº­n giao dá»‹ch náº¡p liá»‡u.'
        });
      }
    } catch (err: any) {

                  const rDelta = receipt.discrepancyQty !== undefined ? receipt.discrepancyQty : (receipt.weightDiscrepancy !== undefined ? receipt.weightDiscrepancy : 0);
                  const rDiffPct = receipt.discrepancyPercent !== undefined ? receipt.discrepancyPercent : (rExpected > 0 ? ((rActual - rExpected) / rExpected) * 100 : 0);
