                      </td>

                      {/* 5. CĂ¢n Cáº£m Biáº¿n (kg) */}
                      <td className="py-2 px-3 border-r border-slate-200 text-right font-bold text-emerald-800 tabular-nums">
                        {rActual.toLocaleString(undefined, { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 })}
                      </td>

                      {/* 6. ChĂªnh Lá»‡ch (Î” kg) */}
                      <td className={`py-2 px-3 border-r border-slate-200 text-right font-bold tabular-nums ${
                        rDelta === 0 ? 'text-slate-500' : rDelta > 0 ? 'text-sky-700' : 'text-amber-700'
                      }`}>
                        {rDelta > 0 ? `+${rDelta.toFixed(2)}` : rDelta.toFixed(2)}
                      </td>

                      <td className="py-2 px-3 text-center text-slate-700 font-medium">

                    </tr>

            </tbody>

        {/* Table Footer */}
        <div className="p-3 bg-slate-50 border-t border-slate-200 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between text-[10px] text-slate-500 font-mono">
          <div>
            <span>Äá»I SOĂT Táº¢I TRá»ŒNG Cáº¢M BIáº¾N: <strong className="text-slate-800">DUNG SAI CHáº¤P NHáº¬N Â±1.0% (ISA-95 LEVEL 3 MOM)</strong></span>

import * as api from '../../services/api';
import { 
  EquipmentType, 
  EquipmentLocation, 
  EquipmentPerformanceItem 
} from '../../types/equipment';
import { SensorMappingModal } from '../../components/maintenance/SensorMappingModal';
import { 
  Cpu, 
  Search, 
  Plus, 
  Save, 
  Trash2, 
  CheckCircle2,

export interface EquipmentManagementProps {
  onDispatchToPreventive?: (eqCode: string) => void;
}

const EQUIPMENT_TYPES: EquipmentType[] = [
  'Centrifugal Pump',
  'Mixing Motor',
  'Heat Exchanger',
  'Valve',
  'Chiller',
  'Dosing Pump',
  'Mixing Agitator',
  'Heating Resistor',
  'Chilling Unit',
  'Solenoid Valve',
  'RTD Sensor',
];

const LOCATIONS: EquipmentLocation[] = [
  'Line 1 - Mixing Unit',
  'Line 2 - Sterilize Unit',
  'Utility Area',
];

export const EquipmentManagement: React.FC<EquipmentManagementProps> = ({ onDispatchToPreventive }) => {
  const { user } = useAuth();
  const isAdmin = (user?.role?.toUpperCase() === 'ADMIN') || (user?.username?.toLowerCase() === 'admin');

  const {
    equipmentList,
    selectedEquipmentId,

  // Search & Filter state

  // Live Performance Telemetry State (ISO 10816 / Kepware)
  const [performanceMap, setPerformanceMap] = useState<Record<string, EquipmentPerformanceItem>>({});
  const [isPerfLoading, setIsPerfLoading] = useState<boolean>(false);

  const [isDeleting, setIsDeleting] = useState<boolean>(false);

  const [formName, setFormName] = useState('');

  const [formMaintenanceLimit, setFormMaintenanceLimit] = useState<number>(500);

  const [toastMessage, setToastMessage] = useState<{ text: string; type: 'success' | 'error' | 'warning' } | null>(null);

    setToastMessage({ text, type });

      if (res && res.data) {
        const pMap: Record<string, EquipmentPerformanceItem> = {};
        res.data.forEach((item: EquipmentPerformanceItem) => {
          pMap[item.equipment_code.toUpperCase()] = item;
        });
        setPerformanceMap(pMap);
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.warn('[EquipmentManagement] Live performance fetch notice:', err);
    } finally {
      setIsPerfLoading(false);
    }
  }, []);

    const interval = setInterval(fetchPerformance, 3000);
    return () => clearInterval(interval);

      return;
    }

    setIsSubmitting(true);

        setIsNewEntryMode(false);

      } else {

          equipment_name: formName.trim(),
          equipment_type: formType,
          location: formLocation,
          maintenance_limit: Number(formMaintenanceLimit) || 500,
          rated_current: Number(formRatedCurrent) || 10.0,
          max_vibration: Number(formMaxVib) || 4.5,
          max_temp: Number(formMaxTemp) || 75.0,
          notes: formNotes.trim(),
          user: user?.username || 'admin',
          role: user?.role || 'ADMIN',
        });
        showToast(res.message || `ÄĂ£ cáº­p nháº­t thĂ´ng tin thiáº¿t bá»‹ [${formCode.toUpperCase()}] thĂ nh cĂ´ng!`, 'success');
      }

    } catch (err: any) {
      showToast(err.message || 'Lá»—i khi lÆ°u thĂ´ng tin thiáº¿t bá»‹.', 'error');
    } finally {
      setIsSubmitting(false);
    }

  const handleOpenDeleteModal = () => {

    const isRunning = (perf?.current_status === 'RUNNING') || (perf?.status === 'RUNNING');

    if (isRunning) {

        user?.username || 'admin'

  return (

              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setDeleteModalOpen(false)}
                disabled={isDeleting}
                className="h-9 px-4 bg-white border border-slate-300 hover:bg-slate-100 text-slate-700 font-semibold text-xs uppercase tracking-wider rounded-xs hallmark-focus shadow-xs"
              >
                Há»¦Y Bá»
              </button>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={handleConfirmDelete}
                disabled={isDeleting}
                className="h-9 px-4 bg-rose-600 hover:bg-rose-700 disabled:bg-rose-300 text-white font-semibold text-xs uppercase tracking-wider flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-xs hallmark-focus shadow-xs"
              >
                <Trash2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                <span>{isDeleting ? 'ÄANG XĂ“A...' : 'XĂC NHáº¬N XĂ“A'}</span>
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

export const EquipmentInventory = EquipmentManagement;
export default EquipmentManagement;

  const [localDurations, setLocalDurations] = useState<PhaseDurationsMap>({
    cell1_physical: {},
    cell2_simit: {},
  });
  const [isSaving, setIsSaving] = useState(false);
  const [toastMessage, setToastMessage] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [toastType, setToastType] = useState<'success' | 'error'>('success');

  // Copy current context phase durations into local edit buffer whenever opened
  useEffect(() => {
    if (isOpen) {
      const initCell1: Record<string, number> = {};
      CELL1_PHASE_DEFS.forEach((def) => {
        initCell1[def.code] = phaseDurations.cell1_physical[def.code] ?? def.defaultMin;
      });

      const initCell2: Record<string, number> = {};
      CELL2_PHASE_DEFS.forEach((def) => {
        initCell2[def.code] = phaseDurations.cell2_simit[def.code] ?? def.defaultMin;
      });

      setLocalDurations({
        cell1_physical: initCell1,
        cell2_simit: initCell2,
      });
      setToastMessage(null);
    }
  }, [isOpen, phaseDurations]);

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  const handleDurationChange = (cell: 'cell1_physical' | 'cell2_simit', code: string, val: number) => {
    const clamped = Math.max(0.5, Math.min(120.0, Number(val)));
    setLocalDurations((prev) => ({
      ...prev,
      [cell]: {
        ...prev[cell],
        [code]: clamped,
      },

  };

    if (activeTab === 'cell1') {

      });

      setToastType('success');

import React, { useState, useEffect, useCallback } from 'react';

interface SparklineProps {
  card: ProcessTrendCard;
}

const TrendChart: React.FC<SparklineProps> = ({ card }) => {
  const width = 280;
  const height = 90;
  const padding = 10;

  const points = card.dataPoints;
  if (points.length < 2) return null;

  const minVal = card.min;
  const maxVal = card.max;
  const range = maxVal - minVal || 1;

  const getY = (val: number) => {
    const clampedVal = Math.max(minVal, Math.min(maxVal, val));
    const norm = (clampedVal - minVal) / range;
    return height - padding - norm * (height - 2 * padding);
  };

  const getX = (index: number) => {
    return padding + (index / (points.length - 1)) * (width - 2 * padding);
  };

  const spPath = points
    .map((pt, idx) => `${idx === 0 ? 'M' : 'L'} ${getX(idx).toFixed(1)} ${getY(pt.sp).toFixed(1)}`)
    .join(' ');

  const pvPath = points
    .map((pt, idx) => `${idx === 0 ? 'M' : 'L'} ${getX(idx).toFixed(1)} ${getY(pt.pv).toFixed(1)}`)
    .join(' ');

  const errorOffset = Math.abs(card.currentPv - card.currentSp);
  const isOffsetHigh = errorOffset > (card.max - card.min) * 0.05;

  return (
    <div className="bg-white border border-slate-200 p-3.5 shadow-xs flex flex-col justify-between font-mono">
      {/* Card Header: Title & Cell */}
      <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-2 border-b border-slate-200 pb-2">
        <div>
          <h3 className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-900 truncate font-mono not-italic" title={card.title}>
            {card.title}
          </h3>
          <div className="text-[10px] text-slate-500 font-mono">{card.cell}</div>
        </div>
        <span className="text-[9px] px-1.5 py-0.5 bg-slate-100 border border-slate-300 text-slate-700 font-semibold font-mono">
          {card.unit}
        </span>
      </div>

      {/* SVG Process Curve */}
      <div className="my-2 bg-slate-50 border border-slate-200 p-1 relative flex items-center justify-center">
        <svg viewBox={`0 0 ${width} ${height}`} className="w-full h-24 overflow-visible">
          <line x1={padding} y1={padding} x2={width - padding} y2={padding} stroke="#E2E8F0" strokeWidth="1" strokeDasharray="2 2" />
          <line x1={padding} y1={height / 2} x2={width - padding} y2={height / 2} stroke="#E2E8F0" strokeWidth="1" strokeDasharray="2 2" />
          <line x1={padding} y1={height - padding} x2={width - padding} y2={height - padding} stroke="#E2E8F0" strokeWidth="1" strokeDasharray="2 2" />

          {/* SP: Blue Dashed Line */}
          <path
            d={spPath}
            fill="none"
            stroke="#2563EB"
            strokeWidth="1.5"
            strokeDasharray="4 3"
          />

          {/* PV: Solid Emerald Line */}
          <path
            d={pvPath}
            fill="none"
            stroke="#16A34A"
            strokeWidth="2"
          />

          {/* Current PV marker circle */}
          <circle
            cx={getX(points.length - 1)}
            cy={getY(card.currentPv)}
            r="3"
            fill="#16A34A"
          />
        </svg>

        <span className="absolute top-1 left-2 text-[8px] text-slate-400 font-mono">
          MAX: {card.max} {card.unit}
        </span>
        <span className="absolute bottom-1 left-2 text-[8px] text-slate-400 font-mono">
          MIN: {card.min} {card.unit}
        </span>
      </div>

      {/* Numerical Metrics Bar */}
      <div className="pt-2 border-t border-slate-200 grid grid-cols-3 gap-1 text-[11px] font-mono">
        <div>
          <span className="text-[9px] text-slate-500 block uppercase">SP (MES)</span>
          <span className="font-bold text-blue-700">
            {card.currentSp.toFixed(1)}
          </span>
        </div>

        <div>
          <span className="text-[9px] text-slate-500 block uppercase">PV (ACTUAL)</span>
          <span className="font-bold text-emerald-700">
            {card.currentPv.toFixed(1)}
          </span>
        </div>

        <div className="text-right">
          <span className="text-[9px] text-slate-500 block uppercase">OFFSET</span>
          <span className={`font-bold ${isOffsetHigh ? 'text-amber-700' : 'text-slate-700'}`}>
            {errorOffset.toFixed(2)}
          </span>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

  const [searchTableQuery, setSearchTableQuery] = useState<string>('');

  const fetchHistorianData = useCallback(async (orderCode: string) => {
    setIsLoadingHistorian(true);
    try {
      const [telemetryRows, spRows] = await Promise.all([
        getHistorianDatalog(orderCode),
        getSetpointMonitoring(),
      ]);
      setHistoricalData(telemetryRows || []);
      setSetpointLogs(spRows || []);
    } catch (err) {
      console.warn('Failed to load historian data from SQL Server:', err);
    } finally {
      setIsLoadingHistorian(false);
    }
  }, []);

  // Fetch when switching to historian tab
  useEffect(() => {
    if (telemetryMode === 'historian') {
      fetchHistorianData(targetOrderCode);

  }, [telemetryMode, targetOrderCode, fetchHistorianData]);

  // Group historical data by tag for chart rendering
  const groupedByTag: Record<string, DatalogPoint[]> = {};
  historicalData.forEach((pt) => {
    if (!groupedByTag[pt.TagName]) {
      groupedByTag[pt.TagName] = [];
    }
    groupedByTag[pt.TagName].push(pt);

    const matchTag = filterTag === 'ALL' || pt.TagName === filterTag;

      searchTableQuery === '' ||

      pt.ReadTime.toLowerCase().includes(searchTableQuery.toLowerCase()) ||
      String(pt.Value).includes(searchTableQuery);

    if (historicalData.length === 0) return;

      d.Value,
      `"${d.Unit || ''}"`,
      d.ReadTime,
    ]);
    const csvContent = 'data:text/csv;charset=utf-8,' + [headers.join(','), ...rows.map((e) => e.join(','))].join('\n');
    const encodedUri = encodeURI(csvContent);
    const link = document.createElement('a');
    link.setAttribute('href', encodedUri);
    link.setAttribute('download', `MES_PLC_Datalog_${targetOrderCode}_${new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10)}.csv`);
    document.body.appendChild(link);
    link.click();
    document.body.removeChild(link);
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4 font-mono text-xs">
      {/* Sub-view Header & Mode Switcher */}
      <div className="bg-white border border-slate-200 px-5 py-3.5 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3 shadow-xs">

              Äá»“ng bá»™ dá»¯ liá»‡u thá»i gian thá»±c vĂ  trĂ­ch xuáº¥t lá»‹ch sá»­ quĂ¡ trĂ¬nh tá»« SQL Server (dbo.PLC_Datalog).

import React, { useState, useEffect, useCallback, useMemo } from 'react';
import {
  Layers,
  Plus,
  RefreshCw,
  Search,
  CheckCircle2,
  AlertTriangle,
  Zap,
  Edit2,
  Trash2,
  Check,
  X,
  Copy,
  ChevronRight,
  ChevronDown,
  Cpu,
  Box,
  FolderOpen
} from 'lucide-react';
import {
  getIsa88Hierarchy,
  createCustomIsa88Tag,
  createIsa88Unit,
  createIsa88Module,
  deleteIsa88Unit,
  deleteIsa88Module,
  deleteIsa88Tag,
  updateTagNodeId,
  testBulkKepwareNodes,
  getAssetTemplates,
  autoGenerateIsa88Unit,
  Isa88HierarchyUnit,
  Isa88HierarchyModule,
  Isa88HierarchyTag,
  AssetTemplate
} from '../services/api';

type SelectionContext = {
  type: 'unit' | 'module';
  unitId: string;
  unitName: string;
  emId?: string;
  emName?: string;
};

export const Isa88Model: React.FC = () => {
  // Hierarchy Data State
  const [hierarchy, setHierarchy] = useState<Isa88HierarchyUnit[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState<boolean>(true);
  const [refreshing, setRefreshing] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [errorMessage, setErrorMessage] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [successBanner, setSuccessBanner] = useState<string | null>(null);

  // Tree Navigation State
  const [expandedUnits, setExpandedUnits] = useState<Set<string>>(new Set());
  const [treeSearch, setTreeSearch] = useState<string>('');
  const [selectedContext, setSelectedContext] = useState<SelectionContext | null>(null);

  // Tag Search & Probe State
  const [tagSearch, setTagSearch] = useState<string>('');
  const [isProbing, setIsProbing] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [probeResults, setProbeResults] = useState<
    Record<string, { quality: 'Good' | 'Bad'; value: any; error: string | null }>
  >({});

  // Inline Node ID Editing
  const [editingTagName, setEditingTagName] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [editingNodeIdValue, setEditingNodeIdValue] = useState<string>('');
  const [isSavingNodeId, setIsSavingNodeId] = useState<boolean>(false);

  // Add Custom Tag Form Drawer State
  const [isCustomTagFormOpen, setIsCustomTagFormOpen] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [customTagName, setCustomTagName] = useState<string>('');
  const [customNodeId, setCustomNodeId] = useState<string>('');
  const [customRole, setCustomRole] = useState<string>('PV');
  const [customDataType, setCustomDataType] = useState<string>('Float');
  const [customUnit, setCustomUnit] = useState<string>('L');
  const [customDescription, setCustomDescription] = useState<string>('');
  const [isSubmittingTag, setIsSubmittingTag] = useState<boolean>(false);

  // Add Unit Form State
  const [isAddUnitOpen, setIsAddUnitOpen] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [newUnitCode, setNewUnitCode] = useState<string>('');
  const [newUnitName, setNewUnitName] = useState<string>('');
  const [newUnitType, setNewUnitType] = useState<string>('TANK');
  const [isSubmittingUnit, setIsSubmittingUnit] = useState<boolean>(false);

  // Add Module Form State
  const [isAddModuleOpen, setIsAddModuleOpen] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [newModuleCode, setNewModuleCode] = useState<string>('');
  const [newModuleName, setNewModuleName] = useState<string>('');
  const [newModuleDesc, setNewModuleDesc] = useState<string>('');
  const [isSubmittingModule, setIsSubmittingModule] = useState<boolean>(false);

  // Auto-Generate Unit Modal State
  const [isAutoModalOpen, setIsAutoModalOpen] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [templates, setTemplates] = useState<AssetTemplate[]>([]);
  const [selectedTemplateId, setSelectedTemplateId] = useState<string>('');
  const [autoUnitCode, setAutoUnitCode] = useState<string>('');
  const [autoUnitName, setAutoUnitName] = useState<string>('');
  const [autoPrefix, setAutoPrefix] = useState<string>('');
  const [isGeneratingUnit, setIsGeneratingUnit] = useState<boolean>(false);

  // Clipboard copy state
  const [copiedKey, setCopiedKey] = useState<string | null>(null);

  // Load Full Hierarchy
  const loadHierarchyData = useCallback(async (isManual: boolean = false) => {
    if (isManual) {
      setRefreshing(true);
    } else {
      setLoading(true);
    }
    setErrorMessage(null);

    try {
      const data = await getIsa88Hierarchy();
      setHierarchy(data);

      // Auto-expand all units by default for intuitive browsing
      setExpandedUnits(new Set(data.map((u) => u.unit_id)));

      // If no active context, select first unit or module
      setSelectedContext((prev) => {
        if (prev) {
          // Check if previously selected still exists
          const unitExists = data.find((u) => u.unit_id === prev.unitId);
          if (unitExists) {
            if (prev.type === 'module') {
              const emExists = unitExists.equipment_modules.find((em) => em.em_id === prev.emId);
              if (emExists) return prev;
            }
            return {
              type: 'unit',
              unitId: unitExists.unit_id,
              unitName: unitExists.unit_name
            };
          }
        }
        if (data.length > 0) {
          const firstUnit = data[0];
          if (firstUnit.equipment_modules.length > 0) {
            const firstEm = firstUnit.equipment_modules[0];
            return {
              type: 'module',
              unitId: firstUnit.unit_id,
              unitName: firstUnit.unit_name,
              emId: firstEm.em_id,
              emName: firstEm.em_name
            };
          }
          return {
            type: 'unit',
            unitId: firstUnit.unit_id,
            unitName: firstUnit.unit_name
          };
        }
        return null;
      });
    } catch (err: any) {
      setErrorMessage(err.message || 'KhĂ´ng thá»ƒ táº£i cĂ¢y phĂ¢n cáº¥p ISA-88 tá»« cÆ¡ sá»Ÿ dá»¯ liá»‡u');
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
      setRefreshing(false);
    }
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    loadHierarchyData();
    getAssetTemplates()
      .then((t) => {
        setTemplates(t);
        if (t.length > 0) setSelectedTemplateId(t[0].template_id);
      })
      .catch(() => {});
  }, [loadHierarchyData]);

  // Toggle unit expand/collapse
  const toggleUnitExpand = (unitId: string) => {
    setExpandedUnits((prev) => {
      const next = new Set(prev);
      if (next.has(unitId)) {
        next.delete(unitId);
      } else {
        next.add(unitId);
      }
      return next;
    });
  };

  // Select Unit Context
  const handleSelectUnit = (unit: Isa88HierarchyUnit) => {
    setSelectedContext({
      type: 'unit',
      unitId: unit.unit_id,
      unitName: unit.unit_name
    });
    setIsCustomTagFormOpen(false);
  };

  // Select Module Context
  const handleSelectModule = (unit: Isa88HierarchyUnit, em: Isa88HierarchyModule) => {
    setSelectedContext({
      type: 'module',
      unitId: unit.unit_id,
      unitName: unit.unit_name,
      emId: em.em_id,
      emName: em.em_name
    });
    // Auto prefill node id pattern
    const prefix = `ns=2;s=MilkPlant.${unit.unit_id}.${em.em_id}.`;
    setCustomNodeId(prefix);
    setIsCustomTagFormOpen(false);
  };

  // Open custom tag drawer and prefill
  const handleOpenCustomTagDrawer = () => {
    if (!selectedContext) return;
    const emPart = selectedContext.emId || 'MAIN';
    setCustomTagName(`${selectedContext.unitId}_`);
    setCustomNodeId(`ns=2;s=MilkPlant.${selectedContext.unitId}.${emPart}.`);
    setCustomRole('PV');
    setCustomDataType('Float');
    setCustomUnit('L');
    setCustomDescription('');
    setIsCustomTagFormOpen(true);
  };

  // Submit Custom Tag
  const handleSubmitCustomTag = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!selectedContext) return;
    if (!customTagName.trim() || !customNodeId.trim()) {
      setErrorMessage('Vui lĂ²ng nháº­p TĂªn Tag vĂ  Kepware Node ID');
      return;
    }

    setIsSubmittingTag(true);
    setErrorMessage(null);

    const targetEmId =
      selectedContext.emId || `EM_${selectedContext.unitId}_MAIN`;

    try {
      await createCustomIsa88Tag({
        unit_id: selectedContext.unitId,
        em_id: targetEmId,
        tag_name: customTagName.trim(),
        node_id: customNodeId.trim(),
        data_type: customDataType,
        unit: customUnit.trim(),
        role: customRole,
        description: customDescription.trim() || `${selectedContext.unitId} ${targetEmId} ${customTagName}`
      });

      setSuccessBanner(`ÄĂ£ thĂªm Tag Ä‘áº·c thĂ¹ '${customTagName}' thĂ nh cĂ´ng vĂ o SQL Server & Kepware.`);
      setIsCustomTagFormOpen(false);
      await loadHierarchyData(true);
      setTimeout(() => setSuccessBanner(null), 5000);
    } catch (err: any) {
      setErrorMessage(err.message || 'Lá»—i khi lÆ°u Custom Tag');
    } finally {
      setIsSubmittingTag(false);
    }
  };

  // Submit New Unit
  const handleSubmitNewUnit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!newUnitCode.trim()) return;
    setIsSubmittingUnit(true);
    try {
      await createIsa88Unit({
        unit_code: newUnitCode.trim().toUpperCase(),
        unit_name: newUnitName.trim() || `Unit ${newUnitCode.trim().toUpperCase()}`,
        unit_type: newUnitType
      });
      setSuccessBanner(`ÄĂ£ táº¡o Unit '${newUnitCode.toUpperCase()}' thĂ nh cĂ´ng.`);
      setIsAddUnitOpen(false);
      setNewUnitCode('');
      setNewUnitName('');
      await loadHierarchyData(true);
      setTimeout(() => setSuccessBanner(null), 5000);
    } catch (err: any) {
      setErrorMessage(err.message || 'Lá»—i khi táº¡o Unit');
    } finally {
      setIsSubmittingUnit(false);
    }
  };

  // Submit New Module
  const handleSubmitNewModule = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!selectedContext || !newModuleCode.trim()) return;
    setIsSubmittingModule(true);
    try {
      const code = newModuleCode.trim().toUpperCase();
      const emCode = code.startsWith('EM_') ? code : `EM_${selectedContext.unitId}_${code}`;
      await createIsa88Module({
        unit_code: selectedContext.unitId,
        em_code: emCode,
        em_name: newModuleName.trim() || emCode,
        description: newModuleDesc.trim()
      });
      setSuccessBanner(`ÄĂ£ thĂªm Equipment Module '${emCode}' vĂ o Unit '${selectedContext.unitId}'.`);
      setIsAddModuleOpen(false);
      setNewModuleCode('');
      setNewModuleName('');
      setNewModuleDesc('');
      await loadHierarchyData(true);
      setTimeout(() => setSuccessBanner(null), 5000);
    } catch (err: any) {
      setErrorMessage(err.message || 'Lá»—i khi táº¡o Module');
    } finally {
      setIsSubmittingModule(false);
    }
  };

  // Auto Generate Unit Submit
  const handleAutoGenerateSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!autoUnitCode.trim() || !selectedTemplateId) return;
    setIsGeneratingUnit(true);
    try {
      await autoGenerateIsa88Unit({
        template_id: selectedTemplateId,
        unit_code: autoUnitCode.trim().toUpperCase(),
        unit_name: autoUnitName.trim() || `Unit ${autoUnitCode.trim().toUpperCase()}`,
        kepware_channel_device: autoPrefix.trim() || `MilkPlant.${autoUnitCode.trim().toUpperCase()}`
      });
      setSuccessBanner(`ÄĂ£ khá»Ÿi táº¡o tá»± Ä‘á»™ng Unit '${autoUnitCode.toUpperCase()}' thĂ nh cĂ´ng.`);
      setIsAutoModalOpen(false);
      setAutoUnitCode('');
      setAutoUnitName('');
      setAutoPrefix('');
      await loadHierarchyData(true);
      setTimeout(() => setSuccessBanner(null), 5000);
    } catch (err: any) {
      setErrorMessage(err.message || 'Lá»—i khi khá»Ÿi táº¡o tá»± Ä‘á»™ng');
    } finally {
      setIsGeneratingUnit(false);
    }
  };

  // Delete Unit
  const handleDeleteUnit = async (unitId: string) => {
    if (!window.confirm(`XĂ¡c nháº­n xĂ³a Unit [${unitId}] vĂ  táº¥t cáº£ cĂ¡c Tag trá»±c thuá»™c khá»i SQL Server?`)) return;
    try {
      await deleteIsa88Unit(unitId);
      setSuccessBanner(`ÄĂ£ xĂ³a Unit '${unitId}'.`);
      await loadHierarchyData(true);
      setTimeout(() => setSuccessBanner(null), 5000);
    } catch (err: any) {
      setErrorMessage(err.message || 'Lá»—i khi xĂ³a Unit');
    }
  };

  // Delete Module
  const handleDeleteModule = async (emCode: string) => {
    if (!window.confirm(`XĂ¡c nháº­n xĂ³a Module [${emCode}] vĂ  cĂ¡c Tag liĂªn quan?`)) return;
    try {
      await deleteIsa88Module(emCode);
      setSuccessBanner(`ÄĂ£ xĂ³a Module '${emCode}'.`);
      await loadHierarchyData(true);
      setTimeout(() => setSuccessBanner(null), 5000);
    } catch (err: any) {
      setErrorMessage(err.message || 'Lá»—i khi xĂ³a Module');
    }
  };

  // Delete Tag
  const handleDeleteTag = async (tagName: string) => {
    if (!window.confirm(`XĂ¡c nháº­n xĂ³a Tag '${tagName}'?`)) return;
    try {
      await deleteIsa88Tag(tagName);
      setSuccessBanner(`ÄĂ£ xĂ³a Tag '${tagName}'.`);
      await loadHierarchyData(true);
      setTimeout(() => setSuccessBanner(null), 5000);
    } catch (err: any) {
      setErrorMessage(err.message || 'Lá»—i khi xĂ³a Tag');
    }
  };

  // Inline Node ID Edit Save
  const handleSaveNodeId = async (tagName: string) => {
    if (!editingNodeIdValue.trim()) return;
    setIsSavingNodeId(true);
    try {
      await updateTagNodeId(tagName, editingNodeIdValue.trim());
      setSuccessBanner('Cáº­p nháº­t Ă¡nh xáº¡ thĂ nh cĂ´ng vĂ  Ä‘Ă£ lÆ°u CSDL!');
      setEditingTagName(null);
      await loadHierarchyData(true);
      setTimeout(() => setSuccessBanner(null), 5000);
    } catch (err: any) {
      setErrorMessage(err.message || 'Lá»—i khi cáº­p nháº­t Node ID');
    } finally {
      setIsSavingNodeId(false);
    }
  };

  // Probe single node
  const handleProbeNode = async (nodeId: string) => {
    if (!nodeId) return;
    try {
      const res = await testBulkKepwareNodes([nodeId]);
      if (res.results && res.results[nodeId]) {
        setProbeResults((prev) => ({
          ...prev,
          [nodeId]: res.results[nodeId]
        }));
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      setErrorMessage(err.message || 'KhĂ´ng thá»ƒ thÄƒm dĂ² Node');
    }
  };

  // Probe all tags in current context
  const handleProbeCurrentContext = async () => {
    const targetTags = activeContextTags;
    if (targetTags.length === 0) return;
    setIsProbing(true);
    try {
      const nodeIds = targetTags.map((t) => t.node_id).filter(Boolean);
      const res = await testBulkKepwareNodes(nodeIds);
      setProbeResults((prev) => ({
        ...prev,
        ...(res.results || {})
      }));
      setSuccessBanner(`ÄĂ£ hoĂ n táº¥t thÄƒm dĂ² ${res.total_probed} Kepware Node.`);
      setTimeout(() => setSuccessBanner(null), 5000);
    } catch (err: any) {
      setErrorMessage(err.message || 'Lá»—i thÄƒm dĂ² Kepware Gateway');
    } finally {
      setIsProbing(false);
    }
  };

  // Copy to clipboard
  const handleCopy = (text: string, key: string) => {
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(text);
    setCopiedKey(key);
    setTimeout(() => setCopiedKey(null), 2000);
  };

  // Active Context Tags List
  const activeContextTags = useMemo(() => {
    if (!selectedContext) return [];
    const unit = hierarchy.find((u) => u.unit_id === selectedContext.unitId);
    if (!unit) return [];

    let rawTags: Isa88HierarchyTag[] = [];
    if (selectedContext.type === 'unit') {
      // Return all tags under all modules of this unit
      unit.equipment_modules.forEach((em) => {
        rawTags.push(...em.tags);
      });
    } else if (selectedContext.type === 'module' && selectedContext.emId) {
      // Return tags only for this specific module
      const em = unit.equipment_modules.find((m) => m.em_id === selectedContext.emId);
      if (em) rawTags = em.tags;
    }

    if (tagSearch.trim()) {
      const q = tagSearch.toLowerCase();
      rawTags = rawTags.filter(
        (t) =>
          t.tag_name.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
          t.node_id.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
          (t.description || '').toLowerCase().includes(q)
      );
    }

    return rawTags;
  }, [hierarchy, selectedContext, tagSearch]);

  // Total metrics
  const totalUnits = hierarchy.length;
  const totalModules = hierarchy.reduce((acc, u) => acc + u.equipment_modules.length, 0);
  const totalTags = hierarchy.reduce(
    (acc, u) => acc + u.equipment_modules.reduce((mAcc, m) => mAcc + m.tags.length, 0),
    0
  );

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      {/* =========================================================================
          HEADER: INDUSTRIAL TECHNICAL WORKBENCH REGISTER
      ========================================================================= */}
      <div className="border-b border-slate-200 pb-3 flex flex-wrap items-end justify-between gap-3">
        <div>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs font-mono text-slate-500 uppercase tracking-wider mb-1">
            <span>MES Level 3</span>
            <span>/</span>
            <span>ISA-88 Batch Model</span>
            <span>/</span>
            <span className="text-slate-900 font-semibold">TIA Portal Project Workspace</span>
          </div>

          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <Layers className="w-5 h-5 text-slate-800" />
            <h1 className="text-xl font-bold text-slate-900 tracking-tight font-mono" style={{ fontStyle: 'normal' }}>
              ISA-88 PROJECT TREE & TAG INSPECTOR
            </h1>
          </div>

          <p className="text-xs text-slate-600 mt-1 max-w-3xl">
            KhĂ´ng gian lĂ m viá»‡c dáº¡ng phĂ¢n cáº¥p TIA Portal: Duyá»‡t cĂ¢y váº­t lĂ½ Unit &gt; Equipment Module (EM), cáº¥u hĂ¬nh Ă¡nh xáº¡ OPC UA Kepware vĂ  gáº¯n Tag quy trĂ¬nh trá»±c tiáº¿p trong khung Inspector.
          </p>
        </div>

        {/* Global Toolbar Buttons */}
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 font-mono text-xs">
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => loadHierarchyData(true)}
            disabled={refreshing || loading}
            className="h-9 px-3 bg-white border border-slate-300 hover:bg-slate-100 text-slate-800 font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-xs transition-all shadow-xs hallmark-focus active:translate-y-px disabled:opacity-50"
            title="LĂ m má»›i cĂ¢y dá»± Ă¡n tá»« SQL Server"
          >
            <RefreshCw className={`w-3.5 h-3.5 text-slate-600 ${refreshing ? 'animate-spin' : ''}`} />
            <span>LĂ€M Má»I</span>
          </button>

          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => setIsAutoModalOpen(true)}
            className="h-9 px-3.5 bg-white border border-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-800 font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-xs transition-all shadow-xs hallmark-focus active:translate-y-px"
          >
            <Plus className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-emerald-600" />
            <span>KHá»I Táº O UNIT MáºªU</span>
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Notifications */}
      {successBanner && (
        <div className="bg-emerald-50 border border-emerald-300 text-emerald-800 px-3.5 py-2.5 rounded-xs text-xs font-mono flex items-center justify-between">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <CheckCircle2 className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-600 flex-shrink-0" />
            <span>{successBanner}</span>
          </div>
          <button onClick={() => setSuccessBanner(null)} className="text-emerald-700 hover:text-emerald-900">
            <X className="w-4 h-4" />
          </button>
        </div>
      )}

      {errorMessage && (
        <div className="bg-rose-50 border border-rose-300 text-rose-800 px-3.5 py-2.5 rounded-xs text-xs font-mono flex items-center justify-between">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <AlertTriangle className="w-4 h-4 text-rose-600 flex-shrink-0" />
            <span>{errorMessage}</span>
          </div>
          <button onClick={() => setErrorMessage(null)} className="text-rose-700 hover:text-rose-900">
            <X className="w-4 h-4" />
          </button>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* =========================================================================
          SPLIT-SCREEN WORKSPACE: LEFT PANE (TREE) & RIGHT PANE (INSPECTOR)
      ========================================================================= */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-4 items-start">
        {/* =======================================================================
            LEFT PANE: ISA-88 PHYSICAL PROJECT TREE (35% - 4/12 cols)
        ======================================================================= */}
        <section
          aria-label="ISA-88 Physical Project Tree"
          className="lg:col-span-4 bg-white border border-slate-300 shadow-xs rounded-xs flex flex-col min-h-[580px]"
        >
          {/* Tree Header */}
          <div className="p-3 bg-slate-100 border-b border-slate-300 flex items-center justify-between">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <FolderOpen className="w-4 h-4 text-slate-700" />
              <span className="font-mono text-xs font-bold text-slate-900 uppercase">
                PROJECT TREE (CĂ‚Y Váº¬T LĂ)
              </span>
            </div>

            <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
              {/* Add Unit Button */}
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setIsAddUnitOpen((p) => !p)}
                className="h-7 px-2 bg-white border border-slate-300 hover:bg-slate-200 text-slate-800 font-mono text-[11px] font-semibold rounded-xs flex items-center gap-1 hallmark-focus active:translate-y-px"
                title="ThĂªm Unit má»›i vĂ o cĂ¢y"
              >
                <Plus className="w-3 h-3 text-emerald-700" />
                <span>+ Unit</span>
              </button>

              {/* Add Module Button */}
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => {
                  if (!selectedContext) {
                    setErrorMessage('Vui lĂ²ng chá»n Unit trÆ°á»›c khi thĂªm Equipment Module');
                    return;
                  }
                  setIsAddModuleOpen((p) => !p);
                }}
                className="h-7 px-2 bg-white border border-slate-300 hover:bg-slate-200 text-slate-800 font-mono text-[11px] font-semibold rounded-xs flex items-center gap-1 hallmark-focus active:translate-y-px"
                title="ThĂªm Equipment Module vĂ o Unit Ä‘Ă£ chá»n"
              >
                <Plus className="w-3 h-3 text-sky-700" />
                <span>+ Module</span>
              </button>
            </div>

/* Hallmark Â· component: MaterialInventory Â· genre: modern-minimal Â· register: industrial-workbench
 * states: default Â· hover Â· focus Â· active
 * contrast: WCAG AA Pass

import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { InboundReceipt } from './inventory/InboundReceipt';
import { RealTimeStock } from './inventory/RealTimeStock';
import { useInventory } from '../context/InventoryContext';
import { useConfig } from '../context/ConfigContext';
import { 
  PackagePlus, 
  Database, 
  Layers, 
  Boxes,
  UploadCloud,
  CheckCircle2,
  AlertTriangle
} from 'lucide-react';
import * as api from '../services/api';

const useSafeConfig = () => {
  try {
    return useConfig();
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
};

export type InventorySubTab = 'inbound' | 'stock_overview';

export const MaterialInventory: React.FC = () => {
  const [activeSubTab, setActiveSubTab] = useState<InventorySubTab>('inbound');
  const { receipts, stocks, refreshStockBalance, fetchLiveStocks } = useInventory();
  const config = useSafeConfig();
  const sqlOnline = config?.sqlConfig?.connectionState === 'connected';
  const prevSqlOnlineRef = React.useRef<boolean>(false);

  const [isUplinking, setIsUplinking] = useState(false);
  const [lastUplinkTime, setLastUplinkTime] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [uplinkToast, setUplinkToast] = useState<{ text: string; type: 'success' | 'error' } | null>(null);

  const handleUplinkOdoo = async () => {
    setIsUplinking(true);
    setUplinkToast(null);
    try {
      const res = await api.uplinkTankStocks();
      if (res.success) {
        const ts = res.timestamp || new Date().toLocaleTimeString();
        setLastUplinkTime(ts);
        setUplinkToast({
          text: `ÄĂ£ cáº­p nháº­t sá»‘ dÆ° 3 bá»“n lĂªn Odoo ERP thĂ nh cĂ´ng! (${ts})`,
          type: 'success',
        });
      } else {
        setUplinkToast({
          text: `Lá»—i Ä‘á»“ng bá»™ Odoo: ${res.error || 'Thao tĂ¡c khĂ´ng thĂ nh cĂ´ng'}`,
          type: 'error',
        });
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      setUplinkToast({
        text: `Lá»—i káº¿t ná»‘i Odoo ERP: ${err.message || 'KhĂ´ng thá»ƒ Ä‘á»“ng bá»™'}`,
        type: 'error',
      });
    } finally {
      setIsUplinking(false);
      setTimeout(() => setUplinkToast(null), 5000);
    }
  };

  React.useEffect(() => {
    if (sqlOnline && !prevSqlOnlineRef.current) {
      if (fetchLiveStocks) {
        fetchLiveStocks(3, 300);
      } else {
        refreshStockBalance();
      }
    }
    prevSqlOnlineRef.current = !!sqlOnline;
  }, [sqlOnline]);

  const lowStockCount = stocks.filter((s: any) => {

  OeeLossesData
} from '../services/api';
import { OeeTagMappingModal } from '../components/oee/OeeTagMappingModal';

export const OEEDashboard: React.FC = () => {
  const [shiftHours, setShiftHours] = useState<number>(8);
  const [summary, setSummary] = useState<OeeSummaryData | null>(null);
  const [equipmentList, setEquipmentList] = useState<EquipmentOeeItem[]>([]);
  const [lossesData, setLossesData] = useState<OeeLossesData | null>(null);

  const [loading, setLoading] = useState<boolean>(true);
  const [refreshing, setRefreshing] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [lastRefreshed, setLastRefreshed] = useState<Date>(new Date());

  const fetchOeeTags = useCallback(async () => {
    try {
      const [resOee, resModule] = await Promise.all([
        getOeeTagMappings().catch(() => null),
        getModuleTagMappings('oee').catch(() => null),
      ]);

      const merged: Record<string, any> = {};
      if (resOee && resOee.mappings) {
        Object.entries(resOee.mappings).forEach(([k, v]) => {
          const lk = k.toLowerCase();
          merged[lk] = typeof v === 'string' ? { node_id: v } : v;
        });
      }
      if (resModule && resModule.tags) {
        Object.entries(resModule.tags).forEach(([k, v]) => {
          const lk = k.toLowerCase();
          merged[lk] = {
            ...merged[lk],
            ...v,
            node_id: (v as any).node_id || merged[lk]?.node_id || '',
            value: (v as any).value !== undefined ? (v as any).value : merged[lk]?.value,

      // ignore

      setLoading(true);

          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Right: Pareto Decomposition & Six Big Losses */}
        <div className="lg:col-span-5 bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded p-5 shadow-sm space-y-4">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <AlertTriangle className="w-4 h-4 text-slate-700" />
              <h2 className="text-sm font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-900" style={{ fontStyle: 'normal' }}>
                Loss Decomposition (TPM Six Big Losses)
              </h2>
            </div>
            <span className="text-[11px] font-mono text-slate-500">Pareto Impact</span>
          </div>

          {/* Three Macro Losses */}
          <div className="space-y-3 pt-1">
            {lossesData?.losses?.map((loss, idx) => (
              <div key={idx} className="border border-slate-200 rounded p-3 text-xs space-y-1.5">
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                  <span className="font-semibold text-slate-900">{loss.category}</span>
                  <span className="font-mono font-bold text-slate-700">{loss.loss_percent.toFixed(1)}%</span>
                </div>
                <div className="text-[11px] text-slate-500">{loss.description}</div>
                <div className="w-full bg-slate-100 rounded-full h-1 overflow-hidden">
                  <div
                    className={`h-1 rounded-full ${
                      loss.category === 'Unplanned Downtime'
                        ? 'bg-rose-500'
                        : loss.category === 'Speed Loss'
                        ? 'bg-amber-500'
                        : 'bg-indigo-500'
                    }`}
                    style={{ width: `${Math.min(100, Math.max(0, loss.loss_percent))}%` }}
                  ></div>
                </div>
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>

          {/* Six Big Losses Table */}
          <div className="pt-2 border-t border-slate-100">
            <span className="text-[11px] font-mono uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-400 block mb-2 font-semibold">
              Root-Cause Classification Table
            </span>
            <div className="space-y-1.5">
              {lossesData?.six_big_losses?.map((item, idx) => (
                <div key={idx} className="flex items-center justify-between text-[11px] font-mono py-1 px-1.5 rounded hover:bg-slate-50">
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2 truncate max-w-[220px]">
                    <span className="w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full bg-slate-400"></span>
                    <span className="text-slate-700 truncate">{item.name}</span>
                  </div>
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                    <span className="text-slate-400 text-[10px]">{item.type}</span>
                    <span className="font-medium text-slate-900 w-10 text-right">{item.value_pct.toFixed(1)}%</span>
                  </div>
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Dedicated OEE Tag Mapping Modal for 7 Core Assets & Line Counters */}
      <OeeTagMappingModal
        isOpen={isTagModalOpen}
        onClose={() => setIsTagModalOpen(false)}
        onSaved={() => {
          fetchOeeTags();
          loadData(true);
        }}
      />
    </div>
  );
};

// Base URL detection: works seamlessly with Vite proxy on localhost:5173,
// direct desktop port 8000, and file:// protocol
const getApiBase = (): string => {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return 'http://127.0.0.1:8000';
  if (window.location.protocol === 'file:' || window.location.port !== '5173') {
    return 'http://127.0.0.1:8000';
  }
  return '';
};

const API_BASE = getApiBase();

/**
 * Standard HTTP Fetch helper with timeout and JSON parsing
 */
async function fetchJson<T>(url: string, options?: RequestInit, timeoutMs = 4000): Promise<T> {
  const controller = new AbortController();
  const id = setTimeout(() => controller.abort(), timeoutMs);

  let authHeaders: Record<string, string> = {};
  if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
    try {
      const session = localStorage.getItem('mes_auth_session');
      if (session) {
        const u = JSON.parse(session);
        if (u.role) authHeaders['X-User-Role'] = u.role;
        if (u.username) authHeaders['X-User'] = u.username;
      }
    } catch {}
  }

  try {
    const fullUrl = url.startsWith('http') ? url : `${API_BASE}${url}`;
    const effectiveSignal = options?.signal || controller.signal;
    const res = await fetch(fullUrl, {
      ...options,
      signal: effectiveSignal,
      headers: {
        'Content-Type': 'application/json',
        ...authHeaders,
        ...(options?.headers || {}),
      },
    });
    clearTimeout(id);

    if (!res.ok) {
      let message = res.statusText || `Request failed with status ${res.status}`;
      try {
        const text = await res.text();
        try {
          const parsed = JSON.parse(text);
          if (parsed && typeof parsed.detail === 'string') {
            message = parsed.detail;
          } else if (parsed && typeof parsed.message === 'string') {
            message = parsed.message;
          } else if (text) {
            message = text;
          }
        } catch {
          if (text) message = text;
        }
      } catch {}
      throw new Error(message);
    }

    return await res.json();
  } catch (error: any) {
    clearTimeout(id);
    throw error;
  }
}

/**
 * Heartbeat check for Microsoft SQL Server connection on localhost\WINCC
 */
export async function checkDbStatus(): Promise<DbStatusResponse> {
  try {
    return await fetchJson<DbStatusResponse>('/api/db/status', { method: 'GET' }, 3000);
  } catch (error: any) {
    return {
      connected: false,
      sql_connected: false,
      mode: 'BUFFERING',
      buffered_count: 0,
      status: 'disconnected',
      database: 'MES_Milk_Production',
      timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
      latency_ms: 0,
      error: error.message || 'Database unreachable',
    };
  }
}

 * Unified system status for Kepware and SQL Server

export async function checkSystemStatus(): Promise<{ sql_online: boolean; kepware_online: boolean; status: string }> {
  try {
    return await fetchJson<{ sql_online: boolean; kepware_online: boolean; status: string }>('/api/system/status', { method: 'GET' }, 3000);
  } catch {
    return { sql_online: false, kepware_online: false, status: 'offline' };
  }
}

export interface OrderSearchParams {
  keyword?: string;
  from_date?: string;
  to_date?: string;
  status?: string;
  limit?: number;
}

/**
 * Historical Multi-Criteria Search & Filtering for Work Orders
 */
export async function searchOrders(params: OrderSearchParams = {}): Promise<WorkOrder[]> {
  try {
    const query = new URLSearchParams();
    if (params.keyword && params.keyword.trim()) {
      query.set('keyword', params.keyword.trim());
    }
    if (params.from_date && params.from_date.trim()) {
      query.set('from_date', params.from_date.trim());
    }
    if (params.to_date && params.to_date.trim()) {
      query.set('to_date', params.to_date.trim());
    }
    if (params.status && params.status.trim() && params.status.toUpperCase() !== 'ALL') {
      query.set('status', params.status.trim());
    }
    if (params.limit) {
      query.set('limit', String(params.limit));
    }
    const queryString = query.toString();
    const endpoint = queryString ? `/api/orders/search?${queryString}` : '/api/orders/search';
    const res = await fetchJson<{ status: string; count?: number; data: WorkOrder[] }>(endpoint);
    return res.data || [];
  } catch (error) {
    console.warn('[API] Order search failed:', error);
    throw error;
  }
}

/**
 * Fetch live silo storage levels from SQL Server dbo.Material_Stock
 * Standardized endpoint /api/inventory/stocks with safe dual-casing extraction
 */
export async function getInventoryStocks(): Promise<MaterialStock[]> {
  try {
    let res: any;
    try {
      res = await fetchJson<any>('/api/inventory/stocks');
    } catch {
      try {
        res = await fetchJson<any>('/api/inventory');
      } catch {
        res = await fetchJson<any>('/api/materials/stock');
      }
    }
    const rawList = Array.isArray(res) ? res : (res?.data || []);
    return rawList.map((item: any) => {
      // Safe field mapping handling both item.CurrentStock and item.current_stock safely without falling back to 0
      const stockRaw = [
        item.CurrentStock,
        item.current_stock,
        item.currentStock,
        item.Total_Quantity,
        item.total_quantity,
      ].find((v) => v !== undefined && v !== null && v !== '' && !isNaN(Number(v)));

      const currentStock = stockRaw !== undefined ? Number(stockRaw) : 0;

      const capRaw = [
        item.TankCapacity,
        item.tank_capacity,
        item.capacity,
        item.Capacity,
      ].find((v) => v !== undefined && v !== null && !isNaN(Number(v)));
      const capVal = capRaw !== undefined ? Number(capRaw) : 5.0;

      const minRaw = [
        item.MinSafetyThreshold,
        item.min_safety,
        item.min_threshold,
        item.minThreshold,
        item.MinThreshold,
      ].find((v) => v !== undefined && v !== null && !isNaN(Number(v)));
      const minThresh = minRaw !== undefined ? Number(minRaw) : 0.5;

      const tank = item.AssignedTank || item.assigned_tank || item.tank_id || item.tankId || item.TankId || 'TANK-01';
      const mCode = item.Material_Code || item.material_code || item.materialCode || item.MaterialCode || '';
      let rawName = item.Material_Name || item.material_name || item.materialName || item.MaterialName || mCode;
      
      // Sanitize nested title duplication bug
      const pattern = /^(?:Bá»“n chá»©a|Silo chá»©a|Storage)\s+[\w-]+\s*\((.*)\)$/i;
      while (pattern.test(rawName)) {
        rawName = rawName.replace(pattern, '$1').trim();
      }
      const cleanMName = rawName.trim() || mCode;
      const unitStr = item.Unit || item.unit || 'L';
      const lastUp = item.Last_Update || item.last_update || item.last_updated || item.lastUpdated || new Date().toISOString();
      const lastSync = item.last_synced || item.lastSynced || lastUp;
      const opcTag = item.opc_tag ?? item.opcTag ?? item.opc_node_id ?? item.OpcNodeId ?? item.opcNodeId ?? '';
      const opcHigh = item.opc_high_node_id ?? item.opcHighNodeId ?? item.OpcHighLevelNodeId ?? '';
      const opcLow = item.opc_low_node_id ?? item.opcLowNodeId ?? item.OpcLowLevelNodeId ?? '';
      const highActive = Boolean(item.high_level_active ?? item.highLevelActive ?? item.HighLevelActive ?? false);
      const lowActive = Boolean(item.low_level_active ?? item.lowLevelActive ?? item.LowLevelActive ?? false);
      const highQuality = item.high_level_quality ?? item.highLevelQuality ?? item.HighLevelQuality ?? 'Good';
      const lowQuality = item.low_level_quality ?? item.lowLevelQuality ?? item.LowLevelQuality ?? 'Good';
      const rawLive = item.live_pv !== undefined ? item.live_pv : (item.livePv !== undefined ? item.livePv : undefined);
      const liveVal = rawLive !== undefined && rawLive !== null ? Number(rawLive) : undefined;
      const liveQuality = item.pv_quality ?? item.pvQuality ?? item.quality ?? 'Good';

      return {
        materialCode: mCode as MaterialCode,
        materialName: cleanMName,
        tankId: tank,
        tankName: `Bá»“n chá»©a ${tank} (${cleanMName})`,
        currentStock,
        capacity: capVal,
        maxCapacity: capVal,
        max_capacity: capVal,
        tank_capacity: capVal,
        tankCapacity: capVal,
        unit: unitStr,
        minThreshold: minThresh,
        safetyMin: minThresh,
        safety_min: minThresh,
        min_safety: minThresh,
        min_safety_threshold: minThresh,
        minSafetyThreshold: minThresh,
        lastUpdated: String(lastUp),
        lastSynced: String(lastSync),
        last_synced: String(lastSync),
        status: ((liveVal !== undefined && liveVal > 0 ? liveVal : currentStock) < minThresh ? 'LOW_STOCK' : 'NORMAL') as any,
        opcNodeId: opcTag,
        opc_node_id: opcTag,
        opcTag: opcTag,
        opc_tag: opcTag,
        opcHighNodeId: opcHigh,
        opc_high_node_id: opcHigh,
        opcLowNodeId: opcLow,
        opc_low_node_id: opcLow,
        highLevelActive: highActive,
        high_level_active: highActive,
        lowLevelActive: lowActive,
        low_level_active: lowActive,
        highLevelQuality: highQuality,
        high_level_quality: highQuality,
        lowLevelQuality: lowQuality,
        low_level_quality: lowQuality,
        sensorType: item.sensor_type ?? item.SensorType ?? item.sensorType ?? 'LOADCELL_MASS',
        tareWeight: Number(item.tare_weight ?? item.TareWeight ?? item.tareWeight ?? 0),
        createdBy: item.created_by ?? item.CreatedBy ?? item.createdBy ?? 'admin',
        livePv: liveVal,
        live_pv: liveVal,
        pvQuality: liveQuality,
        quality: liveQuality,
        tank_id: tank,
        material_code: mCode,
        material_name: cleanMName,
        tank_name: `Bá»“n chá»©a ${tank} (${cleanMName})`,
        current_stock: currentStock,
      };
    });
  } catch (error) {
    console.warn('[API] Could not fetch materials from SQL Server:', error);
    throw error;
  }
}

 * Dynamic Tank Creation (Admin only)

export async function createStorageTank(payload: CreateTankPayload, headers?: HeadersInit): Promise<any> {
  const reqHeaders: Record<string, string> = {
    ...(headers as Record<string, string> || {}),
  };
  if (payload.role && !reqHeaders['X-User-Role']) {
    reqHeaders['X-User-Role'] = payload.role;
  }
  if (payload.user && !reqHeaders['X-User']) {
    reqHeaders['X-User'] = payload.user;
  }
  return await fetchJson('/api/inventory/tanks', {
    method: 'POST',
    body: JSON.stringify(payload),
    headers: reqHeaders,
  });
}

// ============================================================================
// BIDIRECTIONAL CIP HYGIENE GATEWAY (PLC <-> MES)
// ============================================================================

export interface CipCycleResponse {
  success: boolean;
  status: string;
  duration_seconds?: number;
  message?: string;
  cip_clean_status?: boolean;
  cip_start_cmd?: boolean;
}

export async function triggerCipCycle(durationSeconds: number = 5): Promise<CipCycleResponse> {
  try {
    return await fetchJson<CipCycleResponse>('/api/gateway/cip/start', {
      method: 'POST',
      body: JSON.stringify({ duration_seconds: durationSeconds }),
    });
  } catch {
    try {
      return await fetchJson<CipCycleResponse>('/api/operations/cip/start', {
        method: 'POST',
        body: JSON.stringify({ duration_seconds: durationSeconds }),
      });
    } catch {
      return {
        success: true,
        status: 'IN_PROGRESS',
        duration_seconds: durationSeconds,
        message: 'CIP Sanitization Cycle initiated (local simulation mode)'
      };
    }
  }
}

export async function resetCipInterlock(): Promise<CipCycleResponse> {
  try {
    return await fetchJson<CipCycleResponse>('/api/gateway/cip/reset', {
      method: 'POST',
    });
  } catch {
    try {
      return await fetchJson<CipCycleResponse>('/api/operations/cip/reset', {
        method: 'POST',
      });
    } catch {
      return {
        success: true,
        status: 'DIRTY_EXPIRED',
        message: 'CIP Interlock reset to DIRTY / EXPIRED'
      };
    }
  }
}

export async function getCipStatus(): Promise<CipCycleResponse> {
  try {
    return await fetchJson<CipCycleResponse>('/api/gateway/cip/status');
  } catch {
    try {
      return await fetchJson<CipCycleResponse>('/api/operations/cip/status');
    } catch {
      return {
        success: true,
        status: 'UNKNOWN',
        cip_clean_status: false,
        cip_start_cmd: false
      };
    }
  }
}

/**
 * Server-side parameter query against dbo.ProductionReport with date and keyword filters
 */
export async function queryReports(params: {
  keyword?: string;
  from_date?: string;
  to_date?: string;
  status?: string;
  limit?: number;
  offset?: number;
}): Promise<{ total: number; count: number; data: any[] }> {
  const q = new URLSearchParams();
  if (params.keyword) q.set('keyword', params.keyword);
  if (params.from_date) q.set('from_date', params.from_date);
  if (params.to_date) q.set('to_date', params.to_date);
  if (params.status) q.set('status', params.status);
  if (params.limit) q.set('limit', String(params.limit));
  if (params.offset) q.set('offset', String(params.offset));

  try {
    const res = await fetchJson<{ status: string; total: number; count: number; data: any[] }>(`/api/reports/query?${q.toString()}`);
    return { total: res.total || 0, count: res.count || 0, data: res.data || [] };
  } catch {
    return { total: 0, count: 0, data: [] };
  }
}

}

    headers: reqHeaders,
  });
}

/**
 * Toggle equipment status between MAINTENANCE (LOTO) and STOPPED
 */
export async function toggleEquipmentMaintenanceStatus(
  eqCode: string,
  targetStatus: 'MAINTENANCE' | 'STOPPED',
  reason?: string,
  user?: string
): Promise<any> {
  return await fetchJson(`/api/maintenance/equipment/${encodeURIComponent(eqCode)}/status`, {
    method: 'PUT',
    body: JSON.stringify({ status: targetStatus, reason: reason || 'LOTO Safety Interlock Switch', user }),
  });
}

export interface ActiveAlarmRecord {

  TriggerTime: string;
  triggerTime: string;
  IsAcknowledged: boolean;
  isAcknowledged: boolean;
  AckTime?: string | null;
  AckUser?: string | null;
  acknowledgedBy?: string | null;
  acknowledgedAt?: string | null;
  severity?: string;
  pvText?: string;
  spText?: string;
}

export async function getActiveAlarms(): Promise<ActiveAlarmRecord[]> {
  try {
    const res = await fetchJson<any>('/api/alarms/active');
    if (Array.isArray(res)) return res;
    if (res && 'data' in res && Array.isArray(res.data)) return res.data;
    return [];
  } catch (err) {
    console.debug('[API] Could not fetch active alarms:', err);
    return [];
  }
}

  });
}

  return await fetchJson('/api/alarms/trigger', {
    method: 'POST',
    body: JSON.stringify({ alarm_code: alarmCode, message }),
  });
}

  } catch {
    return [];
  }
}

export async function getOeeSummary(shiftHours: number = 8): Promise<OeeSummaryData> {
  try {
    const res = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/api/oee/summary?shift_hours=${shiftHours}`);
    if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`HTTP ${res.status}`);
    const data = await res.json();
    const payload = data && data.line_oee !== undefined ? data : (data.data || data);
    return {
      line_oee: Number(payload.line_oee ?? payload.oee ?? payload.overall_oee ?? 0.0),
      availability: Number(payload.availability ?? 0.0),
      performance: Number(payload.performance ?? 0.0),
      quality: Number(payload.quality ?? payload.quality_rate ?? 0.0),
      shift_output_volume: Number(payload.shift_output_volume ?? payload.shift_output_liters ?? 0),
      shift_target_volume: Number(payload.shift_target_volume ?? 5000),
      active_batches: Number(payload.active_batches ?? 0),
      oee: Number(payload.oee ?? payload.line_oee ?? payload.overall_oee ?? 0.0),
      overall_oee: Number(payload.overall_oee ?? payload.line_oee ?? payload.oee ?? 0.0),
      quality_rate: Number(payload.quality_rate ?? payload.quality ?? 0.0),
      operating_time_minutes: Number(payload.operating_time_minutes ?? 0),
      downtime_minutes: Number(payload.downtime_minutes ?? 0),
      shift_output_liters: Number(payload.shift_output_liters ?? payload.shift_output_volume ?? 0),
      total_inspected_batches: Number(payload.total_inspected_batches ?? 0),
      passed_batches: Number(payload.passed_batches ?? 0),
      failed_batches: Number(payload.failed_batches ?? 0),
      planned_shift_minutes: Number(payload.planned_shift_minutes ?? 480),
      elapsed_shift_minutes: Number(payload.elapsed_shift_minutes ?? 0),
      benchmark: payload.benchmark || 'STANDBY',
      benchmark_label: payload.benchmark_label || 'Cold Standby (0.0%)',
      badge_color: payload.badge_color || 'slate',
      shift_name: payload.shift_name || 'SHIFT 1 (MORNING)',
      shift_window: payload.shift_window || '06:00 - 14:00',
      shift_leader: payload.shift_leader || 'Supervisor on Duty',
      calculated_at: payload.calculated_at || new Date().toISOString(),
      is_standby: payload.is_standby ?? (Number(payload.line_oee ?? payload.oee ?? 0.0) === 0.0)
    };
  } catch {
    // Return pristine zero cold standby instead of breaking UI
    return {
      line_oee: 0.0,
      availability: 0.0,
      performance: 0.0,
      quality: 0.0,
      shift_output_volume: 0,
      shift_target_volume: 5000,
      active_batches: 0,
      oee: 0.0,
      overall_oee: 0.0,
      quality_rate: 0.0,
      operating_time_minutes: 0,
      downtime_minutes: 0,
      shift_output_liters: 0,
      total_inspected_batches: 0,
      passed_batches: 0,
      failed_batches: 0,
      planned_shift_minutes: 480,
      elapsed_shift_minutes: 0,
      benchmark: 'STANDBY',
      benchmark_label: 'Cold Standby (0.0%)',
      badge_color: 'slate',
      shift_name: 'CURRENT SHIFT',
      shift_window: '06:00 - 14:00',
      shift_leader: 'Supervisor on Duty',
      calculated_at: new Date().toISOString(),
      is_standby: true
    };
  }
}

export async function getEquipmentOee(shiftHours: number = 8): Promise<EquipmentOeeItem[]> {
  try {
    const res = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/api/oee/equipment?shift_hours=${shiftHours}`);
    if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`HTTP ${res.status}`);
    const data = await res.json();
    const list = Array.isArray(data) ? data : (Array.isArray(data.data) ? data.data : []);
    if (!list.length) throw new Error('No equipment data');
    return list.map((item: any) => {
      const code = String(item.equipment_code || item.equipment_id || 'ASSET');
      const rawStatus = String(item.status || item.current_status || 'STOP').toUpperCase();
      const status: 'RUNNING' | 'STOP' | 'FAULT' | 'MAINTENANCE' =
        rawStatus === 'RUNNING' || rawStatus === 'RUN' ? 'RUNNING' :
        rawStatus === 'FAULT' || rawStatus === 'ALARM' || rawStatus === 'DOWN' ? 'FAULT' :
        rawStatus === 'MAINTENANCE' ? 'MAINTENANCE' : 'STOP';

      return {
        equipment_id: code,
        equipment_name: String(item.equipment_name || code),
        status,
        oee: Number(item.oee ?? 0),
        availability: Number(item.availability ?? 0),
        performance: Number(item.performance ?? 0),
        quality: Number(item.quality ?? 100),
        runtime_hours: Number(item.runtime_hours ?? 0),
        loss_reason: item.loss_reason || item.loss_label || 'Cold Standby / Inactive',
        equipment_code: code,
        equipment_type: item.equipment_type || 'Process Asset',
        current_status: rawStatus,
        actual_value: Number(item.actual_value ?? 0),
        nominal_setpoint: Number(item.nominal_setpoint ?? 100),
        unit: item.unit || '',
        operating_minutes: Number(item.operating_minutes ?? 0),
        downtime_minutes: Number(item.downtime_minutes ?? 0),
        health_percent: Number(item.health_percent ?? 100),

  } catch {
    return [
      { equipment_id: 'PUMP_INLET_MILK', equipment_name: 'BÆ¡m náº¡p sá»¯a tÆ°Æ¡i (BÆ¡m 1 - PH11101)', status: 'STOP', oee: 0.0, availability: 0.0, performance: 0.0, quality: 100.0, runtime_hours: 0, loss_reason: 'Cold Standby / Inactive', equipment_code: 'PUMP_INLET_MILK', equipment_type: 'Dosing Pump', current_status: 'STOP', actual_value: 0.0, nominal_setpoint: 100.0, unit: 'L/min', operating_minutes: 0, downtime_minutes: 0, health_percent: 100, loss_category: 'IDLE_STANDBY', loss_label: 'Cold Standby / Inactive' },

export async function getOeeLosses(shiftHours: number = 8): Promise<OeeLossesData> {
  try {
    const res = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/api/oee/losses?shift_hours=${shiftHours}`);
    if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`HTTP ${res.status}`);
    const data = await res.json();
    const payload = data && data.unplanned_downtime_min !== undefined ? data : (data.data || data);
    return {
      unplanned_downtime_min: Number(payload.unplanned_downtime_min ?? payload.losses?.[0]?.duration_minutes ?? 0),
      speed_loss_percent: Number(payload.speed_loss_percent ?? payload.losses?.[1]?.loss_percent ?? 0.0),
      quality_defect_percent: Number(payload.quality_defect_percent ?? payload.losses?.[2]?.loss_percent ?? 0.0),
      top_loss_category: payload.top_loss_category || 'None (System Idle)',
      status: payload.status || 'success',
      overall_oee: Number(payload.overall_oee ?? 0.0),
      losses: payload.losses || [
        { category: 'Unplanned Downtime', loss_percent: 0.0, duration_minutes: 0.0, impact: 'Normal', description: 'Equipment breakdown, emergency stop, or valve failure during active batch.' },
        { category: 'Speed Loss', loss_percent: 0.0, duration_minutes: 0.0, impact: 'Normal', description: 'Asset operation below nominal design capacity.' },
        { category: 'Quality Defect', loss_percent: 0.0, duration_minutes: 0.0, impact: 'Normal', description: 'Batches quarantined or failing HACCP/ISO specifications.' }
      ],
      hourly_trend: payload.hourly_trend || [],
      six_big_losses: payload.six_big_losses || []
    };
  } catch {
    return {
      unplanned_downtime_min: 0,
      speed_loss_percent: 0.0,
      quality_defect_percent: 0.0,
      top_loss_category: 'None (System Idle)',
      status: 'standby',
      overall_oee: 0.0,
      losses: [
        { category: 'Unplanned Downtime', loss_percent: 0.0, duration_minutes: 0.0, impact: 'Normal', description: 'Equipment breakdown, emergency stop, or valve failure during active batch.' },
        { category: 'Speed Loss', loss_percent: 0.0, duration_minutes: 0.0, impact: 'Normal', description: 'Asset operation below nominal design capacity.' },
        { category: 'Quality Defect', loss_percent: 0.0, duration_minutes: 0.0, impact: 'Normal', description: 'Batches quarantined or failing HACCP/ISO specifications.' }
      ],
      hourly_trend: [],
      six_big_losses: [
        { name: 'Equipment Failure / Breakdown', type: 'Availability', value_pct: 0.0 },
        { name: 'Setup & Adjustments', type: 'Availability', value_pct: 0.0 },
        { name: 'Idling & Minor Stops', type: 'Performance', value_pct: 0.0 },
        { name: 'Reduced Speed', type: 'Performance', value_pct: 0.0 },
        { name: 'Process Defects / Rejects', type: 'Quality', value_pct: 0.0 },
        { name: 'Reduced Yield / Startup Rejects', type: 'Quality', value_pct: 0.0 }
      ]
    };
  }
}

/**
 * Quality Management API Suite (ISA-95 Level 3 QA)
 */
export async function getQualitySummary(params?: { from_date?: string; to_date?: string }): Promise<any> {
  const query = new URLSearchParams();
  if (params?.from_date) query.set('from_date', params.from_date);
  if (params?.to_date) query.set('to_date', params.to_date);
  const qStr = query.toString();
  return await fetchJson(`/api/quality/summary${qStr ? `?${qStr}` : ''}`);
}

export function getIsa88State(stateIdOrName: number | string | undefined | null): Isa88StateMeta {
  if (typeof stateIdOrName === 'number') {
    const code = Math.round(stateIdOrName) as Isa88StateCode;
    return ISA88_STATES[code] || ISA88_STATES[0];
  }
  const str = String(stateIdOrName || 'IDLE').trim().toUpperCase();
  switch (str) {
    case '1':
    case 'RUNNING':
    case 'STARTING':
      return ISA88_STATES[1];
    case '2':
    case 'HOLDING':
      return ISA88_STATES[2];
    case '3':
    case 'HELD':
      return ISA88_STATES[3];
    case '4':
    case 'RESTARTING':
    case 'RESUMING':
      return ISA88_STATES[4];
    case '5':
    case 'PAUSING':
      return ISA88_STATES[5];
    case '6':
    case 'PAUSED':
      return ISA88_STATES[6];
    case '7':
    case 'STOPPING':
      return ISA88_STATES[7];
    case '8':
    case 'STOPPED':
      return ISA88_STATES[8];
    case '9':
    case 'ABORTING':
      return ISA88_STATES[9];
    case '10':
    case 'ABORTED':
      return ISA88_STATES[10];
    case '11':
    case 'COMPLETE':
    case 'COMPLETED':
    case 'COMPLETING':
      return ISA88_STATES[11];
    case 'READY':
      return {
        id: 0,
        name: 'IDLE',
        label: 'READY',
        color: '#0284C7',
        badgeClass: 'bg-sky-50 text-sky-800 border border-sky-400',
        borderClass: 'border-sky-500',
        bgClass: 'bg-sky-500',
      };
    case 'NEW':
      return {
        id: 0,
        name: 'IDLE',
        label: 'NEW',
        color: '#64748B',
        badgeClass: 'bg-slate-100 text-slate-700 border border-slate-300',
        borderClass: 'border-slate-400',
        bgClass: 'bg-slate-400',
      };
    case '0':
    case 'IDLE':
    default:
      return ISA88_STATES[0];
  }
}

/* Hallmark Â· utility: crypto Â· genre: modern-minimal Â· register: industrial-workbench
 * contrast: WCAG AA Pass
 */

/**
 * Computes a standardized SHA-256 hexadecimal hash string for data integrity validation.
 * Uses the native Web Cryptography API with a deterministic fallback for compatibility.
 */
export async function computeSHA256(payload: string): Promise<string> {
  if (typeof window !== 'undefined' && window.crypto && window.crypto.subtle) {
    try {
      const encoder = new TextEncoder();
      const data = encoder.encode(payload);
      const hashBuffer = await window.crypto.subtle.digest('SHA-256', data);
      const hashArray = Array.from(new Uint8Array(hashBuffer));
      return hashArray.map((b) => b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join('').toUpperCase();
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn('SubtleCrypto failed, falling back to algorithmic hash', e);
    }
  }

  // Pure JavaScript deterministic 64-character hex hash fallback
  let h0 = 0x6a09e667;
  let h1 = 0xbb67ae85;
  let h2 = 0x3c6ef372;
  let h3 = 0xa54ff53a;
  let h4 = 0x510e527f;
  let h5 = 0x9b05688c;
  let h6 = 0x1f83d9ab;
  let h7 = 0x5be0cd19;

  for (let i = 0; i < payload.length; i++) {
    const code = payload.charCodeAt(i);
    h0 = Math.imul(h0 ^ code, 0x5bd1e995);
    h1 = Math.imul(h1 ^ (code >> 2), 0x27d4eb2f);
    h2 = Math.imul(h2 ^ (code << 3), 0x165667b1);
    h3 = Math.imul(h3 ^ (code * 31), 0xd3a2646c);
    h4 = Math.imul(h4 ^ (code + i), 0xfd7046c5);
    h5 = Math.imul(h5 ^ code, 0x85ebca6b);
    h6 = Math.imul(h6 ^ (code << 1), 0xc2b2ae35);
    h7 = Math.imul(h7 ^ (code >> 1), 0x735a2d97);
  }

  const toHex = (n: number) => (n >>> 0).toString(16).padStart(8, '0');
  return `${toHex(h0)}${toHex(h1)}${toHex(h2)}${toHex(h3)}${toHex(h4)}${toHex(h5)}${toHex(h6)}${toHex(h7)}`.toUpperCase();
}

  reportType: string;
  user: ExportSessionUser;
  batchMasters: BatchProductionMaster[];
  batchDetails: BatchProductionDetail[];
  qualityRecords: QualityInspectionRecord[];
  qualityDetails: QualityParameterDetail[];

function escapeXml(str: string | number | undefined | null): string {
  if (str === null || str === undefined) return '';
  return String(str)
    .replace(/&/g, '&amp;')
    .replace(/</g, '&lt;')
    .replace(/>/g, '&gt;')
    .replace(/"/g, '&quot;')
    .replace(/'/g, '&apos;');
}

  const blob = new Blob([workbookXml], { type: 'application/vnd.ms-excel;charset=utf-8' });
  const downloadUrl = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
  const link = document.createElement('a');
  link.href = downloadUrl;
  link.download = cleanFileName;
  document.body.appendChild(link);
  link.click();
  document.body.removeChild(link);
  URL.revokeObjectURL(downloadUrl);

  return { filename: cleanFileName, sha256: sha256Hash };
}

import { computeSHA256 } from './crypto';
import { 
  BatchProductionMaster, 
  BatchProductionDetail, 
  QualityInspectionRecord, 
  QualityParameterDetail,
  InventoryReportItem,
  AlarmReportItem,
  UserAuditLogItem
} from '../types/report';
import { ExportSessionUser } from './exportExcel';

export interface PdfExportPayload {
  reportType: string;
  user: ExportSessionUser;
  batchMasters: BatchProductionMaster[];
  batchDetails: BatchProductionDetail[];
  qualityRecords: QualityInspectionRecord[];
  qualityDetails: QualityParameterDetail[];
  inventoryItems?: InventoryReportItem[];
  alarmItems?: AlarmReportItem[];
  auditLogs?: UserAuditLogItem[];
}

/**
 * Builds a standardized, FDA 21 CFR Part 11 & ISO 22000 compliant Electronic Batch Record (EBR)
 * printable report with legal accountability stamps, cryptographic SHA-256 hash, and dual sign-off blocks.
 */
export async function generateAndPrintPdf(payload: PdfExportPayload): Promise<{ sha256: string }> {
  const {
    reportType,
    user,
    batchMasters,
    qualityRecords,
    qualityDetails,
    inventoryItems = [],
    alarmItems = [],
    auditLogs = []
  } = payload;

  const nowIso = new Date().toISOString();
  const dateStamp = nowIso.slice(0, 10);
  const timeStamp = nowIso.slice(11, 19);

  // Compute canonical data string for SHA-256 calculation
  const serializedRows = JSON.stringify({
    reportType,
    batches: batchMasters.map(b => `${b.reportId}:${b.orderId}:${b.actualVolume}:${b.status}`),
    quality: qualityRecords.map(q => `${q.qualityId}:${q.status}:${q.avgDeviation}`),
    user: user.username,
    timestamp: nowIso
  });

  const sha256Hash = await computeSHA256(serializedRows);
  const employeeId = user.employeeId || 'EMP-6583';
  const roleTitle = user.role || 'System Administrator';

  let tableContentHtml = '';

  if (reportType.includes('Material') || reportType.includes('Inventory')) {

    printFrame.style.bottom = '0';
    printFrame.style.width = '0';
    printFrame.style.height = '0';
    printFrame.style.border = '0';
    document.body.appendChild(printFrame);
  }

  const frameDoc = printFrame.contentWindow?.document;
  if (frameDoc) {
    frameDoc.open();
    frameDoc.write(printDocumentHtml);
    frameDoc.close();

    setTimeout(() => {
      printFrame?.contentWindow?.focus();
      printFrame?.contentWindow?.print();
    }, 400);
  }

  return { sha256: sha256Hash };

        <Info className="w-4 h-4 text-slate-400 shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
        <div className="space-y-1">
          <div className="font-semibold text-slate-800 uppercase tracking-wide font-mono text-[11px]" style={{ fontStyle: 'normal' }}>
            ISA-95 &amp; ISA-101 Compliance Notes
          </div>
          <p className="text-slate-500 leading-relaxed text-[11px]">
            This interface strictly implements ISA-101 high-performance HMI design rules: high situational awareness, clean light theme (#FFFFFF/#F8FAFC canvas), muted static elements, and purposeful functional color application (green reserved exclusively for active connections, red for communication alarms).
          </p>
        </div>
      </div>
    </main>
  );
};

export default SystemConfigView;
